It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother.
On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden.
At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers.
We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts.
The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost my brother and me our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty.
So I decided to run for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.
But this race is one of the most competitive in the country, and my MAGA opponent has the backing of Trump and his millions of dollars. It’s not going to be easy to win.

clean_body: It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother. Hello, It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother. On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden. At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers. We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts. The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost my brother and me our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty. So I decided to run for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy. But this race is one of the most competitive in the country, and my MAGA opponent has the backing of Trump and his millions of dollars. It’s not going to be easy to win. name: Royce White
subject: This email is longer, but it’s worth the read
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
body:
The industrial media complex attacks me for this
| [ ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=9b8ec76a32cb46e08a5ec466845210d8&_e=0UcGeeM3M-rcoRmmJ42Sm4TW_mc3fWoQrO5EWnyqke-r4r_voR7hXV48Q0gLUN_b5gYzNlUzTrqn8Qm4Kll3YXDJi79mSF9K2xj5S38sEg3YslH4j3fPayxd6rAMewMu05x--x3iUlAYBP3wdigGu9jMKIftAFjf_s04Tuw7lPwzN_10EnlAkEXnzDJ52PRYtGKqLD3E7Xf2V2XMegD7lFppYhEKQgi_3vMcL3U3fCOTVanriGHkcHqWo0ey9wN_vBxXfcF2uFunPYI3YeI95CezJ5GwMVhPz6kdIIOrBbo4F5GkIdNLW9oywehzj45Lq6FET-Fsu0swaRw7A-q6bw%3D%3D)
---

Fellow American,

In 2012, I was drafted into the NBA--it was a dream come true until I decided to stand up for what I believed in. I've struggled with mental health my entire life, and severe anxiety has been a demon following me at every turn in life. Mental health carried more of a stigma back then; it was hard to open up and take a stand, especially as a first-year player in the NBA. _But, that didn 't stop me from risking everything for something I believed in._

**My story is ultimately one of healing, perseverance, and redemption.**

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=9b8ec76a32cb46e08a5ec466845210d8&_e=0UcGeeM3M-rcoRmmJ42Sm4TW_mc3fWoQrO5EWnyqke-r4r_voR7hXV48Q0gLUN_b5gYzNlUzTrqn8Qm4Kll3YXDJi79mSF9K2xj5S38sEg3YslH4j3fPayxd6rAMewMu05x--x3iUlAYBP3wdigGu9jMKIftAFjf_s04Tuw7lPwzN_10EnlAkEXnzDJ52PRYAE6BX1cVYEf1khXqilCIrJLrMGSx7-4PUXxYA_txB8Ks9oxlMWFbtNHCL0lp_oQ5bduoRO0IM1YQnX_F_UNZPcC3LheJNbmzLSiINAcwuQIQhXaTOsfvZyNc3nFbTBWnbU8y0Keoc5pQEZsep8wsfA%3D%3D)
At the time, the NBA didn't have any policies to support players' mental health. A grueling 82-game season will weigh on anyone--the best athletes in the world included. As someone who has dealt with an extreme level of anxiety growing up, being thrust onto one of the biggest stages in the world at 21 years old was challenging, to say the least. subject: This is my story and how I escaped China.

body:
America saved my life and now I’m ready to protect it for the next generation.| | | Friend, I should have been another statistic. I was born to illiterate working-class parents in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution. My childhood was full of poverty, food rationing, chaos, and communist indoctrination.

---
[](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=8d05e749c0f747278520a19ff02b1138&_e=aKqk30jJZK_w8qOKC_IR4z5OUK-dlEDeE4JOFDs-257KfJmx4N42YMfg4f7SYurjolzgK9roWmI-NAwq6M8mewJKObPrmZfwpSzmx1NeWa5cZX0nY2uGM4Zkcl1tkKogF4_DAt9pnf7PHQJDIUMyuoyB-qwQ3X9os7Lewngm8OxUdCnoJwx2iRovDKx6d1Zmh0I6Cuoea2xqVYIsWsbhsHSfzYHtiaM7KpLfDaj7L8GOv_jrf_tK2ab0qO7fTh9-ahPHXHIPL3cSAD3_FBseRMr68JNsbjS_Yi89thgFnKdJV2KUKNNO4ya29LR81kDqlXBswQknxqu7VSGA8Ubai4U_ZTJM8p8EkOJaD_dZRzjEQR0N_pWfGza4yVBb68Ug3-wg81D9Sxz5xsHBgld5lg%3D%3D)
---
My family and I lived in a small row house by the river and shared an outhouse with 8 other families. I was brainwashed to be the model communist citizen in schools. I memorized Mao’s words and recited his political slogans as a prayer.
---
[](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=8d05e749c0f747278520a19ff02b1138&_e=aKqk30jJZK_w8qOKC_IR4z5OUK-dlEDeE4JOFDs-257KfJmx4N42YMfg4f7SYurjolzgK9roWmI-NAwq6M8mewJKObPrmZfwpSzmx1NeWa5cZX0nY2uGM4Zkcl1tkKogF4_DAt9pnf7PHQJDIUMyuoyB-qwQ3X9os7Lewngm8OxUdCnoJwx2iRovDKx6d1Zmh0I6Cuoea2xqVYIsWsbhsHSfzYHtiaM7KpLfDaj7L8FccfkuNqPjWUx2XX7zr7YIlZRJtKxG5bYznRa2v4PKMjYaBWSSGdY_8hfCbBmic1mAA9roUNs7AfSg0TjRYkn8GJ9IuZa5gJTy_aiQErBo2_shr0qfi8JnVgeiZkoQg8BVgfA6YDlIi2oQ2u8pWp0nLLUVUiHaQzx5LuW-9CgmqA%3D%3D)
---
After Mao died in 1976, schools and colleges started to reopen, and after 3 years of hard work and dedication, I passed the national entrance exam. I was accepted into a top-tier university to study law. It was during that time I met an American student, and what he showed me forever changed my life – **a pocket-sized U.S. Constitution.** I learned that U.S. citizens have constitutional rights to free speech, free press, freedom to assemble, religious freedom, right to vote and bear arms, etc. Never had I imagined that I, an individual, had rights. Those words shattered my mental shackles, and I started to dream about reaching the land of the free. In 1988, I made it. I arrived in America with $100 in my pocket and a massive smile.
---
[](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=8d05e749c0f747278520a19ff02b1138&_e=aKqk30jJZK_w8qOKC_IR4z5OUK-dlEDeE4JOFDs-257KfJmx4N42YMfg4f7SYurjolzgK9roWmI-NAwq6M8mewJKObPrmZfwpSzmx1NeWa5cZX0nY2uGM4Zkcl1tkKogF4_DAt9pnf7PHQJDIUMyuoyB-qwQ3X9os7Lewngm8OxUdCnoJwx2iRovDKx6d1Zmh0I6Cuoea2xqVYIsWsbhsHSfzYHtiaM7KpLfDaj7L8H1dsTBwp1N4tyxDhhy_FYCFWTEwVJ_6pGEto4BeitHrENsufVhKXGm3cnsetKzpNxxCrIRWwAbnmHpVqq8GwPPW8k0L65T76yfCFcEX0-V4dUB8_5HStxMf8iJ2O2_jv6nF3xqAjs_IOPSVqsLOLgLHmrxTyHh9bIsw38OI2lgYg%3D%3D)
---
In the decades since arriving in this great country, I have earned a graduate degree, got married, raised 3 children, started a business, rid myself of CCP indoctrination, naturalized as a U.S. citizen, and volunteered in my community. But I’ve watched as politicians locked us down, closed small businesses, inflated our money, and mortgaged our children’s future. I have seen it all before in China, the division of society, silencing voices, taking away parental rights, the indoctrination of youth, endless government mandates and control.** ** **[I fear that the country I love is becoming like the country I left, and that’s why I am running for Congress. It is time to start asking questions.](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=8d05e749c0f747278520a19ff02b1138&_e=aKqk30jJZK_w8qOKC_IR4z5OUK-dlEDeE4JOFDs-257KfJmx4N42YMfg4f7SYurjolzgK9roWmI-NAwq6M8mewJKObPrmZfwpSzmx1NeWa5cZX0nY2uGM4Zkcl1tkKogF4_DAt9pnf7PHQJDIUMyuoyB-qwQ3X9os7Lewngm8OxUdCnoJwx2iRovDKx6d1Zmh0I6Cuoea2xqVYIsWsbhsHSfzYHtiaM7KpLfDaj7L8GIdmQyRmJ-wU5Vvyq_vkU_5aWifQiczEhd_swOtqIUWWv81i4ZilXNOMdcOmSyokszDCzX2japj7Ah70Ie1WITdbOpQ1JU2oA7DrHXUJFKCmSanIMQcNU65pj2qX7-1ji-ntQAT4FnJaaMHIxqVsIur7E1mSp5tERlwNZc7HU8qg%3D%3D)** I’m running in a closely watched race as a proud common-sense conservative. This race will decide the control of the House, and right now, Nancy Pelosi’s allies are outspending our campaign.

I’m counting on patriots like you. ](http://links.gopwinning.org/u/click?_t=ea36c899de41479ca8c7218c6a20a10b&_m=8d05e749c0f747278520a19ff02b1138&_e=aKqk30jJZK_w8qOKC_IR4z5OUK-dlEDeE4JOFDs-257KfJmx4N42YMfg4f7SYurjolzgK9roWmI-NAwq6M8mewJKObPrmZfwpSzmx1NeWa5cZX0nY2uGM4Zkcl1tkKogF4_DAt9pnf7PHQJDIUMyuoyB-qwQ3X9os7Lewngm8OxUdCnoJwx2iRovDKx6d1Zmh0I6Cuoea2xqVYIsWsbhsHSfzYHtiaM7KpLfDaj7L8FQ79OQRDWyGIloW1u1STI8SFuNmWAIr0ay2XTdSgxelER2lU1SCeaK4eb4-xP7ZLfgfKwFGTbCcy24am-yYOA3ERg0P3S2rSM9ACD3x2qtK6_yyqoqGYiCIomn2okasSxDBcr31FJU1yXV0XnMEc_fAq6KNZg08Z1X-sNKhpa_7A%3D%3D)**

Peter, As the Director of Political and Campaigns here at NDRC, I feel lucky to learn about, and work with, so many unbelievable leaders who have stepped up to defend our democracy as candidates. Today, we’re launching our “Adopt a State” program that will allow _**you**_ to take a closer look at one (or more!) of our priority states in this 2024 election. When you adopt a state to focus on, you’ll receive important updates from our priority races in that state. (And, if you pair your pick with a donation today, you’ll get a custom background for your phone and to share with friends — all while supporting Democracy Defenders across the country.) In 2024, we are broadly working to 1) elect Democratic candidates for governor and state legislatures; 2) combat partisan efforts to reduce the independence of State Supreme Courts and support fair-minded State Supreme Court justices; and 3) enact redistricting reform ballot measures and defend against anti-Democratic initiatives. [**Take a closer look at our 2024 priority states below, and when you’re ready, click here to adopt a state to focus on.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028500/499130439/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **ARIZONA**
In Arizona, we’re focused on the state legislature. Right now, Republicans hold just a _two-seat majority_ in both the state House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process. We are so close. [**[Join Team Arizona]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028501/499130440/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **GEORGIA**
We’re supporting the Georgia House of Representatives, Peter, where MAGA Republicans have enacted extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. We’ve endorsed _twenty-seven_ state legislature candidates as Democracy Defenders. There are so many extraordinary candidates for you to learn more about. [**[Join Team Georgia]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028502/499130441/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **MICHIGAN**
You’ve heard about this recently from our team — the Supreme Court race here is incredibly important. The Republicans nominated an extreme MAGA Republican for one of the seats. He perpetuates the “Big Lie” and actually attended a “Stop the Steal” rally at the Michigan State Capitol on January 6, 2021. Luckily there are two phenomenal candidates who’ve stepped up to preserve our fundamental rights. We’ve endorsed Justice Kyra Harris Bolden and Kimberly Ann Thomas as Democracy Defenders — two tested, proven legal professionals who are pro-democracy, pro-voting rights, and pro-freedom. [**[Join Team Michigan]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028503/499130442/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **MINNESOTA**
In 2022, _just 321 votes_ flipped control of the State Senate to a one-seat Democratic majority and created a blue trifecta with the State House and governorship. While Democrats have the majority in the legislature right now, the Minnesota State House is on the line this November. The legislature here has been able to make great gains on paid and medical leave, workplace protections, voting rights, gun safety and more — we need to make sure pro-democracy leaders stay in office. [**[Join Team Minnesota]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028504/499130443/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **MONTANA**
Two of the seven Montana Supreme Court seats are up in November. The state’s highest court has been pushing back on unconstitutional laws — so conservatives are aggressively working to secure these seats. But with State Supreme Courts being asked to rule on abortion, gerrymandering, voting rights, and climate change, it’s critically important that we help elect justices who will protect our fundamental rights. [**[Join Team Montana]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028505/499130444/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **NEW HAMPSHIRE**
In New Hampshire, we’re watching the state legislature _as well as_ the Governor’s race. Right now Republicans hold both the Senate and the House — but they have to defend tiny majorities. _The House is considered a toss-up_ and the Senate is within reach. Mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. And New Hampshire is the one state in New England that does not have abortion protections on the books. We’ve got to elect leaders who will help enshrine and protect our freedoms. [**[Join Team New Hampshire]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028506/499130445/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **NORTH CAROLINA**
We endorsed Justice Allison Riggs for the North Carolina Supreme Court because she has proven to be a fair-minded and independent voice on the court. She is a tenacious civil rights attorney who has been a champion of every American’s fundamental rights, including voting rights. Her opponent, Jefferson Griffith, has already shown he would push the North Carolina Supreme Court even further to the extreme and supports _egregious_ gerrymanders. He joined a deeply controversial ruling that would have established a precedent for so-called personhood laws in North Carolina, which have resulted in restrictions to abortion access and IVF bans in other states. North Carolinians deserve a leader like Justice Allison Riggs to defend their freedoms. [**[Join Team North Carolina]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028507/499130446/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **OHIO**
There’s a lot at stake in Ohio this year. In July, we endorsed three Supreme Court candidates as Democracy Defenders. Justice Michael P. Donnelly, Justice Melody Stewart, and Judge Lisa Forbes are fair maps champions who will protect fundamental rights, adhere to legal and judicial norms, and uphold the rule of law for all Ohioans. [**[Join Team Ohio]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028508/499130447/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **PENNSYLVANIA**
The Pennsylvania legislature is another _huge_ opportunity. It’s currently the _only_ state in the country with a divided legislature (where Democrats hold one legislative chamber and Republicans hold the other), after Democrats flipped the House in 2022. Earlier this year, States United Action reported that nearly _1 in 3 members of the Pennsylvania House are election deniers_. And when the brave first responders who defended our capitol on January 6th visited the Pennsylvania House, several Republicans _booed and walked out_. Pennsylvanians deserve better than that. We’ve endorsed _thirty-three_ state legislative candidates as Democracy Defenders — if we flip the Senate AND hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform. [**[Join Team Pennsylvania]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028509/499130448/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **TEXAS**
In Texas, State Supreme Court justices are elected in partisan elections. Right now, all nine of them are Republicans — Democrats haven’t been elected to the court since the late 1990s. We’ve got to gain some ground here ahead of the next redistricting fight, and there are three court seats up. It’s going to be a tough road, but we can do it with your support. [**[Join Team Texas]**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93028510/499130449/-1581702089?source=don_ndrc_tier1_email_PriorityStates_email_20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240917-NDRC-Tier1-PriorityStates_&utm_campaign=PriorityStates&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU4MjEwYTMwLTU1NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=d_A4Mm5RLUBPtflQ8yFlIkWNil6jhn1b-x95A1eBU6s=&emci=9465b7aa-3475-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e8210a30-5575-ef11-991a-6045bda8aae9&ceid=8431045) **WISCONSIN**
Earlier this year, this movement won fair maps for Wisconsin. The Republican-drawn, gerrymandered legislative maps were struck down in court. Now we have a chance to elect a legislature that reflects the will of the people. For decades, Wisconsin has seen some of the most brazen attempts to manipulate maps for Republicans who have been desperate to hold on to power in the legislature. clean_body: When you adopt a state to focus on, you’ll receive important updates about the priority races in that state — all while supporting Democracy Defenders across the country | Peter, As the Director of Political and Campaigns here at NDRC, I feel lucky to learn about, and work with, so many unbelievable leaders who have stepped up to defend our democracy as candidates. Today, we’re launching our “Adopt a State” program that will allow you to take a closer look at one (or more!) of our priority states in this 2024 election. When you adopt a state to focus on, you’ll receive important updates from our priority races in that state. (And, if you pair your pick with a donation today, you’ll get a custom background for your phone and to share with friends — all while supporting Democracy Defenders across the country.) In 2024, we are broadly working to 1) elect Democratic candidates for governor and state legislatures; 2) combat partisan efforts to reduce the independence of State Supreme Courts and support fair-minded State Supreme Court justices; and 3) enact redistricting reform ballot measures and defend against anti-Democratic initiatives. ARIZONA In Arizona, we’re focused on the state legislature. Right now, Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in both the state House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can strengthen the state’s redistricting process. We are so close. [[Join Team Arizona]]() GEORGIA We’re supporting the Georgia House of Representatives, Peter, where MAGA Republicans have enacted extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. We’ve endorsed twenty-seven state legislature candidates as Democracy Defenders. There are so many extraordinary candidates for you to learn more about. [[Join Team Georgia]]() MICHIGAN You’ve heard about this recently from our team — the Supreme Court race here is incredibly important. The Republicans nominated an extreme MAGA Republican for one of the seats. He perpetuates the “Big Lie” and actually attended a “Stop the Steal” rally at the Michigan State Capitol on January 6, 2021. Luckily there are two phenomenal candidates who’ve stepped up to preserve our fundamental rights. We’ve endorsed Justice Kyra Harris Bolden and Kimberly Ann Thomas as Democracy Defenders — two tested, proven legal professionals who are pro-democracy, pro-voting rights, and pro-freedom. [[Join Team Michigan]]() MINNESOTA In 2022, just 321 votes flipped control of the State Senate to a one-seat Democratic majority and created a blue trifecta with the State House and governorship. While Democrats have the majority in the legislature right now, the Minnesota State House is on the line this November. The legislature here has been able to make great gains on paid and medical leave, workplace protections, voting rights, gun safety and more — we need to make sure pro-democracy leaders stay in office. [[Join Team Minnesota]]() MONTANA Two of the seven Montana Supreme Court seats are up in November. The state’s highest court has been pushing back on unconstitutional laws — so conservatives are aggressively working to secure these seats. But with State Supreme Courts being asked to rule on abortion, gerrymandering, voting rights, and climate change, it’s critically important that we help elect justices who will protect our fundamental rights. [[Join Team Montana]]() NEW HAMPSHIRE In New Hampshire, we’re watching the state legislature as well as the Governor’s race. Right now Republicans hold both the Senate and the House — but they have to defend tiny majorities. The House is considered a toss-up and the Senate is within reach. Mid-cycle congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, so the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. And New Hampshire is the one state in New England that does not have abortion protections on the books. We’ve got to elect leaders who will help enshrine and protect our freedoms. [[Join Team New Hampshire]]() NORTH CAROLINA We endorsed Justice Allison Riggs for the North Carolina Supreme Court because she has proven to be a fair-minded and independent voice on the court. She is a tenacious civil rights attorney who has been a champion of every American’s fundamental rights, including voting rights. Her opponent, Jefferson Griffith, has already shown he would push the North Carolina Supreme Court even further to the extreme and supports egregious gerrymanders. He joined a deeply controversial ruling that would have established a precedent for so-called personhood laws in North Carolina, which have resulted in restrictions to abortion access and IVF bans in other states. North Carolinians deserve a leader like Justice Allison Riggs to defend their freedoms. [[Join Team North Carolina]]() OHIO There’s a lot at stake in Ohio this year. In July, we endorsed three Supreme Court candidates as Democracy Defenders. Justice Michael P. Donnelly, Justice Melody Stewart, and Judge Lisa Forbes are fair maps champions who will protect fundamental rights, adhere to legal and judicial norms, and uphold the rule of law for all Ohioans. [[Join Team Ohio]]() PENNSYLVANIA The Pennsylvania legislature is another huge opportunity. It’s currently the only state in the country with a divided legislature (where Democrats hold one legislative chamber and Republicans hold the other), after Democrats flipped the House in 2022. Earlier this year, States United Action reported that nearly 1 in 3 members of the Pennsylvania House are election deniers. And when the brave first responders who defended our capitol on January 6th visited the Pennsylvania House, several Republicans booed and walked out. Pennsylvanians deserve better than that. We’ve endorsed thirty-three state legislative candidates as Democracy Defenders — if we flip the Senate AND hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform. [[Join Team Pennsylvania]]() TEXAS In Texas, State Supreme Court justices are elected in partisan elections. Right now, all nine of them are Republicans — Democrats haven’t been elected to the court since the late 1990s. We’ve got to gain some ground here ahead of the next redistricting fight, and there are three court seats up. It’s going to be a tough road, but we can do it with your support. [[Join Team Texas]]() WISCONSIN Earlier this year, this movement won fair maps for Wisconsin. The Republican-drawn, gerrymandered legislative maps were struck down in court. Now we have a chance to elect a legislature that reflects the will of the people. subject: What this race is really about

body:
Team, in a moment, I'm going to share why I'm running for Congress, but first I am asking: Can you chip in $5 or more to help me flip this critical seat blue? Oregon is my home. According to Merriam-Webster, a patriot is simply one who "loves and supports" their country.

To me, a real patriot acts selflessly to benefit their entire community, regardless of race, national origin, who they vote for, or who they love.
A patriot should ensure everyone has access to crucial goods and services — not enrich themselves off the funds meant to help working families access quality health care and our elders retire with dignity.
A patriot should fight for the workers in their community to build a better life for themselves and their families — not roll back their right to demand better wages and working conditions from profit-obsessed employers.
A patriot should protect the beauty, biodiversity, and resilience of their local environment — not dismantle conservation and public health measures that protect nature and neighborhoods from the worst impacts of climate change.
A patriot should trust their community to make the best choices for their own bodies and futures — not revoke their right to do so.
**To me, Rick Scott, his policies, and his party embody the _exact opposite_ of what a patriot is supposed to be.**
That's why I'm running to unseat him: **because all Floridians, and all Americans, deserve a senator who will love, support, and fight for them, no matter who they are or which party they endorse. **
But against the fraudulent personal fortune he uses to fund his campaign, I can't follow through without the help of patriots like you who make up this movement to reach my**$150,000 goal** before the clock strikes midnight.

OK – let’s talk about this.
We’re just over two weeks into September, and I’m willing to bet that your inbox has already seen more emails this month than in recent memory.
“But the election is still seven weeks away! Why are you guys emailing me so much, Sara??”
Here’s the thing: The election isn’t actually seven weeks away. Election Day may be November 5th, but tens of millions of people will vote well before then, in person or by mail.
In several states, early voting starts as soon as this week (and here in California, ballots will be mailed in just 21 days!). Meaning Democrats are currently in one of the most critical moments of the entire election cycle for reaching undecided voters and getting our message out.
And it’s not just that the election is closer than any of us realize, it’s also that at the end of September, every single federal campaign is facing our final quarterly FEC report of the election – which means that every dollar we can bring in between now and September 30th matters A LOT.
All of that is to say – the resources we raise right now have an outsized impact on the outcome of this year’s elections. So if you have the ability to make a contribution today, I’d really appreciate it. Your donations help me secure not only my own re-election but also support my fellow Democrats running in tough races. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

body:
| Folks, I’ve faced my fair share of challenges, but when the going gets tough, I remind myself of what my parents taught me. **To fight for what’s right, no matter the challenge.**

[I’m now facing one of the toughest fights of my life, and I need your support. Will you chip in $10 now to my campaign and Voter Protection Project? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78578?t=6&akid=16913%2E878179%2E4CF6uq) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78578?t=7&akid=16913%2E878179%2E4CF6uq) My parents led by example. My mom was active in our community and founded and operated a Spanish language school. My dad was a civil rights lawyer who helped found North Carolina’s first integrated law firm. He and his partners never backed down, not even when someone firebombed their office and burned it to the ground.

They continued to fight and win landmark cases that helped fight discrimination, protect voting rights, and so much more.

My mom and dad’s dedication to serving others is one of the reasons why I’ve dedicated my career to fighting for North Carolina. From working as a consumer protection lawyer to serving as Attorney General, I’ve been honored to take on big fights for the people of North Carolina – and win.

[At the end of the day, I’m running for Governor because, just like my parents, I believe that the fight for North Carolina’s future is worth it. If you’re with me, please chip in a split donation between my campaign and Voter Protection Project now.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78578?t=8&akid=16913%2E878179%2E4CF6uq) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Stein and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/78579?t=9&akid=16913%2E878179%2E4CF6uq)

# **NICK BEGICH RECEIVES ENDORSEMENT FROM PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP**
---
|
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
September 17, 2024

Website: [www.alaskansfornickbegich.com](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=8b1a41d56d&e=6679001ba0)
**NICK BEGICH RECEIVES ENDORSEMENT FROM PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP**

**Anchorage, Alaska — Nick Begich** is proud to announce his heartfelt acceptance of the endorsement from former President Donald J. Trump for his candidacy for Alaska's sole seat in the U.S. House of Representatives. As a champion of conservative values and a staunch advocate for Alaskan development, Nick is eager to continue building on the momentum established during the Trump administration.

_“There is a clear difference among the choices for President in this election. Only one presidential candidate has a pro-Alaska agenda and a record of supporting Alaskan resource development – that's Donald J. Trump. His strong record in Alaska is one of the many reasons why I was proud to endorse him in December.”_ **Nick Begich** said.

_“Some candidates in this race don't want to tell Alaskans who they support for President – but Alaskans deserve transparency from their representative in Congress. We deserve to know whether they'll align with those with a pro-Alaska agenda or with those who want to lock our state down. From opening up vital energy resources, streamlining infrastructure development, and supporting our critical industries, Trump’s America First policies delivered tangible benefits to our great state. I am deeply honored to have his support in this crucial race."_

Under Trump’s presidency, Alaska saw crucial pro-growth policies, including the expansion of oil and gas exploration, reduced federal overreach in land management, and a strong push for job creation within the state's natural resource sectors. These initiatives helped lay the groundwork for a thriving Alaskan economy, positioning the state as a leader in energy independence and economic growth.

In his endorsement, **President Trump** stated:

> “America First Patriot Nick Begich won a primary against a Strong and Respected Candidate in Alaska, a State I love and won by large margins in 2016 and 2020. That Candidate has now withdrawn in favor of Nick, so this time, for the first time in years, we will have a REPUBLICAN against a Democrat - The Republican, Nick Begich, is outstanding, and he will win!
>
> Nick will be an INCREDIBLE Fighter in Congress, and will work closely with me to enact MAGA policies. As a very successful Small Businessman, Nick knows how to Fight Inflation, Grow the Economy, Lower Taxes, and Eliminate Government Waste. In Congress, Nick will fight tirelessly to Secure our Border, Stop Migrant Crime, Champion American Energy Independence, Strengthen our Incredible Military/Vets, and Defend our always under siege Second Amendment. **Nick Begich has my Complete and Total Endorsement – HE WILL NOT LET YOU DOWN!”**

Nick looks forward to working with President Trump in his next administration to further develop Alaska's potential, from bolstering the state's economic base to advancing opportunities for its people. With shared values and a vision of an Alaska that stands strong and prosperous, Nick's candidacy represents a continued commitment to the state's future.
###
_Nick Begich is the leading Republican candidate for Alaska’s at-large seat in the U. S. Congress. For more information about Nick Begich's campaign or to get involved, please visit alaskansfornickbegich.com or contact Josh Walton at (907) 227-5785._

**Kamala Harris: Could She Be The New Threat to Your Wealth?** Many Americans believed that Joe Biden’s presidency was a low point for the nation, with increasing taxes, rising inflation, and a faltering economy. However, the prospect of **Kamala Harris taking the reins has left many questioning if things could get even worse**. For the middle class, retirees, and anyone invested in 401Ks, Harris' policies may pose an even greater risk to financial stability.

**The Threat to Middle-Class Wealth and Retirement**

Kamala Harris' tax plan has been a point of concern for many. If implemented, it could significantly impact middle-class Americans, particularly those who are relying on their 401Ks and retirement savings. Harris has proposed higher taxes on wealth, which would hit not only the rich but also those who have diligently saved for retirement. The increase in taxes could mean that the[ **hard-earned savings of millions of Americans will be eroded** ,](http://track.gunpowdermag.org/?xtl=o3bliggjyxo5nt7s6k9l42xy2ljyzlvxuhk3r7f54btg0g1fol0ypxzwugbz7ncpewh44c3llvszjzctt0syw3e84a8zmzc77cay7ydm2w3ccmlg1py5opa4nqj1l79383zhcmf47xk0cpk4ivw1yvlq5xdlep1i21txvtixl850p3xwc4cg9rfivsqcitnr5gmj7xo5ud6n6sdkyj6rlw28y8nxs7jj3zfcs2fstvpdgz7ovdi06oc0mbzf2kemerx6o1244zk&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sjzn6g&__onlt=h) leaving them with less money to live on in their retirement years. Moreover, Harris' proposal to tax **unrealized gains raises significant concerns for investors and the broader economy.** By taxing gains that have not yet been realized, the policy could force individuals to pay taxes on investments that might decrease in value the following year, potentially resulting in financial strain if the market turns bearish. This could devastate retirees who rely on their 401Ks, as they might be forced to liquidate assets prematurely to cover these taxes,[**significantly reducing their retirement nest egg.**](http://track.gunpowdermag.org/?xtl=o3bliggjyxo5nt7s6k9l42xy2ljyzlvxujrf9n5nn07b93hmdh1dlizarl3utmqdo4y9ysc0zigvyw7oz4gvm8a7sp9qmffr9s1vfc1ksi1aysksh0luapaoofxzkl74oj7az3fvxp7whm8bhjbnmcqfguikwchwo8xvc7dnry14na236k5h1ugv70x2pwt6ck64jbur012ln48o0i8z7nrfrptyr1fdjgw9nlhdg37dvzrtk2t7zkt07k06n8dpd6j4qqxnmr3&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sjzn6g&__onlt=h)

Additionally, Harris's plan to increase the corporate **tax rate could prompt businesses to offset higher taxes by cutting costs,** often through layoffs, which could lead to higher unemployment. Under Harris’s potential presidency, the dollar is likely to face significant pressure. The Fed is already torn between keeping interest rates high, which could lead to bank failures and increased unemployment, or cutting interest rates, which would fuel inflation and further weaken the dollar. After Trump singled out Nevada as the one Senate race he took the time to mention during the RNC – calling me “not respected” and a “lightweight” – I knew he wouldn’t hold back. But, friends, I didn’t expect him to stoop so low.
**Donald Trump has resorted to schoolyard taunts in his desperate attempt to flip Nevada red and pave the way for a total Republican takeover. It’s one thing for him to lie about my record, but Trump is now mocking me directly, bringing back his favorite nickname for me – “ Wacky Jacky.” 🙄**
Trump and his MAGA allies are attacking me at every chance they can get – and it’s no surprise why: **they know that Nevada’s Senate race is the one thing standing in the way of their Republican Senate majority**. Experts report that I’m the most vulnerable woman in the Senate, so the GOP and their outside groups are spending tens of millions of dollars to unseat me.
[That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask committed grassroots supporters like you to split a donation between my campaign and the NV Dems to help me fight back against Trump and my far-right opponents’ attacks. name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Take our Critical Race Theory Survey
body:
I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zedq8vp0fomntsbs6r1bo8sie3793h78c3ho6q6g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdgm6ob6c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zd6kalejo31ul6cvh5o09e6upblh5spmg80jnnc0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdgm6ob6c3h2bs)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zlg4unjoh6n8r0a44f2t421eb0sv55s7njg3l6vg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdgm6ob6c3h2bs)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College
---

---

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: it all begins today . . .
body:
In Pennsylvania, early voting is already under way...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

“Election Day” is here!

No, it’s not Tuesday, November 5th.

But early voting is already underway as of today in the swing state of Pennsylvania.

Which means our window to make an impact before the election is over is closing fast!

I need to make sure our 2024 Election Year Programs are running at full steam – especially our canvassing program, which we’ve found is the most effective way to convert pro-abortion/on-the-fence voters into PRO-LIFE FIRST voters!

But in order to keep our canvassers knocking on doors through Election Day, I’ll need to count on the generosity of pro-lifers like you.

**[So, will you please make your most generous contribution possible to _Students for Life Action_ right away to help me make sure pro-lifers come out on top in November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gikhre-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, _Students for Life Action_ has an army of door-to-door canvassers – _largely comprised of young college and high school students._

These young people put in long, hard days knocking on doors, educating voters, converting them into Pro-Life First voters, and sometimes are even attacked by pro-abortion radicals whom they encounter.[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gikhre-duchtdja-j/)

I’d like to introduce you to one of our volunteers – _Michael Merchant._

Michael is currently a senior at the _University of Missouri – St. Louis_ where he’s majoring in Computer Science.

Michael said he’s in the Pro-Life Movement because abortion hurt his family, and he told us he just couldn’t stand by silently as women are lied to every day about abortion being their only option.

But standing up for what’s right hasn’t always been easy for Michael. He told us:

_“Few people know how painful it is to be pro-life and stand alone. Not a single person in my life was pro-life, including my parents, siblings, and friends. I was hesitant to bring it up my entire life. I searched for a pro-life community, and I found Students for Life! You have no idea how happy I was to find a group of pro-life friends like you all. You are my family now. This couldn’t have been more impactful for me.”_
The truth is, we have so many young people just like Michael who are helping us knock on doors this fall.

Michael and others are only able to do the work they do because they know they have the support of good folks like you – **[folks who will cover their travel costs, pay for new election materials, and even buy them lunch during a long day of door knocking](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gikhre-duchtdja-t/).**

**[Will you consider helping Michael in any of these ways so he can continue making an impact](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gikhre-duchtdja-i/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, passionate young people like Michael, who take time out of their busy college schedule to work with _Students for Life Action_ as canvassers are one of our secret weapons – _especially with how successful they are!_

You see, though the 2022 Midterms didn’t help the GOP much on Capitol Hill – _mostly due to a lack of resources and weak-kneed Republicans running away from the abortion issue_ – it wasn’t all bad news.

Not only did we learn which Republicans we could trust to run on a Pro-Life Platform _(and which were traitors whom we’d need to hammer in their next primary),_ and were honored to educate voters to see dozens of key victories that turned state legislatures more pro-life... but we also collected some incredible data.

In Battleground States, such as Ohio, we found that we could convert ONE pro-abortion/on-the-fence youth voter for just $12!

That means the only thing stopping the Pro-Life Movement from sweeping Battleground States isn’t a lack of manpower – _as you know we have plenty of that._

It’s a lack of resources.

Canvassers like Michael can only make an impact if they can afford to go on deployments to Battleground States, have the materials they need to succeed, and are taken care of while on the road.

That’s where you come in, Pro-Life Friend – **[even if it’s only $12, $24, $60, or $120 to covert ONE, TWO, FIVE, or TEN Pro-Life First Voters](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gikhre-duchtdja-d/).**

**[With a deal like that, I’m calling on YOU and other pro-lifers like you to chip into the fight right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gikhre-duchtdja-h/)!**

Michael and our other canvassers are counting on you!

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

Michael said he’s in the Pro-Life Movement because abortion hurt his family, and he told us he just couldn’t stand by silently as women are lied to every day about abortion being their only option. But standing up for what’s right hasn’t always been easy for Michael. He told us: “Few people know how painful it is to be pro-life and stand alone. Not a single person in my life was pro-life, including my parents, siblings, and friends. I was hesitant to bring it up my entire life. I searched for a pro-life community, and I found Students for Life! You have no idea how happy I was to find a group of pro-life friends like you all. You are my family now. This couldn’t have been more impactful for me.” The truth is, we have so many young people just like Michael who are helping us knock on doors this fall. Michael and others are only able to do the work they do because they know they have the support of good folks like you – . ? Pro-Life Friend, passionate young people like Michael, who take time out of their busy college schedule to work with Students for Life Action as canvassers are one of our secret weapons – especially with how successful they are! You see, though the 2022 Midterms didn’t help the GOP much on Capitol Hill – mostly due to a lack of resources and weak-kneed Republicans running away from the abortion issue – it wasn’t all bad news. Not only did we learn which Republicans we could trust to run on a Pro-Life Platform (and which were traitors whom we’d need to hammer in their next primary), and were honored to educate voters to see dozens of key victories that turned state legislatures more pro-life... but we also collected some incredible data. In Battleground States, such as Ohio, we found that we could convert ONE pro-abortion/on-the-fence youth voter for just $12! That means the only thing stopping the Pro-Life Movement from sweeping Battleground States isn’t a lack of manpower – as you know we have plenty of that. It’s a lack of resources. Canvassers like Michael can only make an impact if they can afford to go on deployments to Battleground States, have the materials they need to succeed, and are taken care of while on the road. That’s where you come in, Pro-Life Friend – . ! Michael and our other canvassers are counting on you! Thank you for everything you do for Life. For Life, Kristan Hawkins President, Students for Life Action Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

name: Steve Garvey
subject: Pray for me and my election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
Dear Fellow Patriot,

I just wanted to say _**[thank you](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zp37vgpni5fgdk1tr9c40aedl9247ehfajvo1ag0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdimcor6c9h2bs)**_ - thank you for opening this email.

. . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now.

And more importantly, I know that you are busy with a life of your own, a family of your own, and daily trials and joys of your own.

So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me.

**[Can I count on you to stick with me through November?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1msrqfjtc4m7ubgt3jklqro3a9b32uiqjao11r8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdimcor6c9h2bs)**

Fellow Patriot, I hope you'll **[join my campaign team today](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z8hhqjbll91vt6uoe1pca7pcmppbueg4qicqmt00_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdimcor6c9h2bs)** and stay up to date through Election Day. We have less than 3 months to go, and so much is at stake.

If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring commonsense leadership to our country's most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is _**[pray for me and my election.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5nop6vu4esscmtu3nkt0fm0lecneh7hmipfn500_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdimcor6c9h2bs)**_

And friend, in addition to your prayers, if you're able, **[a small contribution to my campaign](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfn6chhh1kkdrgut32l6bbdfcim8fnfou9h1qnh0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdimcor6c9h2bs)** goes a long way towards helping me fight against Adam Schiff and the Democrat machine backing his campaign.

Because the last thing the Democrats want to see is support from hundreds of individual American patriots donating to my campaign and dreaming of a new Conservative California.

So, I'm glad this email reached you, and I hope I can count on your support to defeat Adam Schiff in November.

Thank you for your support.

Let's win this together,
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2iratftunjae1trvp9nequgig4rilivks0agp30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cdimcor6c9h2bs)
Steve Garvey

subject: Universal School Choice: Empowering Parents to Cut the Chains of Government
body:
Government education spending and school property taxes are out of control.
No images? [Click here](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-e-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-x/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-r/) **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Press Manager
Contact: [Press@HuffinesLiberty.com](mailto:Press@HuffinesLiberty.com)
## **Universal School Choice: Empowering Parents to Cut the Chains of Government**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, September 17, 2024 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation is releasing our latest solutions paper, _[Universal School Choice: Empowering Parents to Cut the Chains of Government](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-j/)_.**The Problem**
Government education spending and school property taxes are out of control. From 2012 to 2022, spending on Texas government schools [increased by 73% ($32.3 billion)](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-t/); this reflects a 22% increase per student adjusted for inflation. School property taxes increased even faster, up 91% ($20.9 billion) over that period. At the same time, less than half of Texas government school students exhibited grade-level proficiency in English, math, science, and social studies. Most Texas children are trapped in these failing schools and have little hope of finding better options. School choice would bring competition to Texas K-12 education and empower parents to send their children to better-performing schools. This competition would also increase the quality of currently poor-performing government schools.Three times in 2023, a majority of the Texas Legislature opposed efforts to provide parents with greater opportunity to get their children out of Texas' high-cost, low-performing government schools.Not only did the Legislature fail, but the plans they came up with put billions more of taxpayer dollars into public education than they did into school choice. The massive increase in government education funding included in these bills was a failed attempt to court the support of Legislators controlled by the government school monopoly. Because Texas politicians must answer to voters, not to school boards and education unions, almost all of the Republicans who voted against school choice will not be returning to Austin in 2024.**The Solution**
For school choice to be effective at cutting the chains of government, it must meet three key criteria:_School Choice Should Empower Parents_
Education Savings Accounts should put consumers--parents--in charge of their children's education. Parents should be able to tailor educational services to their child's unique needs by selecting from one or more of a variety of services such as government schools, private schools, virtual (online) education, tutoring, special education, or homeschooling._School Choice Should be Universal_
All Texas children should be eligible to participate in school choice programs. The plans last year were touted as "universal," but this was not true. The funding and other elements greatly restricted how many students would have been able to participate. Every student is as valuable as the next. All of them should have access to school choice so they can escape failing government schools and government indoctrination._School Choice Should Foster Competition and Reduce the Cost of Education_
Competition increases quality and lowers the price of everything it touches. The 2023 school choice legislative proposals greatly increased the cost of education even though the $10,000 per student funding for school choice was much less than the $17,966 per student cost of Texas government schools. This was because the legislation included large funding increases for government schools and allowed most school districts to keep their funding even if they lost students. School districts should not be compensated for students they are not educating. A universal school choice plan adopted by the Texas Legislature should save taxpayers money. [Read / Share Solutions Paper](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-i/) [**WATCH --Don Huffines on the importance of bringing competition to Texas education:**](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-h/) [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-k/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, non-partisan research institute. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.### [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-u/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-o/)[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-b/) | [](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-n/) | [ Share ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-fb-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-c/) | [ Tweet ](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-tw-sfhuuy-yuddtktydi-v/) | [ Forward ](https://huffineslibertyfoundation.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-yuddtktydi-17329976-sfhuuy-l-e)

subject: Pray for me and my election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
Dear Fellow Patriot,

I just wanted to say _**[thank you](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Qb9_btRQ93-7VVFRrojnBg~~/AARclAA~/RgRozRLGP0T6aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL2ZpZ2h0LWZvci10aGUtZnV0dXJlLXNnLXBhcy8_~~)**_ - thank you for opening this email.

. . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now.

And more importantly, I know that you are busy with a life of your own, a family of your own, and daily trials and joys of your own.

So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me.

**[Can I count on you to stick with me through November?](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Qb9_btRQ93-7VVFRrojnBg~~/AARclAA~/RgRozRLGP0T6aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL2ZpZ2h0LWZvci10aGUtZnV0dXJlLXNnLXBhcy8_~~)**

Fellow Patriot, I hope you'll **[join my campaign team today](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Qb9_btRQ93-7VVFRrojnBg~~/AARclAA~/RgRozRLGP0T6aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL2ZpZ2h0LWZvci10aGUtZnV0dXJlLXNnLXBhcy8_~~)** and stay up to date through Election Day. We have less than 3 months to go, and so much is at stake.

If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring commonsense leadership to our country's most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is _**[pray for me and my election.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Qb9_btRQ93-7VVFRrojnBg~~/AARclAA~/RgRozRLGP0T6aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL2ZpZ2h0LWZvci10aGUtZnV0dXJlLXNnLXBhcy8_~~)**_

And friend, in addition to your prayers, if you're able, **[a small contribution to my campaign](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Qb9_btRQ93-7VVFRrojnBg~~/AARclAA~/RgRozRLGP0T6aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL2ZpZ2h0LWZvci10aGUtZnV0dXJlLXNnLXBhcy8_~~)** goes a long way towards helping me fight against Adam Schiff and the Democrat machine backing his campaign.

Because the last thing the Democrats want to see is support from hundreds of individual American patriots donating to my campaign and dreaming of a new Conservative California.

So, I'm glad this email reached you, and I hope I can count on your support to defeat Adam Schiff in November.

Thank you for your support.

Let's win this together,
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Qb9_btRQ93-7VVFRrojnBg~~/AARclAA~/RgRozRLGP0T6aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL2ZpZ2h0LWZvci10aGUtZnV0dXJlLXNnLXBhcy8_~~)
Steve Garvey

name: Kelsey Grammer
subject: A personal request
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
New Jersey and the United States Senate need Curtis Bashaw.

Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state. And I love this country.

I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him,**[join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate. >>](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9zg0fPxRAriS-9rl27vlZg~~/AARclAA~~~)**

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn't always easy but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me. After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so called "community" was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: Hatred and Racism. Pathetic.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore. We can look to him to promote prosperity for all--a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States.

There comes a time when we have to speak out in support of our nation's traditional values. For Patriotism. For the right to pursue happiness on our own terms.

We need a remedy for what Washington has been doing.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy, or at least a good part of it.

**[Please, join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.>>](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9zg0fPxRAriS-9rl27vlZg~~/AARclAA~~~)**

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/9zg0fPxRAriS-9rl27vlZg~~/AARclAA~~~)
Kelsey Grammer

---
| MassGOP Blasts Mayor Wu's Mismanagement Amid Widespread Boston School Bus Delays
---
---
| Boston, MA- Boston Public Schools' bus operation is off to a troubling start, with 40% of buses failing to depart or arrive at school on time. When questioned about the delays, Mayor Wu blamed them on a newly implemented bus tracking app and an "unprecedented wave of new registrations right as school was starting." This is yet another instance of the Mayor deflecting responsibility and shifting blame while students are left waiting for hours for buses to pick them up and bring them home.
The delays don't seem to concern the Wu Administration, particularly Boston Public Schools' press secretary, Max Baker, whose tone remains deeply unserious. In an email to BPS at the beginning of the school year, as reported in the Herald, he sent an email out to colleagues stating, "I was thinking about all the days I would be sitting by the beach, wearing shorts all day, drinking mai tais... And while I'm mourning the loss of my carefree fruity rum drinks (I'm switching back to martinis because they really take the edge off), I can think of 500 people who are absolutely stoked to be back in school." We're confident that the parents who waited hours for their children to return home were far from "stoked."
MassGOP Chairwoman, Amy Carnevale, commented on the delays stating, "There is no excuse for bus delays, especially after an entire summer to prepare for this fundamental responsibility of the school system. There is no excuse for the ridiculous demeanor of the BPS press secretary. Working parents must be able to count on the schools to bring their children home on time, as even an hour's delay can disrupt work schedules, with potentially severe consequences for their families. There's nothing funny or cute about being preposterously unprepared for the school year. These delays are absolutely unacceptable, and Mayor Wu's inadequate response coupled with BPS's spokesperson's frivolous attitude towards his job shows a blatant disregard for the needs of Boston's families."
###

Dear Fellow Patriot,

I just wanted to say _**[thank you](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f04eb5ff4a7a4af19e5d6b493a3151c3&_e=nYMd2SU2gVwzsTX7ftTYQHeayWteFCxkXzr5m2ti1g8AaLizFdhQ7DT7YA1bbnr7NLGaSiRjPTurh-te8LS5zsR-U-gIXqkv1rXP4YaFgkpUq31JGTtRbmWsNoF89nVKF5nU6aR2C8mVCesKE8dmr23jmm72YOEPplrKXpV7LQrzQynShsb939lvZc6rngfPSzseeVK6wZScFGf9MdtnYHmW9EoXNRmdb5mstrBCpCZHIoysQ_d7f3isNZgHKDG9zijY1Bf5-rR3JZE9Mi1yinJvShSaRbOUa2eLh4uKYbavwsx3zNvsDTPYNRl4HhkiI9HB6lyk9oowHa06iVLD__i-JEha8V3vaGRPktCcZpJNPD9UhECF86YOpWyXiMDodiU5647O0VnOQpPY6LJJfHAWuAq0KvvSOiogyAFLGM1RCepSxiaEIyRf1meIqmw-VS5Czh1lEZGPtlPvLxkDDSKRfbV_xXeTSoleATg46sKDi_3VnnfWbL_JkBuy0zv3)**_ - thank you for opening this email.

. . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now.

body:
Dear Fellow Patriot,

I just wanted to say _**[thank you](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkU2L5CAQhn-NudkkpW0nhxxmCQ17mGWhWfYotlaSgkTFjx7m3y_pmWHPcxPRet_nqb-v-tXQRn75ZXYcKWedfNE-ZctzvfPFpAe-85jMu4YWJG8H3vUaGjeeoevnvsGxu4BSqj2rvllHMHgRZ3CqNaaDM8wo3SDcHa0EKztoaDzmtEPXt4O8yP5kBShl-m4AdRm6VjLZ1uhMwRP5TA6zDSHGsFEhm08hLc02rqXEzMQLgyuDa0ZbE57eyCd0Jxt2BteDgMF1pmUtfA6JlxX5XEtNyPPCo8nHX3GtZdc7Oqo7ExPuhjYG6rjMoSaLTEzRPHXoXO_ZJoqFgv98Y80eDS2eiekTSmhv9DN0Dqms-D_x0enfL7c_P3T-cKo_Gj7nFMvE9PN2U_zLzVdA8AV9YWKaq3fJUCa_MFDpIE7HWUwlVWSgzF5iyPRsJybZpNHFN9o2yurCZLscaIebpnxjy48R_gUAAP__72C1MA)**_ - thank you for opening this email.

. . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now.

And more importantly, I know that you are busy with a life of your own, a family of your own, and daily trials and joys of your own.

So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me.

**[Can I count on you to stick with me through November?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkU2L5CAQhn-NudkkpW0nhxxmCQ17mGWhWfYotlaSgkTFjx7m3y_pmWHPcxPRet_nqb-v-tXQRn75ZXYcKWedfNE-ZctzvfPFpAe-85jMu4YWJG8H3vUaGjeeoevnvsGxu4BSqj2rvllHMHgRZ3CqNaaDM8wo3SDcHa0EKztoaDzmtEPXt4O8yP5kBShl-m4AdRm6VjLZ1uhMwRP5TA6zDSHGsFEhm08hLc02rqXEzMQLgyuDa0ZbE57eyCd0Jxt2BteDgMF1pmUtfA6JlxX5XEtNyPPCo8nHX3GtZdc7Oqo7ExPuhjYG6rjMoSaLTEzRPHXoXO_ZJoqFgv98Y80eDS2eiekTSmhv9DN0Dqms-D_x0enfL7c_P3T-cKo_Gj7nFMvE9PN2U_zLzVdA8AV9YWKaq3fJUCa_MFDpIE7HWUwlVWSgzF5iyPRsJybZpNHFN9o2yurCZLscaIebpnxjy48R_gUAAP__72C1MA)**

Fellow Patriot, I hope you'll **[join my campaign team today](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkU2L5CAQhn-NudkkpW0nhxxmCQ17mGWhWfYotlaSgkTFjx7m3y_pmWHPcxPRet_nqb-v-tXQRn75ZXYcKWedfNE-ZctzvfPFpAe-85jMu4YWJG8H3vUaGjeeoevnvsGxu4BSqj2rvllHMHgRZ3CqNaaDM8wo3SDcHa0EKztoaDzmtEPXt4O8yP5kBShl-m4AdRm6VjLZ1uhMwRP5TA6zDSHGsFEhm08hLc02rqXEzMQLgyuDa0ZbE57eyCd0Jxt2BteDgMF1pmUtfA6JlxX5XEtNyPPCo8nHX3GtZdc7Oqo7ExPuhjYG6rjMoSaLTEzRPHXoXO_ZJoqFgv98Y80eDS2eiekTSmhv9DN0Dqms-D_x0enfL7c_P3T-cKo_Gj7nFMvE9PN2U_zLzVdA8AV9YWKaq3fJUCa_MFDpIE7HWUwlVWSgzF5iyPRsJybZpNHFN9o2yurCZLscaIebpnxjy48R_gUAAP__72C1MA)** and stay up to date through Election Day. We have less than 3 months to go, and so much is at stake.

If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring commonsense leadership to our country's most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is _**[pray for me and my election.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkU2L5CAQhn-NudkkpW0nhxxmCQ17mGWhWfYotlaSgkTFjx7m3y_pmWHPcxPRet_nqb-v-tXQRn75ZXYcKWedfNE-ZctzvfPFpAe-85jMu4YWJG8H3vUaGjeeoevnvsGxu4BSqj2rvllHMHgRZ3CqNaaDM8wo3SDcHa0EKztoaDzmtEPXt4O8yP5kBShl-m4AdRm6VjLZ1uhMwRP5TA6zDSHGsFEhm08hLc02rqXEzMQLgyuDa0ZbE57eyCd0Jxt2BteDgMF1pmUtfA6JlxX5XEtNyPPCo8nHX3GtZdc7Oqo7ExPuhjYG6rjMoSaLTEzRPHXoXO_ZJoqFgv98Y80eDS2eiekTSmhv9DN0Dqms-D_x0enfL7c_P3T-cKo_Gj7nFMvE9PN2U_zLzVdA8AV9YWKaq3fJUCa_MFDpIE7HWUwlVWSgzF5iyPRsJybZpNHFN9o2yurCZLscaIebpnxjy48R_gUAAP__72C1MA)**_

And friend, in addition to your prayers, if you're able, **[a small contribution to my campaign](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkU2L5CAQhn-NudkkpW0nhxxmCQ17mGWhWfYotlaSgkTFjx7m3y_pmWHPcxPRet_nqb-v-tXQRn75ZXYcKWedfNE-ZctzvfPFpAe-85jMu4YWJG8H3vUaGjeeoevnvsGxu4BSqj2rvllHMHgRZ3CqNaaDM8wo3SDcHa0EKztoaDzmtEPXt4O8yP5kBShl-m4AdRm6VjLZ1uhMwRP5TA6zDSHGsFEhm08hLc02rqXEzMQLgyuDa0ZbE57eyCd0Jxt2BteDgMF1pmUtfA6JlxX5XEtNyPPCo8nHX3GtZdc7Oqo7ExPuhjYG6rjMoSaLTEzRPHXoXO_ZJoqFgv98Y80eDS2eiekTSmhv9DN0Dqms-D_x0enfL7c_P3T-cKo_Gj7nFMvE9PN2U_zLzVdA8AV9YWKaq3fJUCa_MFDpIE7HWUwlVWSgzF5iyPRsJybZpNHFN9o2yurCZLscaIebpnxjy48R_gUAAP__72C1MA)** goes a long way towards helping me fight against Adam Schiff and the Democrat machine backing his campaign.

body:
The Limited Edition Trump Knife Collection is not just a collectible—it’s a legacy of patriotism, precision, and exquisite craftsmanship

| | | | Dear Friend,
Introducing a unique opportunity to own a distinguished piece of American history.
The **[Limited Edition Trump Knife Collection](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1fba0299974140669deefa614902034d&_e=xVSHSV6mkW5leKkOvP5TwI_3ReI3ZHhtnxOZZ6kjpMLhDCrRd0JmPcmiuxrF6YMM2Z62ZSGENsdeKOpt1rxw4kNH3zSH28NKcjOluUc3JhTepa7GyYKxI76ez8uP7LsUwkrlzO3J5y_n5dNw82nvYTh_hvHNgNbxgTfVKKUKOQDEKZI8xbT9b945vH8HB3pzj5ffmZlkm31Q69Db7lv-dRKUDiytxMYNUA9ldEp3d0uDxUhB7i5e0VPgiI0_g-OQJ56IFasmyvIlalxSvBADIqqjFxcd_u78oRZBWReV338%3D)** is not just a collectible—it’s a legacy of patriotism, precision, and exquisite craftsmanship.
Reserved for those who appreciate the finer things in life, this set is the ultimate tribute to the 45th President of the United States.

---
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1fba0299974140669deefa614902034d&_e=xVSHSV6mkW5leKkOvP5TwI_3ReI3ZHhtnxOZZ6kjpMLhDCrRd0JmPcmiuxrF6YMM2Z62ZSGENsdeKOpt1rxw4kNH3zSH28NKcjOluUc3JhTepa7GyYKxI76ez8uP7LsUMXyb-8CM2zE22TKQ9b2UTxJCxWTXQveoRzU2W4piikDRZEvZTrPpBduZaOoIlMsFrfDhUzOXpJ8sSJ8Ti9TbCKFrKPdvFFAyfvRuRsocvhrMvvb6Y3o5UPHspJ1_ZeYDfZGS5VERa3U_KHbdlNwYvo4jAcdQgPVCXEmkr-806Ek%3D)
---
| | |
**Why the Trump Knife Collection Stands Apart:****8 Distinctive Knives, Each Telling a Story**
This collection is thoughtfully[ designed to commemorate pivotal moments from Trump’s presidency](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1fba0299974140669deefa614902034d&_e=xVSHSV6mkW5leKkOvP5TwI_3ReI3ZHhtnxOZZ6kjpMLhDCrRd0JmPcmiuxrF6YMM2Z62ZSGENsdeKOpt1rxw4kNH3zSH28NKcjOluUc3JhTepa7GyYKxI76ez8uP7LsUpMgQ2nRLYXCizkG9crCf3uGUJdzC4p-3T4YmqnzSruroMWsYq4UupYQMZH9XUFtdTHK1Sas7VIyUrRy_zbnQzGOXIzXV4ZsWXjRPbgTNohJ8zcjWsTShk3EjLanZk3h857ayOc7p-waQll6si3NjurSiKix13YNYq43pwtvX2IQ%3D).
Each month, a new knife arrives at your door, featuring a full-color image of President Trump paired with one of his defining messages—from “Keep America Great” to “Save America Again.”
Each piece is more than a knife; it’s a statement of American pride.
* **Premium Pakkawood Handles** : Hand-polished with a rich cherry stain, each knife handle is crafted to reflect both strength and elegance, offering a balanced, luxurious feel in your hand.
* **Razor-Sharp Stainless Steel Blades** : Each blade is forged with precision, ensuring durability and a sharp edge, reflecting the steadfast spirit of American craftsmanship.
* **American Craftsmanship** : Designed and forged in the USA, each knife is a testament to American quality, pride, and tradition.

---
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1fba0299974140669deefa614902034d&_e=xVSHSV6mkW5leKkOvP5TwI_3ReI3ZHhtnxOZZ6kjpMLhDCrRd0JmPcmiuxrF6YMM2Z62ZSGENsdeKOpt1rxw4kNH3zSH28NKcjOluUc3JhTepa7GyYKxI76ez8uP7LsU2Jh6AyyVms5g_MtgWkSsTRE00VLQVgmC5LpDUTpV7xaM4r2Z56Zrdo8tPkls6vhdDy5dIE7MvXahBfD2yrupQ7vGVyqUfeCIdgRo5AfoZoSw2g3z-gh6p_u5HDIdpbAsPyb_hm2Qk1_DxQx8CCSXd1jfJYfsFDZpCd-WQcf9-NI%3D)
---
| | |
**A Showcase of Elegance: The LED Display Case** The collection comes complete with a **[custom-designed wooden display case](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1fba0299974140669deefa614902034d&_e=xVSHSV6mkW5leKkOvP5TwI_3ReI3ZHhtnxOZZ6kjpMLhDCrRd0JmPcmiuxrF6YMM2Z62ZSGENsdeKOpt1rxw4kNH3zSH28NKcjOluUc3JhTepa7GyYKxI76ez8uP7LsU91L-QnQAIUik4YS0lT1OMnlIzII0yaWTVUZh35n21EutkMVWEIFUjawBDBOJ5glOVc9mvslO7H-uKk1NRhMHi8PIzhmAdV_rQNVX6wowRuoeGwU2cW-Y_mAb0-FUq3E2UkM9HdWQ82CmFYh05gSOyLXBa2OCku-LfHt-hOqzUKc%3D)** , made from premium cherry wood and featuring a shining gold strip with a hinged glass cover.
The addition of **eight built-in LED lights** enhances the beauty of each knife, casting a soft glow that captures the essence of this elegant tribute.
* **Protective and Elegant** : The hinged cover provides easy access to your knives while ensuring they remain protected from dust and wear.
* **Showcase Presidential Pride** : The display case is adorned with a raised golden medallion, inspired by the American presidential seal, making it a stunning centerpiece for any home or office.

---
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1fba0299974140669deefa614902034d&_e=xVSHSV6mkW5leKkOvP5TwI_3ReI3ZHhtnxOZZ6kjpMLhDCrRd0JmPcmiuxrF6YMM2Z62ZSGENsdeKOpt1rxw4kNH3zSH28NKcjOluUc3JhTepa7GyYKxI76ez8uP7LsUx546h_4PL3Be9c4ff44eWue_yf__kCpIA8Wur-27VCJodkXOYDSTqeciQ25QcizmUUCJKBIuIOA79Q01AH8yIWiSsJoHEYn8fjxQ0diq6h1qM0XojB9olvcPynKRqGyySlRhttczZf7D5XAX381wvS528hy_mvvJ-pAarR0XGTc%3D)
---
| | | ****
**An Heirloom for Generations**
****
****This collection is more than a tribute to Trump’s presidency—it’s an heirloom piece that captures a moment in history with elegance and pride. Each knife's patriotic theme is carefully chosen to resonate with the values that define America: freedom, strength, and resilience.

Displayed together, they create a narrative that will be admired for generations.
****
**What Our Collectors Are Saying:**
* **“The detail and craftsmanship are unparalleled. Each knife is a conversation starter, and the display case elevates them to a true work of art.” – Lisa M., Verified Buyer**
* **“I’ve never seen anything like it. Each delivery brings a new piece of history to my collection, and the quality is outstanding.” – Tom L., Verified Buyer**

**Secure Your Place Among History’s Collectors**
****
****The**Limited Edition Trump Knife Collection** is available for a short time.

With each knife delivered monthly, anticipation builds until your set is complete.

This isn’t just about owning knives; it’s about curating a piece of history.
****
**[CLICK HERE TO CHECK AVAILABILITY AND ORDER YOUR SET](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1fba0299974140669deefa614902034d&_e=xVSHSV6mkW5leKkOvP5TwI_3ReI3ZHhtnxOZZ6kjpMLhDCrRd0JmPcmiuxrF6YMM2Z62ZSGENsdeKOpt1rxw4kNH3zSH28NKcjOluUc3JhTepa7GyYKxI76ez8uP7LsUqq9z7qcSWTW4yTWfO9la6p2mIwdct3wqDN-e2Ltsf_O7TYxhYWAJGvb7lpM17JMmObkqIfGN-UCjpGUN4Oduxp_VFsXKlh47ahoF7eqCLyzybp2rOWwM7VnIRhFN8yPELc1nCGIxnRG9TciVvj7AszLWmh9drWIWoodPURNgvok%3D)**

Sincerely,
TrumpKnifeSet.com

P.S. Each knife is delivered in a custom box, making it an exquisite gift for those who hold America's values close to their hearts.
