I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=89d5a4ae1d774a258e751d66645bd27c&_e=bJtgxIz3KHZJUWpTbtZPC9KpA-B2afit-wRqM_LZsBBc0lFf0pNqgnhr5xCZUz1Mk42FFAjEMQ6q-cab4SPve376ypClum4QNhe6Gc__cSsXg7pIwiPjs4EG219Qpd3jeism_mc2qNsIZoJQyUPX5nkJBqn5aIbfaqob6hyHv1Q8XBeSJtkE2h4F9GA-z3YUR9ukJilf2W2f312YqNaoraOTpK6spdPzFMX79szuEi6gcmzZUA3Yg5koVdeWc4tK2krIE_lAWcdo1b6t7rGx_txCb3VazlZY3IR7fdcKYxTseP8CT--ndDLNr-VxipsuJXDivhs4W_aRfPGwDp5ZM_IiesRNa5nSo6Jg4OHsyZ0fVZtTGf-N_Bq5R-b-nxha)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=89d5a4ae1d774a258e751d66645bd27c&_e=bJtgxIz3KHZJUWpTbtZPC9KpA-B2afit-wRqM_LZsBBc0lFf0pNqgnhr5xCZUz1Mk42FFAjEMQ6q-cab4SPve376ypClum4QNhe6Gc__cSsXg7pIwiPjs4EG219Qpd3jeism_mc2qNsIZoJQyUPX5nkJBqn5aIbfaqob6hyHv1Q8XBeSJtkE2h4F9GA-z3YUR9ukJilf2W2f312YqNaoraOTpK6spdPzFMX79szuEi4ZUmIAGOaO7FG-BJ4yv2G0D9UFv5FucVngkMri7Kh2fK8CEccJe3VYMv1Tl08hwi1B6uT7qvKLs-OV5fQfaasc-1Ar96tWNruhvh68cBNT9kt_7PrVyMj_wO5gqC8U3XIeecx4zI8ot6-1wmJd1JIJ)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

## Pagers Explode Across Lebanon
Eleven people were killed and thousands injured [after handheld pagers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2UDnw3HswUMXb-naER3hCFc5GGErpP31VTJ3_PRJ70nv6zJcSJKst0-6c6hzHuha5cGDb7Vr0QymmcLMjNw3HPQZrbXudDLNEk7MxOS5B4NgRmMAaTSsLfYaUHMjAQENeO00gAPdkWcHbp6u2jqvx1kZ4Elq3rvvLGtdeE4_-cF7d833JoWl1q2o_kNhVBiP4-joKbm8XoXxxVYYwSuM-qwwLvw75pRoaTe68d7yc0u5SF5LK2UnTm3l9b2bPUzbISlJsWdl4HYnSW9p_T_BI-BfAAAA___lYl2a) used by Hezbollah members exploded across Lebanon on Tuesday, according to reports.Hezbollah blamed Israel for the "criminal aggression," vowing retaliation, while Israel declined to comment. [Here's a video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGS2yAYBOCnQR0awAhDQZFGndOm1CD-XxYZBBrAJvHT3-jqa_drdvfPY3m4EEN6_nYH2rblxfkW3rgYyjUVcpED2A1R4G1Ay-9CKaWnSQ67XZ2cwEyT4sobeePKgFOaeTBiA-bFEKxgQjLDNWdMMz46g5rpDTxX2vB1I5IhhJbL-DeH1Hbc4v_8xjL6fAzR7q2dldx-ETETMffex4KvhqVefiW5RCBiPgJARIquNiJmyB9Mle74WXOMbqcHHiuWSnt-JUCgEVeXcqJ9x0RP97wM_50xX1jzq3istIeWsFas9NpAmaH8TsQ8FAtnDzGGqu5EsufhQvyu234-723FVwAAAP__aE5z8Q) showing what happened.[Munitions experts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzGPtCAUAH8NdGvgCYgFxdfY7ddeafDxWLmgGCVy9-8ve_V1k0wyyXw856dPOe2v_34jV2OZPdZ00zw-pH2AmhUPLhIB9ZycHMAYY7VWfHWKBgQdg0GtewMarJIWQeKoAS1FnhwIUGKUVgphhez8SFbYGFAaO8olMiUopFrO7rOkva4U83e56eywbDy7tdbjYv0_BhODqbXWLQu-HYNpp3YxmPxZE2Z6I4bha6d8H3QUfrpwtJRzuszAlHhtPuXfav378XbwEwAA__9xqlOW) suggested the pagers may have been packed with military-grade explosives triggered by an alphanumeric text message.Israel has said it wants to [secure the Lebanon border](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGu2yAUxvGnwRsWYC7GA0PbK2_J2tE64INNhSHCJCh5-sqdu33Sb_p_v2_LDUIMabvDgab6vICr4YXLRLmmQi6yW41HFDh0aPgolFL660t2u9FixHHSklmLTCE4ZN5Kz6ySCM5NXTCCCckmrjljmvEeJtRM-9VxpSduPZEM11Bz6f_kkOqOPr7zC0vv8tFFs9f6OMnwg4iZiLm11ifrErbzciLma16QS1yJmMNZACNN2GiDQrcMke74sTlG2OkRYqhQ3vTqy4lGtJByoht8gBaXgI9c8pEM87Mey5mfxSEZvn0MD5uhrESoC1xOFVMlw_fzxELEfP_5647t7IpZHy3EGE41Esm2A0L811H__-rLiL8BAAD__w_4fYc) and allow its residents to return, which requires security against Hezbollah. Israeli leaders say they anticipate a major response from the terrorist group.
## Sean "Diddy" Combs Jailed Without Bail
A New York federal Magistrate on Tuesday [ordered hip-hop mogul Sean "Diddy" Combs](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAUAL8Gd0TwjA0uKK6hy7VXWhge9sthExmSbP5-la23Hmk0mn_X-eop07H-9TvalsrsQ6MnzhOXhoOaVRdtQgTsO7RSwziOZhhUt1ndw4JJK637ftAhRFyiHPowpGDUIkxHFgQoMUkjhTBCXvyERpgUgxzNJJfElMBIrZyXW6GjbZjyuzzxvISyd9lurd0r6_8wcAzc8b6X2j6IgfuIGTgxMXBSM3CPyg98VQauoj94pBjfPJR9qbwVviDfMEf-oraVR-OLp8zp4BW_eDt9ShT-07Hy4Cvy2yOuyMB1p433F-VMddRMiXX3lH_S2u-jnha-AwAA__8KJWqW) to be held without bail on charges of sex trafficking, racketeering conspiracy, and transportation for prostitution.He faces up to life in prison if convicted.Combs was [arrested Monday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj72O8yAQAJ8GuljsGgMuKL7GXb72SoufJSHCJrKRfX77U66-bqSRRpqv-3x3ueT18d8tZFuqswstHzSPNzA3lLPk0SYipJ6TBY1KKTMMkj9t6h300SNCDDJ4iRqM0cH4qLQmjTxbFCjFCAaEMAI6N5IRJsUAyozgE5OCYm516141r-1JqVz1oK0LdeHFPlt776z_x3BiOJ3n2XkfPo7htNK5M5zc1nIo9MEwXP33IF4XDJVvNr7PXErelWZSPBaXy2-1_f14WPwJAAD__3pHUuQ) evening in New York, six months after federal agents raided his homes in Miami and Los Angeles. The word "lemma" comes from the Greek "lēmma," which means "something assumed." name: John Goodman
subject: Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley if he has the resources to make it happen
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley
| | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5563367c-7346-4ded-abce-b51656b0085e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
| [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T68b68e31-2476-4c7e-8f49-92f41dd08ab5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Hey Peter, born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here. The stakes are high this election year — especially in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race. Here we’ve got Josh Hawley, the coward of January 6th, up against Lucas Kunce, a 13-year Marine veteran who knows what it’s like to grow up through hardship, fight for his community, and serve our country. I’m proud to support Lucas, and in a moment I’ll ask you to join me in splitting a donation between him and Blue Amp Action. But first, I want to tell you why I know that Lucas can defeat Hawley this year and why his grassroots campaign urgently needs our help. Please let me explain.
---
| | [CHIP IN NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8f6712d0-ea23-4e96-99b9-ffbd822cd685/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| I’ll be honest: I’ve been ready to defeat Josh Hawley since January 6th, 2021. He totally disgraced my home state that day... raising his fist because he wanted to look strong, and then running away like a little coward out the back door. But Josh Hawley has done a lot more than just that to embarrass Missouri over the years, stuff you probably wouldn’t even believe. Hawley himself played a major role in overturning Roe V. Wade — he even bragged about it! He backs the total abortion ban in Missouri, co-sponsored a national abortion ban, and is a pioneer of the legal movement threatening access to IVF and birth control nationwide. Hawley forced Missouri taxpayers to cover his legal bills after he broke the law — $250,000, in this economy! He’s refused to invest a single dollar in Missouri, instead spending all his time writing stuff like his “Manhood” self-help book. It’s just shameful.
---
| | [CHIP IN NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T75fc3f29-4294-4b44-8264-058de5c92a3b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Now let’s talk about Lucas Kunce. I learned about Lucas probably the same way many of you did, from online ads and emails just like this one. I heard Lucas’ story of struggle and community, which reminded me of my own. I’m sure it resonates with you too. I also saw he was running a real campaign — outraising Hawley, earning record-breaking support, bringing people together regardless of what party they’re from or who they’ve voted for before. And I saw it’s made the polls get closer, too. I’m all-in to help Lucas because I know he can win this race. I know Missouri can elect a Senator we can all be proud of. And I know if we all pitch in, we can run that coward Josh Hawley out of the Senate! I’m about to get to the most important part of this email, but first I need to ask:******[Will you please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce and Blue Amp Action by splitting $10 or more to their campaigns today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc1f47ae3-70ba-48a0-b1e0-10054f390e8e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**
---
| | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T236c19e2-3626-4590-b9e9-b15a019a4549/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| I want you to take what I’m about to tell you seriously, Peter. With so much on the line this year, Missouri’s U.S. Senate race is one of the most important in America — one of our ONLY chances to flip a GOP-held seat. First off, Josh Hawley is far more vulnerable than any national news outlet will lead you to believe. Hawley won his last election with only 51% of the vote, with a margin weaker than Trump’s by double digits. Since then, polls consistently show he’s the least popular GOP Senator up for re-election this cycle, with approval ratings even lower than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida. Maybe even more telling than all that... after January 6th, Hawley’s former mentor, three-term Missouri Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth said supporting Hawley’s campaign in 2018 was “the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.” Hawley’s base abandoned him. And he hasn’t won them back.
---
| | [CHIP IN NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2331bc2d-7573-42bf-a0c4-6d78015ab6b7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Meanwhile, Lucas has consistently played offense — holding Hawley accountable for his extreme record while getting his own positive message of taking back power for working people in front of voters across Missouri. He’s earned critical support from Missouri’s election-winning labor movement, groups like Abortion Action Missouri, Social Security Works, and End Citizens United — and even the Missouri Fire Fighters, who normally endorse Republicans. With help from real people like you, all across the country, he’s built a record-breaking movement to flip this Senate seat. Frankly, Peter, Lucas Kunce and Missouri’s U.S. Senate race haven’t got the attention they deserve this year. But that’s OK, because it hasn’t changed this truth: Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley if he has the resources to make it happen.
---
| | [CHIP IN NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/T57c36fe7-1ca7-49b4-813a-e84d6834459d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Time isn't on our side here. November 5th will be here before we know it, and we’ve gotta make every moment count for Lucas and the team. We’ve gotta make sure they have the resources to fight back hard against the onslaught of attacks that have already started from Hawley and his campaign. Oh yeah, I forgot to mention — Hawley is so afraid of Lucas, he hasn’t even run a single ad about his own record in the Senate. It’s all just false attack ads against Lucas! If you’re able to support Lucas right now in this important moment, you can make a real difference for our country this year, Peter. So I’m personally asking: [Will you please join me in supporting Lucas and Blue Amp Action’s campaigns by donating $10, $25, or just whatever you can today? Lucas is committed to running his campaign the right way, without a single cent from corporate PACs, so anything you’re able to give really will make a big impact.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T54ea4fbb-b809-4494-9a8a-fbaff9ec3dc7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfd535cc2-3cec-47d0-8ba2-600a1c614c50/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| Thank you for listening, John Goodman
Born-and-raised Missourian

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. Since then, polls consistently show he’s the least popular GOP Senator up for re-election this cycle, with approval ratings even lower than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida. Maybe even more telling than all that... after January 6th, Hawley’s former mentor, three-term Missouri Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth said supporting Hawley’s campaign in 2018 was “the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.” Hawley’s base abandoned him. And he hasn’t won them back. | | | Meanwhile, Lucas has consistently played offense — holding Hawley accountable for his extreme record while getting his own positive message of taking back power for working people in front of voters across Missouri. He’s earned critical support from Missouri’s election-winning labor movement, groups like Abortion Action Missouri, Social Security Works, and End Citizens United — and even the Missouri Fire Fighters, who normally endorse Republicans. With help from real people like you, all across the country, he’s built a record-breaking movement to flip this Senate seat. Frankly, Peter, Lucas Kunce and Missouri’s U.S. Senate race haven’t got the attention they deserve this year. But that’s OK, because it hasn’t changed this truth: Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley if he has the resources to make it happen. | | | Time isn't on our side here. November 5th will be here before we know it, and we’ve gotta make every moment count for Lucas and the team. We’ve gotta make sure they have the resources to fight back hard against the onslaught of attacks that have already started from Hawley and his campaign. Oh yeah, I forgot to mention — Hawley is so afraid of Lucas, he hasn’t even run a single ad about his own record in the Senate. It’s all just false attack ads against Lucas! If you’re able to support Lucas right now in this important moment, you can make a real difference for our country this year, Peter. ## UT Austin Tightens Admission Threshold
The University of Texas at Austin announced it will [limit automatic admissions](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LHOozAQBOCnMZ2RvdhgChfX0OXaK5GJl2R1YCO8QPL2p0TX_u2MPmk0f27jLdBC6fE7rOj5Necx3JlOHHupnQQzmir6ScVeV-h1B23bGtfb6ulBI4YwWYwNoFLO9OCmGazFLnbNZCryoMCoXjutrNOmdtHZ2Lheu661OihhFEbivNf8RMZXKPPyzifu9T2v1eKfzFsRzS8Bg4Dhuq767yukTylgSHgVAcOXCRiORCfuhfgt8yy_qQwsw1GYkuQs4543GQ7Oa2C6yxBXKoVyKnLOu-S8_UeFj4iJy8dYSUmCglbAUO0-bhctC5W2E0Y91kDLdyj_8Nvp4V8AAAD__zbKcmU) for in-state students to those in the top 5% of their high school class in 2026. That's down from the current 6%, which has been in place since 2017. The change comes after the school received a record-breaking 73,000 undergraduate applications for this fall. Last year, [around 42,000 undergraduate students](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOhCAQgOGngU4zsIBDQXGN3V57pUEYVxJcNzrq3ttfsv31f_7k-7kP91hqeT6-40KB39M6xMTlpME3ChttBiNzGCF7JSmoTjvnDHor55BhIhWNdZZQjQY7AG06m9CnMSGCLEGDNuAVKrCoTIsZbb6hV9g5qyIIA5QLr1vLMzG94z7V3_WkrU3rImuYmV-7uH0J3QvdX9fVHp-qpXwI3cdxPVjofoqJ9yY-czOVx7HRLreQX1epteyuEwYeSyz18-R_iGfQfwEAAP__HLBTOA) were enrolled at UT Austin.
## Overturned Cattle Truck Kills 40 Cows
A cattle truck carrying 80 or so cows overturned on a bridge crossing I-30 in Arlington Monday evening, [killing around 40 of them](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAQRn-N2Yzsw9hm8NCFLV07osM-EqsGInMN6b-vkr3r9-lJT-_rMl0wl7xdP3GlwM9lnzByftA0SO0lmMk0KcwqDbqhoB1Ya40f-uYWsFMqObvYSOgsdtRH6GF2zqloBzRNDqDAqEF7rXqvTeuT71PnB-2d7TUqYRSlzHtt-UZMTzyW8rs_qLZxX5sSbsz3Q3QfAkYB43mebZyPjc7j9QsY34iA8TUJGCMyF5Jcf-K3xBhzoo3lvsksOyXnmtOVJLKcMdckF6yrrDsmAWNTQ7qfuZR8WCeMuq6Yy1uC_2nyCPAXAAD__xnHZDc) and blocking traffic in both directions. One cow escaped the trailer and was hit and killed by another vehicle. A forklift was used to remove the dead cattle, while those that survived were loaded into other trucks. Police say the driver--who was not hurt--[misjudged how much space he needed](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGP4yAUhH8N7p4FGGwoKNK4OClXXHOlhW0co9iQhZeQ3V-_Yvut3pNm9Glm_l-nq_WHD7e_9nQG31uc7IL-5SYNTAEXk2hWM9NVs8YZNvC-74XSstlNp7Wl2zarTSu5yL4XnZTMdsswD9s8q8YbTrmgmilGpWKiVauSa6c0U0MvmaVEULd6jKnF3aF727wdn_HlUrvEsznMjvjIpLsQPhI-llLaM4eqET66AM9M-BhcqSfi7hLhI6bncgeMxYcbKApLLBkqEp8pZAjOJvDQUfABbKrFMQa4-6O-sMYvFzLEDXB3YIM_7VHpNsHlwj7-7Pd_TTLro1R_7gci6O20_vjJi7_M9zL8OwAA__-K0XPD) to turn onto Baird Farm Road after exiting the interstate, causing the truck to flip over. The intersection was cleaned by a hazmat crew before being reopened Tuesday morning.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: social media just banned us!
body:
My jaw hit the floor yesterday evening when one of my staffers told me...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

My jaw hit the floor yesterday evening when one of my staffers told me that TikTok just banned _Students for Life of America’s_ account.

**__What for_?_**

We posted a short video where one of our student spokesperons, Lydia Taylor, posed as a pregnant woman seeking a very late-term abortion.

Lydia called an abortion facility in Colorado who confirmed they would commit the abortion and then went in detail as to how they would kill her baby.

If you'd like, you can see the video that got us banned, I've included it at the bottom of this email.

But first, Pro-Life Friend, just take a minute to consider what an outrage this is.

We're in the midst of one of the most consequential Presidential campaigns in American history!

Early voting is literally starting today in Pennsylvania. Both candidates are making claims and promises. **_The media is CLEARLY in the pocket of one candidate_.**

_And now, social media – specifically TikTok – is banning us from pointing out the emperor is wearing no clothes when it comes to late-term abortion?_

This cannot stand!

**[If you agree, please make your most generous contribution to our Legal Defense Fund to help us FIGHT BACK against this outrageous censorship](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gikhrkl-duchtdja-y/).**

Even as I write you, the situation continues to change with TikTok.

After we had hundreds of students write in complaint letters, we can finally get back into our account but the video is still censored. Since TikTok doesn’t have any American offices, there is no one to talk too or reach out for help.

AI fear this is the first in what will be a “banned-not banned-banned” saga from now until Election Day... as this happened in 2020 too.

To be 100% honest, I'm very worried this type of censorship will spread to other platforms ahead of November 5th.

No matter what you think of TikTok _(I have my opinions),_ this platform is one of the most popular among young people right now.

So, we have to be where young people are – _or else we can't communicate with them._

That's exactly what the Abortion Lobby and their pals want.

Apparently, it's what TikTok wants too.

They banned us the same day their attorneys were in Federal Court arguing THEY shouldn't be banned in America and have the right to free speech!

**Just like every Third-World, tinpot dictator around the globe knows, if you can control the flow of information, you control a country.**

That's what the Abortion Lobby and their political pals want.

The First Amendment was created to stop authoritarianism in the United States.

Big Tech, power-mad government agencies, the media, and Kamala's kama-nists all want rights of freedom of speech destroyed in their mad quest for control . . .

And they will win if you and I don't fight back.

We have to fight back and show these social media companies that we don’t take this lying down.

We will fight for our right of Free Speech.

And we must fight to continue to show young Americans the reality of late-term abortion and the Democratic Party who champions it.

**[That's why I'm counting on you to please make your most generous contribution to our Legal Defense Fund to help us FIGHT BACK against this outrageous censorship](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gikhrkl-duchtdja-j/).**

Pro-Life Friend, I am not going down without a fight.

Are you?

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – I almost forgot to include the video that got us banned. You can watch it here!

Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

I’m an actress, director, singer, longtime activist, and, above all, a citizen of our great democracy. And as a citizen with a platform larger than most, I believe it is not only my right but also my duty to express my concerns. So here goes Peter:

If the GOP succeeds in flipping Pennsylvania red, they’ll almost certainly regain control of both the Senate _and_ the White House, threatening everything from voting rights to women’s rights to the fight against climate change.

# [Ask Trump: "If you're 'the biggest' IVF champion, why didn't you do a damn thing to get the IVF rights bill passed in the Senate?"](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td8c892bb-d5a2-4be7-895a-74001e1c182e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | IVF treatments have helped millions of families to have children, and they have strong support across the political spectrum, except for an idiot extreme on the far right. And Donald Trump recently claimed that no one is a bigger champion of IVF than he is. So why didn't he do a damn thing to push for passage of a critically important [IVF rights bill](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0ac2e7dc-aa0a-4696-8b44-727b20c70515/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) in the Senate? With only two Republicans supporting it, a phone call or even a tweet from Trump could have easily flipped several more, and put this bill on a path to law. And yet, Trump did nothing, apparently too scared of the anti-abortion extremists who want to outlaw IVF and even contraception. [**Ask Trump: "If you're an IVF champion, why didn't you do a damn thing to get the IVF protection bill passed in the Senate?"**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T68fcdb21-1077-475b-b919-27afc446ebb1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump is a spineless liar whose word cannot be trusted, and who will drop to his knees before the extreme right every time. And he needs to be forced to explain his inaction, and make it clear before all that he will do nothing to protect freedom. [**Ask Trump: "If you're an IVF champion, why didn't you do a damn thing to get the IVF protection bill passed in the Senate?"**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T09a19d45-a00d-4bcd-bd47-7b71d11b9156/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What Trump did in Michigan last night
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1945%2E135344%2ECsL2_A)

Yesterday evening, Donald Trump held a town hall in Flint. A few hours earlier, J.D. Vance spoke in West Michigan at a rally in Kent County. These should have been opportunities to bring people together, or offer a plan for our state and our country.
Instead, Trump did what has become typical for his events: he ranted about crowd size at his rallies, bragged about his relationships with Kim Jong Un, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin, and repeated the lie that the 2020 election was unfair.
Vance was no better, suggesting that Kamala Harris was leading us all on a “path to slavery.”
This is Trump’s 10th visit to Michigan since he launched his 2024 presidential campaign. And it won’t be the last time we see him here.
Because Trump, Vance, and Republicans know what we know: If Trump loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the race is tight. At the top of the ticket, and for my race for Senate. And everyone knows it will come down to the wire.
Trump’s visit is part of a clear strategy to throw their resources at Michigan. If you watch even a few minutes of TV here you’ll see millions of dollars of attack ads on a non-stop loop.
The latest polls show our state is virtually tied — for both the presidential and the Senate race. Political forecaster Nate Silver’s recently published analysis said not only that Michigan is a “pure toss up” but also that there may be no state more important than Michigan in this election.
But we are not powerless. We can impact the outcome of the races in this state.
[**Want to help? Chip in what you can and help send a message that Michigan is sure as hell not ready to swing back to Trump.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240918-1-900&t=2&akid=1945%2E135344%2ECsL2_A)

---
Hi Peter,

We are heartbroken and outraged. But we knew we’d eventually have to share this story...

We didn’t know which state it would be about or the name of the woman, but we knew there would come a day when a woman would die from lack of access to modern reproductive healthcare. This week, ProPublica reported that Amber Thurman, a 28-year-old mother in Georgia, has died because doctors would not help her manage complications during her pregnancy.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93040332/499166064/-1452981315?refcode=EM_F_240918outrage_N_HBM_NO_14_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMyY2UwZGRjLWJiNzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=guRLi0HdeP_bCGbUTfyjbPzKLJp1-8Tw74DV2i_8JFw=)
---
Thurman had taken an abortion pill but was experiencing complications. She checked into a Georgia Hospital in need of a routine – and life-saving – procedure called a dilation and curettage, or D&C.;

According to ProPublica:

_“Her state had made performing the procedure a felony, with few exceptions. Any doctor who violated the new Georgia law could be prosecuted and face up to a decade in prison. Thurman waited in pain in a hospital bed, worried about what would happen to her 6-year-old son, as doctors monitored her infection spreading, her blood pressure sinking and her organs beginning to fail._

_It took 20 hours for doctors to finally operate. By then, it was too late.”_

We need to make something clear: **in Georgia, like ALL abortion-ban states, the legislature is overwhelmingly MALE.** MEN

SHOULD NOT

BE MAKING LAWS

ABOUT WOMEN’S BODIES We have been outraged for long enough. Our outrage must come with action. At Her Bold Move, we will not rest until each and every lawmaker who worked to pass abortion bans is replaced with a pro-choice woman.

We cannot do this work alone. We depend on donations like yours to make this work possible. Our candidates are often outspent by their opponents, but we work to help them fill the gaps.

[**Please turn your outrage into action. Women MUST fight back. There have been too many tragic stories of women missing out on STANDARD MODERN HEALTHCARE in the United States – made possible by a lack of representation in the rooms of power where these unconscionable decisions are being made. For ALL women,

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to ETS American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun coETS as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

USO Supporter, **today the Air Force celebrates its 77th birthday** , and we set a goal to collect 77,000 signatures and well-wishes for our brave airmen. But right now, we're coming up short, and I'm counting on you to help us reach our goal before this chance passes by.
**[It only takes a moment to show your support, so please: Will you add your name now to honor our airmen while there's still time?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/k3vwHbG8-gH6/OFBZNHZrMnVmNVdZbjhITkx0SUFibnk0QUZWaXZXcjdoZVNhMjVOUFpITzJNK0dKWHFVU3ViYmh4dGNMUXp3cXFJVHAxdmlsLzJ5aE9KSjdSM0NyTmxjVmtkYUFtK1NLNWtHTFVtVDArbm89S0/cFcrUlVXcjB4ekpycW1lZ0pmdnVPUVRlRk5YbGVKYmdBTktmQ3hvOXdxUEU0ZTY2WDArTjNDN1IvUEVLOEgrZWhscDJrQXRSK01zaVBSVkxLMVVHbHVxejRnbzkyUmRtS0)**
I've seen firsthand the risks our airmen take and the sacrifices they -- and their families -- make on behalf of us all. Over the course of 25 years, including my deployments to Afghanistan, Kuwait and other locations in the Middle East, my family and I made those sacrifices too.
During one of those long deployments, my wife got this idea from another military spouse: Fill a jar with M&M'S to help our kids count down the days until my return. Every day, they'd get to eat one M&M -- just one! -- and by the time the jar was empty, I'd be home.
Then, my deployment was extended. The thought of disappointing our kids was heartbreaking. But in the middle of the night, my wife secretly added M&M'S to the jar, keeping it just filled enough so our little ones wouldn't lose hope. I don't know how she held it together for our kids for so long. But I do know that every military family has their own story of perseverance just like ours.
**That 's why it's so important to share these stories and honor the sacrifices made by so many airmen and their loved ones. Today, as we reflect on the Air Force's birthday, your words of encouragement, understanding and gratitude are even more powerful.**
[SIGN NOW TO HONOR OUR HEROES](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/_K68QeW7w2tD/OFBZNHZrMnVmNVdZbjhITkx0SUFibnk0QUZWaXZXcjdoZVNhMjVOUFpITzJNK0dKWHFVU3ViYmh4dGNMUXp3cXFJVHAxdmlsLzJ5aE9KSjdSM0NyTmxjVmtkYUFtK1NLNWtHTFVtVDArbm89S0/cFcrUlVXcjB4ekpycW1lZ0pmdnVPUVRlRk5YbGVKYmdBTktmQ3hvOXdxUEU0ZTY2WDArTjNDN1IvUEVLOEgrZWhscDJrQXRSK01zaVBSVkxLMVVHbHVxejRnbzkyUmRtS0)

Serving in the Air Force is a challenging and vital mission, but it's a source of great pride. We do it because families like yours and mine are worth every effort, and the support of the American people keeps us strong.
**So please, will you take this opportunity to make today special for everyone in the Air Force?**
**[Add your name before midnight to show our Air Force heroes and all our service members you care and thank them for the sacrifices.](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/-Z39JWayANSV/OFBZNHZrMnVmNVdZbjhITkx0SUFibnk0QUZWaXZXcjdoZVNhMjVOUFpITzJNK0dKWHFVU3ViYmh4dGNMUXp3cXFJVHAxdmlsLzJ5aE9KSjdSM0NyTmxjVmtkYUFtK1NLNWtHTFVtVDArbm89S0/cFcrUlVXcjB4ekpycW1lZ0pmdnVPUVRlRk5YbGVKYmdBTktmQ3hvOXdxUEU0ZTY2WDArTjNDN1IvUEVLOEgrZWhscDJrQXRSK01zaVBSVkxLMVVHbHVxejRnbzkyUmRtS0)**
Thank you for supporting our military heroes,
Christopher Plamp

For change,

Curtis Bashaw
Entrepreneur. Husband. Preservationist.

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

subject: Ruben Gallego is required, by law, to publicly report his fundraising numbers on September 30th. With less than 50 days to go, we must show strength.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
If we put up a strong FEC report we improve our chances at defending our Senate Majority and winning back the White House.
#

Peter -
Just a few years ago, the idea that someone like Donald Trump would be running for president (again!) would have been a joke.
**But he has a commanding lead in Arizona today.**
It’s hard to even think that someone like Kari Lake, one of Donald Trump’s most vocal supporters, could be a United States Senator after all of her lies, misinformation, conspiracies, schoolyard insults and bullying.
**But the polls have this U.S. Senate race a dead-heat, and we are losing our edge in fundraising right now.**
Both of them have to go through Ruben Gallego to win, but to defend Arizona he needs your help. And these next two weeks before our final FEC deadline before the election are some of the most critically important days of the campaign.
Ruben is legally required to publicly report his fundraising numbers after this FEC deadline. Everyone is going to be watching, because what happens in this race directly affects what happens up and down the ballot in Arizona.
If we put up a strong FEC report we improve our chances at defending our Senate Majority and winning back the White House. If we put up a weak FEC report it invites millions more dollars in outside spending and throws the momentum back to Kari Lake and Trump.
We need a TON of donations before this FEC deadline to catch up to where we need to be. It would be an unmitigated disaster if we miss our goals this late in the election.
So, please:

body:
Kamala’s ‘lawful pathways’ program floods U.S. with 1 million-plus migrants, escalates crime in Colorado’s sanctuary cities
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey folks,

This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, September 18, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Ganahl: Kamala’s ‘lawful pathways’ program floods U.S. with 1 million-plus migrants, escalates crime in Colorado’s sanctuary cities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
In a staggering development, newly released data from U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) reveals that nearly 530,000 migrants have flown into the United States and been paroled into the country under the Joe Biden-Kamala Harris administration’s controversial CHNV mass parole program.
In addition to this massive influx, about 813,000 more migrants have scheduled appointments through the CBP One app at ports of entry, where they will also be released into the U.S.
These so-called “lawful pathways” are new processes created by the Harris administration to provide migrants a way into the country without being counted as illegal border crossings. While these individuals are not crossing the border unlawfully, the programs have drawn sharp criticism from immigration enforcement officials and law-and-order advocates for their lack of oversight and potential long-term consequences.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Denver’s Initiative 309 slaughterhouse ban impacts national lamb supply chain](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver’s Initiative 309 proposes shutting down Superior Farms, Colorado's largest lamb processing facility, potentially disrupting 15-20% of the U.S. lamb supply. If passed, the initiative could cause an estimated $861 million economic loss and lead to 2,787 job cuts in Colorado, affecting the wider regional economy.
* Local ranchers and industry groups oppose the initiative, arguing it threatens rural Colorado's economy and misuses the state's ballot initiative process to harm the meat industry. Critics contend the initiative may violate the 5th Amendment and bypass standard regulatory oversight, avoiding informed decision-making by relevant stakeholders.
* The ["Stop the Ban"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) campaign, backed by various associations, aims to educate voters on the initiative's negative implications for the economy and food prices, while arguing it won't improve animal welfare.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Takeaways from Hawley report on secret service failures in first Trump assassination attempt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Senator Josh Hawley's report details multiple missed opportunities and failures by the Secret Service, DHS, and FBI in preventing the assassination attempt at a Pennsylvania rally.
* Whistleblowers revealed that critical security evaluations and measures, such as countersniper teams, were inadequately applied at the event, partly because of bureaucratic decisions prioritizing Trump's status as a former president.
* The report calls for the Secret Service to reassess its protective methodologies and for Congress to enhance oversight to ensure rigorous security for all protected individuals, regardless of their current political status.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Denver council OKs $6 million contract to Haven of Hope to aid immigrants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Denver City Council approved a $6 million contract with Haven of Hope to manage food distribution and provide services for 865 immigrants, including children, in Denver's Asylum Seekers Program.
* Councilmember Serena Gonzales-Gutierrez raised questions about the program’s sustainability and its future, considering the high cost per participant and the announcement of no subsequent cohorts.
* Councilmember Shontel Lewis opposed the contract, advocating for a no-strings-attached basic income approach similar to a prior successful project in Denver, arguing it allowed people to better manage their needs.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Sean ‘Diddy’ Combs Hit with Sex Trafficking, Racketeering Charges in NYC](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Sean "Diddy" Combs was arrested and charged with sex trafficking and racketeering conspiracy, stemming from accusations of orchestrating exploitative "Freak Off" performances for his sexual gratification.
* The indictment describes Combs as the leader of a criminal enterprise, utilizing his business resources and influence to coerce women into abusive scenarios, threatening their safety and using recorded material as blackmail.
* The charges follow months of federal investigation, including raids on Combs' properties, and add to a series of civil lawsuits accusing him of similar abusive behaviors dating back decades.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|

**[Andrews: A ban on fur in Denver would only hurt this thriving cow town](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY PAUL ANDREWS, [THE DENVER POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Denver is like no place else. We’re a “cow town” with a thriving food scene; a tech hub and a gateway to world-class recreation opportunities; sports teams, museums, brew pubs, and distilleries for everyone. We’ve hit on a formula for a world-class 21st-century city that honors its heritage. It’s no wonder boomers and Gen Z alike want to be here._
_So why mess with success?_
_Unfortunately, some ideologues want to do just that. They have a scheme that would tear apart our heritage and what makes us a unique and desirable city. The backers of the initiative will tell you it’s no big deal, but when they put something on the ballot that will hurt the National Western Stock Show, the Denver Powwow, our fly-fishing businesses and hatmakers, that should rile us all up. Hands off our hats!_

clean_body: Kamala’s ‘lawful pathways’ program floods U.S. with 1 million-plus migrants, escalates crime in Colorado’s sanctuary cities | | | | PRESENTED BY | | Hey folks, This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, September 18, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | TODAY'S TOP STORIES BY HEIDI GANAHL, In a staggering development, newly released data from U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) reveals that nearly 530,000 migrants have flown into the United States and been paroled into the country under the Joe Biden-Kamala Harris administration’s controversial CHNV mass parole program. In addition to this massive influx, about 813,000 more migrants have scheduled appointments through the CBP One app at ports of entry, where they will also be released into the U.S. These so-called “lawful pathways” are new processes created by the Harris administration to provide migrants a way into the country without being counted as illegal border crossings. While these individuals are not crossing the border unlawfully, the programs have drawn sharp criticism from immigration enforcement officials and law-and-order advocates for their lack of oversight and potential long-term consequences. | Denver’s Initiative 309 proposes shutting down Superior Farms, Colorado's largest lamb processing facility, potentially disrupting 15-20% of the U.S. lamb supply. If passed, the initiative could cause an estimated $861 million economic loss and lead to 2,787 job cuts in Colorado, affecting the wider regional economy. Local ranchers and industry groups oppose the initiative, arguing it threatens rural Colorado's economy and misuses the state's ballot initiative process to harm the meat industry. Critics contend the initiative may violate the 5th Amendment and bypass standard regulatory oversight, avoiding informed decision-making by relevant stakeholders. The campaign, backed by various associations, aims to educate voters on the initiative's negative implications for the economy and food prices, while arguing it won't improve animal welfare. | Senator Josh Hawley's report details multiple missed opportunities and failures by the Secret Service, DHS, and FBI in preventing the assassination attempt at a Pennsylvania rally. Whistleblowers revealed that critical security evaluations and measures, such as countersniper teams, were inadequately applied at the event, partly because of bureaucratic decisions prioritizing Trump's status as a former president. The report calls for the Secret Service to reassess its protective methodologies and for Congress to enhance oversight to ensure rigorous security for all protected individuals, regardless of their current political status. | The Denver City Council approved a $6 million contract with Haven of Hope to manage food distribution and provide services for 865 immigrants, including children, in Denver's Asylum Seekers Program. Councilmember Serena Gonzales-Gutierrez raised questions about the program’s sustainability and its future, considering the high cost per participant and the announcement of no subsequent cohorts. Councilmember Shontel Lewis opposed the contract, advocating for a no-strings-attached basic income approach similar to a prior successful project in Denver, arguing it allowed people to better manage their needs. | Sean "Diddy" Combs was arrested and charged with sex trafficking and racketeering conspiracy, stemming from accusations of orchestrating exploitative "Freak Off" performances for his sexual gratification. The indictment describes Combs as the leader of a criminal enterprise, utilizing his business resources and influence to coerce women into abusive scenarios, threatening their safety and using recorded material as blackmail. The charges follow months of federal investigation, including raids on Combs' properties, and add to a series of civil lawsuits accusing him of similar abusive behaviors dating back decades. | BY PAUL ANDREWS, Denver is like no place else. We’re a “cow town” with a thriving food scene; a tech hub and a gateway to world-class recreation opportunities; sports teams, museums, brew pubs, and distilleries for everyone. The backers of the initiative will tell you it’s no big deal, but when they put something on the ballot that will hurt the National Western Stock Show, the Denver Powwow, our fly-fishing businesses and hatmakers, that should rile us all up. | Dear Friend,
We’re approaching a critical moment in this campaign, and I need **YOU** to be part of it! This fall, we’re hitting the road to rally supporters all across the district — and this is your chance to make your voice heard and help secure a win for our future.
**Join me at one of our Get Out the Vote Rallies near you, and let’s stand up together to create change!**

🕛 12 pm - 2 pm at Mid County Park in Christiansburg
🔗 [RSVP Here](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=032593cec8&e=8cac9e7f7d)

🔗 [RSVP Here](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=085a4c7903&e=8cac9e7f7d)

🔗 [RSVP Here](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=03f2c05f32&e=8cac9e7f7d)
**📍 October 12th, 2024 - Martinsville** 🎤 Guest Speakers: State Senator Aaron Rouse & Melody Cartwright
🕕 6 pm - 7:30 pm at Uptown Kornna Kitchen and Lounge
🔗 [RSVP Here](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=0e9993b887&e=8cac9e7f7d)
**📍 October 13th, 2024: Coalfields**
🕕 5 pm - 7:00 pm in Wise/Norton Area (Location TBD)
🔗 [RSVP Here](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=aba52e3f4f&e=8cac9e7f7d)
We are on the brink of a new chapter for Southwest Virginia, and every person who shows up to these rallies strengthens our movement. This is our moment to fight for working families, better healthcare, and the future our children deserve. **The change we need won’t happen without YOU, so I’m personally inviting you to come rally with us!**
🌟 **Why Your Support Matters:**
Your attendance sends a powerful message that we are united, energized, and ready to bring much-needed change to the 9th district. Each rally is a chance for us to gather as a community, show our strength, and encourage more folks to get to the polls.
🤝 **Bring Your Friends, Family, and Neighbors!**
Share the event with your loved ones, and let’s turn out in record numbers! Each rally is a celebration of our values, our vision, and the future we’re building. There will be local speakers, music, and plenty of opportunities to connect with fellow supporters.
I can’t wait to see you on the campaign trail.
Let’s make history!

| In solidarity,Karen Baker

body:

---
| | | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

| | Dear Friend,Populism is a word often used to describe emerging political trends around the world. But populism isn't just a modern phenomenon -- it goes back centuries.
---
| [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.--uWgBg)
---
| | Traditionally described as a battle between Left and Right, political differences are actually far more complex. What we are witnessing today are two distinct populist movements challenging party establishments across the West. Remarkably, these tensions can be traced all the way back to Roman times.

This is why I'm reaching out to you today. I want to offer you a free copy of one of our most insightful eBooks: **Dueling Populisms** by Victor Davis Hanson. Hanson, a Hoover Senior Fellow and acclaimed historian, provides a unique perspective that I believe you'll find incredibly valuable.

In **Dueling Populisms** you'll discover:
* What to expect from a political landscape dominated by movements that oppose both the establishment and each other.
* The striking similarities between ancient populist movements and today's progressive and conservative populisms.
* Insights into what the future holds for America as we navigate these revived ancient tensions in our modern culture.

This eBook is especially relevant as we face increasing political polarization and try to anticipate and understand election outcomes. By understanding the historical context of these populist movements, you'll gain a clearer view of our current environment and the potential paths forward. Hanson's expertise will help you see beyond the surface of today's political debates and grasp the deeper currents at play.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to deepen your understanding of today's political dynamics. Get your free copy of **Dueling Populisms** using this secure link: [Get Your Free eBook](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

I hope that it helps equip you to understand and participate in the civic discourse in the coming months.
Greg Greg Stamps | Online DevelopmentHoover Institution | Stanford University

Yep, just $5. $5 because last year, Adam Frisch lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. $5 because now Lauren Boebert has moved to my district, and I am the official Democratic nominee running against her. $5 because brand-new polling shows Boebert is still incredibly vulnerable and in danger of losing! And $5 because if we turn this seat blue, Democrats are almost guaranteed to take back the House – and that’s why Lauren Boebert and Speaker Johnson’s Super PACs are already attacking me. I know $5 might not seem like much – and to be honest, it’s not. But over 61,000 grassroots donors like you have already chipped in to my campaign, and we are building a grassroots movement to defeat Lauren Boebert – $5 at a time. We cannot stop or let up now. Not when we are so close to giving Boebert the boot. My campaign has set a goal to raise another $75,000 to fight back and defeat Lauren Boebert, but we are still $19,085 away with time running out before our next fundraising deadline. | I couldn’t be prouder to support Tammy Baldwin’s reelection campaign.

I couldn’t be prouder to support Tammy Baldwin’s reelection campaign. Tammy is a trailblazing, change-making leader who has dedicated her career to fighting for working families everywhere. As someone who was born and raised in a blue-collar family in Ohio, I get it. We don’t want hyper-partisan politicians in Washington who are there to prioritize profits over people. We want a champion who understands the challenges that people face every day and is willing to go the extra mile. **Tammy is the champion Wisconsin deserves in the Senate.** Unfortunately, she’s facing her most challenging election yet. And now, Wisconsin’s Senate race is statistically tied and Republicans have a real chance to flip this seat red. clean_body: A four-to-one financial disadvantage will NOT take back the Senate | Fellow American, Democrats are defending 23 seats in 2024, and FIVE are critical for our effort to take back the Majority. - Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy is taking on corrupt Democrat Jon Tester and his $3 to $1 financial advantage (Tester has raised $43 million to Sheehy's $14 million). Tester is a corrupt Democrat who is closer to the D.C. lobbyists who pay his campaign bills than Montana voters. - Republican Bernie Moreno is taking the fight to Dem Incumbent Sherrod Brown in a campaign where Republican analysts admit “Brown's spending has left a mark.” - Former GOP Rep. Mike Rogers is taking on Democrat Rep. Elissa Slotkin and sources inside Rogers campaign are saying “he does not have enough” money to win this race. - GOP Candidate, Army Captain, and IED-blast survivor Sam Brown is neck-and-neck in the polls with Democrat Incumbent Jacky Rosen, but Brown is staring down a 4-to-1 financial disadvantage he can't fix without our help. - West Point Graduate, Army Captain, and now GOP candidate Dave McCormick has brought this race within the margin of error in the polls, but he has been outspent by a margin of more than 3-to-1 so far. These critical races are only still neck-and-neck because of the Democrats' financial advantage. The consequences of a Democrat Majority in the U.S. Senate would be devastating, and it is up to grassroots GOP patriots just like you, Fellow American, to help us keep pace with the Democrat's record-breaking spending. Republican candidates in these close, critical races are working tirelessly to reach every undecided voter and motivate each of their supporters to VOTE on Election Day. These neck-and-neck races will be decided in the final weeks and days of the election. In those final days, advertisements and grassroots support make the difference. And they are EXPENSIVE. It's tough when you don't see yourself represented politically. I'm a millennial, a woman, a dog mom 🐶, and an environmental activist--so who represents me? It's a simple question, but the reality of it is complicated.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8fe906bb-2b7a-4a2b-8e50-a534a04943a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Part of the reason I decided to run is because there are issues that our elected representatives either don't understand or don't have the experience to tackle.
We need leaders who look like us, think like us, and care about us. Half of Americans are women, yet women hold just 150 of the 535 seats in Congress. Younger voters aged 18-35 make up one of the largest voting blocs in America, yet the median age of the U.S. Senate is 65.3!
Here's a quick example about why political representation matters: our younger generations will be the ones inheriting this planet. By continuously failing to act on climate change, our elected officials are putting their futures at risk either out of ignorance or greed.
Already, Utahns are seeing the effects that climate change can have on the Great Salt Lake, with ~800 square miles of lakebed being exposed and winds blowing toxic dust into our communities, threatening wildlife, industries, and poisoning our lungs.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6a3ac4f3-b401-4520-a7bc-179d4faee872?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And climate change isn't the only issue where good representation matters: Our opponent has gone out of his way during his time in Congress to appease anti-abortion groups and ranked among the most conservative Republicans in the House. That's not what listening looks like.
But you don't even have to take it from me. On a debate stage 2 years ago, John Curtis said, "I wish, as a man, I didn't have to make this decision; I wish women could make this decision." **Yeah, we'd like to!!** Yet as I'm writing this, Senate Republicans just voted to block the Right to IVF Act for the second time this year...
By protecting IVF and abortion, our opponent would truly be giving women the choice to do what they think is best. Instead, he will likely follow the Republican Party on issues such as this, just as he's done for years in the House.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2be66c5e-1186-4ebb-af2b-161213bc8d82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But we don't just need representation that looks like us - we need folks who are willing to disarm the political rhetoric and actually listen. Fear-mongering politicians like our opponent rant on about China and the border in an attempt to divide and misdirect us from the lack of representation that we face.
Different outlooks come from different experiences. Women, young people, and working Utahns agree quite often, but with inflammatory issues serving as a wedge, we're unable to see that. In fact, just one look at John's website tells you everything you need to know about how serious he is on the issues we face:
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fbaf743e-bcf7-442b-93a0-ab68b0fc80c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Yes, this is a real screenshot ..._
I'm sick of business as usual. Business as usual means more tax cuts for the wealthy in exchange for more campaign contributions from corporate donors. It means more misdirection and more division from someone who values his position in power too much to rock the boat. And it means more out-of-touch billionaires in Congress instead of regular working people ⬇️.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5838d72a-8db7-41d5-844d-bc144b73c480?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We all have a representation problem here in Utah: women, young people, and working Utahns. This November, we have a real chance to be part of a grand change in our state, one that will put people first and address the issues that really matter.
If you'd like to be a part of that change and help us solve Utah's representation problem, I'd be happy to have you join me. **[Can you click this link to make a grassroots contribution today and show your support?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e32f675a-c7cb-4d0b-8a68-d51c22618ed2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e32f675a-c7cb-4d0b-8a68-d51c22618ed2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm counting on you,
Caroline Gleich 🏔️
_P.S. Thank you so much for always sticking around to read these. I really appreciate it._
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/249a9d6c-0997-43ac-886c-93408fc7d5fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

This is about equal treatment in our democracy and equal treatment for all citizens, regardless of skin color, financial resources, or background. A rich person shouldn't be able to buy their vote back, candidate for office or not.
Add your name today to end this double standard: Tell Congress to co-sponsor and pass the Inclusive Democracy Act now >> [https://act.commoncause.org/letters/tell-congress-end-shameful-double-standards-in-our-legal-system?source=090224swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://act.commoncause.org/letters/tell-congress-end-shameful-double-standards-in-our-legal-system?source=090224swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=091824_1&amount=25]
Folks:
Listen, the honest truth is: Felony disenfranchisement laws have a shameful history dating back to Jim Crow – and were never intended to target wealthy, powerful people. These laws were expressly written to make it harder for someone who had ever committed a crime to vote, even if they had repaid their debt to society.
These laws impact 4.4 million ordinary Americans currently disenfranchised by felony convictions and unable to vote.
The Inclusive Democracy Act would end this blatant double standard , restoring full voting rights for federal elections to all Americans with felony convictions, and ensuring NO American is denied their right to have a say in our democracy.
Sign our petition now: Tell Congress it's time to end shameful double standards in our legal system >> [https://act.commoncause.org/letters/tell-congress-end-shameful-double-standards-in-our-legal-system?source=090224swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://act.commoncause.org/letters/tell-congress-end-shameful-double-standards-in-our-legal-system?source=090224swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]
Why are we talking about a double standard? One huge example:
Despite his 34 felony convictions, Donald Trump doesn’t have to worry about his eligibility to vote this fall. He has the wealth, connections, and privilege to ensure his voting rights would never be in question – not to mention a high-powered legal team paid for by his political donors due to gaps in campaign finance laws.
Just look at Trump’s home state of Florida, where Governor Ron DeSantis has personally guaranteed that the former president will be able to cast a ballot this fall. In stark contrast, Black Florida residents have been dragged from their homes at gunpoint and arrested for the "crime" of not realizing they were ineligible to vote .
It’s time to END this shameful double standard. Urge your members of Congress to co-sponsor and pass the Inclusive Democracy Act ASAP >> [https://act.commoncause.org/letters/tell-congress-end-shameful-double-standards-in-our-legal-system?source=090224swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pereles-for-mo-ad1?refcode=castles_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pereles-for-mo-ad1?refcode=castles_image]
You read that right. Gregory, against the vocal opposition of local preservationists, is planning to build a series of castle-like dwellings in Jefferson City for him and his family once he wins this election. Joe is focused squarely on talking with voters over the next seven weeks, not building castles in Jefferson City. And that’s exactly how and why we’re going to win this election.
We need your help to tell every voter in this district the stakes of this election. Flipping this seat red to blue is the key to turning our state around and protecting our rights and our freedoms for generations to come. Hi Derek, can
I tell you a quick story about this photo?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240918_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7597%2E5257348%2E2pz-SD ]Adam Schiff Harvard Law Graduation

That's me in 1985 — just 24 years old at my law school graduation, fresh
off a student research assistant job for Harvard Professor Laurence Tribe,
thinking that I had just completed the toughest challenge of my academic
career. Well, up to that point, anyway — the bar exam was still a few
weeks away!

Some years later, I would become an Assistant United States Attorney, and
successfully prosecute the first FBI agent charged with espionage, Richard
Miller, for spying for the Soviet Union.

As a new graduate of law school, I could never have imagined I would
handle a case like that.

Or that I would later investigate a president who also betrayed our country ...
...lead his impeachment and Senate trial...
...serve on the January 6 Committee...
...get kicked off the Intelligence Committee by a craven Speaker of the House
for doing the above...
...and get censured by extreme partisan MAGA House Republicans under the
personal threat of that corrupt president...

Life leads us in uncertain and fortuitous ways. I’m fortunate that at a
time when our country has been in trouble, and our democracy at risk, I
have been in a position to help do something about it.

I’ve always been deeply committed to serving our country, using my
position to make a difference in people’s lives every single day. Whether
securing funding to build affordable housing in my community or fighting
to defend our elections and the rule of law against a sore loser of a
former president, I will always fight for what’s fair and just and right.

In the Senate, I hope to do even more.

If you're able to, will you contribute
$10 to
help me reach the Senate, defend our majority, and defeat Trump? I would
be grateful for your help in continuing my service.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

| | Being a military spouse was hard.

Peter, this is April Cao. My husband Hung and I stayed together through two decades of deployments to the Middle East and Africa. I’m not going to lie, it was difficult having a loved one on the front lines in some of the most dangerous places on the planet.

But I knew the sacrifices were worth it because he was keeping the enemy at bay so our children would be safe at home.

| Peter, too many families are struggling to find safe and affordable housing.

As rent prices soar and homeownership becomes a distant dream for many, the housing crisis continues to affect our most vulnerable communities.

**I’ve seen firsthand the impact this crisis has on hardworking families who are forced to make impossible choices between paying rent and buying groceries or between affording childcare and keeping the lights on.**

_This is unacceptable, and it’s why I’ve made fighting for affordable housing a top priority._

I’ve been proud to support policies that would finance billions of dollars in new affordable housing construction and continue the fight to increase the minimum wage because no one working full-time should struggle to afford basic necessities.

That’s why I’ve introduced bills such as the Lifeline Act, which would make American Rescue Plan funds available for affordable housing developments receiving low-income housing tax credits.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Sharing my new op-ed with you

body:
I hope you’ll take a few minutes to read my op-ed about the state of gun violence in our country
#

Hi friends, it’s Gabby Giffords. I’m reaching out today in the hope that you’ll take a few minutes to read my op-ed published in _The New York Times_ this week. In light of multiple assassination attempts on the former president and recent mass shootings in Georgia and Kentucky, I thought it important to write this piece about the state of gun violence in our country.
[**Keep scrolling to read my op-ed, and if you’re able, please consider using this link to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC to fuel our work to end gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240918-1-60&t=1&akid=8971%2E3935704%2EYoxf9n)
**[contribute](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240918-1-60&t=2&akid=8971%2E3935704%2EYoxf9n)**
* * *
After every shooting, blame and rationalizations fly. I know, because I was shot in the head at a 2011 congressional event near my home in Tucson, Ariz. Eighteen other people were shot at that event, six of whom died. In the weeks that followed, there were all kinds of arguments as to why and how that could have happened. To me, only one rang true: Someone dangerous had access to a gun.
There have now been two assassination attempts on former President Donald Trump in just over two months. Two separate shooters, in possession of semiautomatic weapons, came terrifyingly close to inflicting great harm. But the through line here isn’t former President Trump. The through line isn’t the Secret Service. The through line isn’t heated rhetoric. The through line is, as it always is, the guns.
We are a country weary of repetitive gun violence. When that happens, you have a school shooting on a Wednesday and the country’s attention has moved on by Friday. You have a country where shootings on interstate highways appear to be a pattern and students in Kentucky miss several days of school during a manhunt for the perpetrator of the most recent interstate shooting. I imagine many people reading this right now might not even know about that shooting, or that manhunt, or those kids in Kentucky, doing schoolwork at home because it’s not safe to go to school.
Political rhetoric matters — but rhetoric wasn’t in the bushes around Mr. Trump’s golf course, or on the interstate in Kentucky, or in the school hallways in Georgia, or at the Trump rally in Butler, Pa. Dangerous people with guns were. The most recent would-be attack on the former president, on Sunday, is an indicator of where we are as a nation: a place where no one is safe from gun violence.
There’s no doubt that our political debate needs to cool down. We live in a participatory democracy with a wide range of opinions. We always have times when emotions are running hot; it’s inevitable.
What’s not inevitable is angry or inexplicably violent people having such easy access to guns. In Pennsylvania, a gunman too young to buy a beer nonetheless got his hands on a semiautomatic rifle. In Georgia, the high school shooting suspect was 14, and used an AR- 15-style rifle. In Kentucky, the suspected gunman reportedly sent a text message declaring his intention to “kill a lot of people” and then opened fire with an AR-15-style rifle. Nothing about these episodes was inevitable.
I didn’t grow up in a country with a lot of school shootings, or mass shootings generally. The gun industry was granted broad legal immunity by Congress in 2005 through the Protection of Lawful Commerce in Arms Act, a major contributing factor to the soaring number of gun sales. That was great for gun company profits, and terrible for public safety. With the saturation of guns and loosening of gun laws came, unsurprisingly, a saturation of violence. Gun deaths have skyrocketed since the gun industry received that immunity. So when Senator JD Vance, the Republican vice-presidential nominee, says school shootings are a “fact of life,” he should know: They weren’t a fact of life in this country until guns proliferated and loopholes in our laws allowed dangerous people to get them.
I am, at heart, a political moderate. I believe that successful governing requires a measure of moderation — pragmatic concessions that lead to the breakthroughs that move us forward. The value of moderation is that it allows us to find common purpose and to act on solutions. But moderation without action is merely a different kind of talk, and talk is not what’s wanted or needed now.
How can we tell Americans it’s safe to send their kids to school, to head to the grocery store, to attend concerts or houses of worship — or political events with their families — if we won’t acknowledge the danger that weak gun laws present, and won’t take reasonable steps to keep them secure? All over the country parents are having to answer their children’s questions about whether school is protected, about why these guns threaten their childhoods and their lives.
One thing I learned as a candidate and elected official myself was never to try to talk people out of their own reality. Americans know the dangers of gun violence. They see it in their communities and on their news every week. Now they’ve seen a heavily guarded former president as the target of gun violence twice in just over two months.
And Americans know the difference between action and inaction. Recent research from my gun violence protection organization, Giffords, found that 95 percent of likely voters in battleground House districts — including 91 percent of people who voted for Mr. Trump in 2020 — support background checks on all gun sales, which would make it harder for dangerous people to get guns. Seventy-four percent of those survey respondents support banning weapons like the AR-15 and the AK-style rifles, the weapons implicated in the events this week, last week and the week before.
I have fought so hard to recover from my grievous wounds. I’ve fought hard to work, to stand shoulder to shoulder with other survivors and demand different gun laws. I’ve worked so hard to find my voice — as hard as it is, as much as I struggle to find the right words — to share not just my story of violence but also my deep belief in the American people, that we can find a different, safer way of living.
It’s Monday morning as I write this. Earlier today, students threw books and papers into their backpacks, grabbed lunch or their water bottles and headed out to school. We have promised them safety, but how can we look them, or their parents, in the face and pretend that the answer is anything other than changing easy access to guns? Our path forward requires us all — leaders, voters, Americans — to name the problem clearly and to take action.

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=3&akid=8971%2E3935704%2EYoxf9n) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

| | **For Immediate Release:** September 18, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**VIDEO: DAVE MIN PLACES SEVEN FIGURE TV BUY**
_“California, Too” Highlights Baugh’s Extremist Agenda_
**IRVINE, CA** — This week, Dave Min’s campaign launched a new ad campaign bolstered by a seven figure buy across broadcast, cable, and streaming services. The spot gives viewers an eerie look into the extreme politics that Scott Baugh and his MAGA cronies would seek to implement if they were to hold control of the House this November.
Watch The Spot Here:

**[](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d4957ffbde&e=7017cc100e)**

_Across the country, women are being denied medical care.

Their lives pushed to death’s door as abortion is banned.

It’s happening in California, too.

And it will only get worse if Scott Baugh and MAGA extremists have their way. They want a national ban on abortion, and would punish doctors for providing women medical care.

No abortions. No exceptions. Not even in California.

Stop Scott Baugh, stop the MAGA extremists._ ###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=b1a3bb8452&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this_[ _“toss up”_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=bb9bfdeb6a&e=7017cc100e) _district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

Friend,

My name is Dr. Mary L. Trump. I never needed political pundits or psychologists to tell me that my uncle Donald should never get anywhere near the Oval Office.

I spent much of my childhood in the very house where Donald grew up. The cruel, weak, and deeply insecure man who brought our democracy to the brink of disaster is the same man I have always known. **The fight to defeat him and his cronies is personal for me.**

In 2022, I launched the Democracy Defense Fund to build a grassroots movement to secure our electoral system from Donald and the authoritarian traitors who seek to destroy it. **I’m about to go into detail about our plans for this critical election cycle —** [**but first, I have to ask, can I count on you to split $10 or more between Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats and DDF to ensure we have the resources to defeat Donald, defend the Senate, and flip the House this November?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51829?t=7&akid=22060%2E4449941%2EoJvI6L) | [DONATE »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51829?t=8&akid=22060%2E4449941%2EoJvI6L)
