Because of Donald’s grip on the Republican Party, it can be easy to forget what an electoral disaster he’s been. Just look at the midterm results of 2018 and 2022, or the 2020 election when a record 81 million people voted to oust him.

A lot of people are repulsed by him, and it’s clear why: This is the man who sent an army of violent insurrectionists to attack the Capitol; the man who rigged the Supreme Court to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ ; the man who will do anything to secure power and money for himself; the man I know is capable of so much worse.

**Our pro-democracy movement CAN defeat him. If you[split a gift of $10 or more today](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51829?t=9&akid=22060%2E4449941%2EoJvI6L), you’ll be helping to fund our efforts to:**
1. **Flip the House.** We’re supporting Congressional candidates committed to expanding voting rights and targeting Republicans who refused to certify the 2020 election.
2. **Save the Senate.** We’re fighting to keep a Democratic majority in the Senate, supporting those who are willing to get rid of the filibuster and approve Democrat-appointed judges — the last line of defense in protecting our right to vote.
3. **Take the fight to the States.** We’re investing in flippable down-ballot races that have the potential to impact the electoral certification process.
4. **Advance the issues we care about.** Whether it’s voting rights, health care, or common-sense gun control — we’re pushing for the policies and reforms that will build a better country.
5. **Protect democracy.** Hundreds of voter suppression bills have been introduced across the country in the last couple years. We’re punching back against these autocratic efforts.

My uncle has the backing of billions of dollars from dark money groups to try and sway the election his way. **But Donald can’t buy what we have — an army of people like you who are determined to protect our country and everything that we hold dear that he threatens.** [**Will you split a donation of just $10 or more right now between Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats and my org to support our pro-democracy movement?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51829?t=10&akid=22060%2E4449941%2EoJvI6L)

Peter,

Yesterday my opponent, Senator Wicker, cast yet another vote against women’s reproductive rights. This time, his vote was against a bill protecting IVF treatment from state-level bans.

**I firmly believe that every woman should have the autonomy to make her own healthcare choices, including those regarding fertility treatments like IVF.**

Senator Wicker’s ongoing attacks on women’s reproductive rights, particularly his vote against legislation to secure access to IVF yesterday, demonstrate that he is disconnected from the values of women in Mississippi.

As a veteran, I also know just how important quality family planning services are to families with members serving overseas. Fertility treatments like IVF allow our military members to start healthy, happy families after their service.

_The bottom line is that women throughout Mississippi are relying on leaders who will defend their right to make deeply personal healthcare decisions – not politicians who aim to impose their beliefs._

Senator Wicker’s vote yesterday exemplifies his disregard for the reproductive freedom and family planning options available to women in this state.

**Mississippi deserves better.**

As your next Senator, I am committed to fighting for legislation that protects reproductive rights, including access to IVF, contraceptive care, and abortion services.

[Will you work with me to defeat an extreme anti-choice incumbent by contributing $20, $10, or whatever you can to our campaign today? If you can afford it, split $10 with my campaign and Blue Amp Action right away. | | Dear Friend, I hope this message finds you well. Last month, I reached out on behalf of [Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93074292/499271874/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzZlNzE5OC1kZTc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VTtLyvZFyMoI4WSuOqDopDoL01OPNQgbyQgKhtUkSrc=&emci=6cf46a57-c375-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=e36e7198-de75-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=9512399) (BAF Action), a nonprofit committed to promoting democracy, transparency, and balanced politics. Today, I’m following up with an urgent and time-sensitive request. We have just 52 days before the election, and early voting starts soon. Mary Peltola, the first Alaska Native member of Congress, is facing Nick Begich III a Trump-aligned opponent in what will be a tough re-election. _Securing her seat is critical—not only for Alaska but for the entire country._ With Mary in Congress, we’re one seat closer to a Democratic majority, building a blue firewall to protect America from Project 2025, an extremist far-right agenda that could reshape our nation in dangerous ways. Project 2025 would:
* Use an 1870s law to limit abortion access nationwide
* Eliminate the Department of Education
* Force federal agencies to enforce a ‘biblically based’ definition of marriage and family
* Introduce a new national sales tax, costing the average family $2,500 per year
* Slash critical programs like Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid.

This agenda would be disastrous for Alaska and the country as a whole. _To combat it, Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund is dedicated to transparency, education, and protecting Alaska’s legacy of bipartisanship._ Mary Peltola stands for the same values, working across party lines for solutions that benefit all Alaskans. We need your immediate support to raise funds for a hyper-targeted digital ad campaign that will get Mary’s message out to voters. Every dollar counts. [Can we count on you to donate today?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93074293/499271875/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzZlNzE5OC1kZTc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VTtLyvZFyMoI4WSuOqDopDoL01OPNQgbyQgKhtUkSrc=&emci=6cf46a57-c375-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=e36e7198-de75-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=9512399) _Your contribution is essential in making sure we have the resources to fight back against extremist agendas like Project 2025 and to support leaders like Mary, who put Alaska first._ Every donation, no matter the amount, brings us one step closer to securing a better future for Alaska and America. Please don’t wait—[we need your support now to ensure Mary has the resources she needs to win.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93074294/499271876/1533895835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzZlNzE5OC1kZTc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VTtLyvZFyMoI4WSuOqDopDoL01OPNQgbyQgKhtUkSrc=&emci=6cf46a57-c375-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=e36e7198-de75-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=9512399) I know you are being asked to contribute to many important races, and if you are like me, you may be over your campaign budget for the year. But consider this: more than any other race in Alaska this year, Mary’s is an opportunity for Alaska to make a significant positive contribution to a productive Congress and protect our nation against an extremist takeover in DC. Thank you for your continued commitment to Alaska’s future. Let’s make sure Mary stays in Congress to fight for our state and against extremism. Sincerely, Fran UlmerFormer Lt. clean_body: If we do not take back the Senate, the consequences will be disastrous. | Fellow patriot, Senator Ron Johnson here. I am sure you know all about the race for the White House and the importance of winning, but today, I want to talk to you about something just as critical – the battle for the Senate majority. This year’s election is not just another political contest; it is a battle for the soul of this nation. Bernie Moreno is exactly the kind of fresh, bold voice we desperately need in Washington right now. While his opponent, Sherrod Brown, is a career politician with a 50-year record of championing radical Democrat policies, Bernie brings a new perspective as a political outsider who is committed to advancing a conservative agenda. Bernie Moreno is the exact opposite of his liberal Democrat opponent. He knows what it's like to build a successful business and he has lived the American dream. Now, he's running to protect it for future generations. If we do not take back the Senate, the consequences will be disastrous. We will be taxed to death, drowning in out-of-control spending, and helpless as the radical left tries to pack the Supreme Court and open our borders. The Democrats are determined to reshape America into something unrecognizable, and we cannot let them succeed. This is a tough race, and we’re up against the Democrats’ massive war chest. Thank you in advance for your help to take back the Senate, fire Sherrod Brown, and send Bernie Moreno to Washington to fight for us. Sincerely, Senator Ron Johnson Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. | | | Hello,As a fellow conservative, you likely already well know and feel the pressure that is being put upon you to abandon your principles by the progressives on the far left. You know that fighting back for what you believe in is the best thing to do.In these trying times, we conservatives must turn to the greatest document in the history of the world to promise freedom and opportunity to its citizens for guidance; **our Constitution.** That's why I'm writing today. I'd like to offer you the chance to gain **[free access to Heritage's Guide to the Constitution today to help you defend your principles against those on the far left.](http://trk.libertyledger.-EXsMpx0lZgJTj3eVd4tOA)**[](http://trk.libertyledger.)In this free digital interactive guide, you'll find:
* **Useful, clause-by-clause analysis** of the entire Constitution and each amendment
* Input from more than **100 constitutional scholars and legal experts** including President Reagan's former Attorney Ed Meese
* **A thorough review** of what the Constitution actually says and how it applies today
* **A copy of the Constitution** and the documents that served as its foundation

This is a critical year in our nation's history. The country is polarized and divided on a great number of issues, and roughly half of the voting population is being swayed towards greater government control over our lives--they want government-controlled health care, higher taxes and redistribution of wealth in the form of socialism, increased regulations, to do away with the Electoral College, and for open borders.It is for this reason that we need to educate as many people as possible, of all age groups, the freedoms promised to us in the Constitution.Because if we don't truly understand the freedoms that it promises to us as citizens, then we will not fight to defend those freedoms.To get your free access today and to help us make sure that everyone in the conservative movement has refreshed their understanding of the Constitution this year, will you activate your free access by clicking this link today? If so, please use this link to activate your access to the guide today: **[https://secured.heritage.org/constitution/](http://trk.libertyledger.)** This resource has been hailed across the nation as an "outstanding Guide," which is why I consider it one of the finest resources Heritage has ever produced. I think you'll enjoy reading it, and I know you'll find use for it each day.With this powerful Guide in hand, you'll be ready to stand up to the far-Left and confidently defend the vision of our Founding Fathers.[**I hope you'll claim your copy today.**](http://trk.libertyledger._Divwd7EA) Thank you,Tony JohnsonDirector of Membership

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93077350/499281309/665036969?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-09-18_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNkNjJhMzMzLWUyNzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=yd-xot16tKkQGYspkS3-88He7QNIsWJTGhA-024mdlU=)
---
Can I explain something, Peter?

I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.

**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**

Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.

I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.

The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.

Ohio Governor DeWine (also a Republican) reports that Springfield received at least 33 bomb threats in the last week in the aftermath of Trump's lies that Haitian immigrants are eating pets. Rather than retract his false statements, Donald Trump has continued to double down on this overt and grotesque racism. Vance, meanwhile, admits to [making up the story](https://substack.com/redirect/22b51e38-0460-4458-a0bc-dfd56a584f75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) but stands by his lie to "bring attention" to the immigration crisis.

## 2\. Racist Slurs from National Right Wing Media
The anti-Haitian hatred has also revealed the disparaging ways right wing media revels in describing Black people. Rich Lowry's interview this week on The Megyn Kelly Show exemplifies this point. Lowry is Editor-In-Chief of the National Review. During his interview with Kelly, he referred to Haitian migrants as "Haitian N-word."

> **Senator Kennedy:** Ms. Berry, Do you support Hamas?
> **Maya Berry:** No, I do not. Hamas is a designated foreign terrorist organization.
> **Senator Kennedy:** You just can't get yourself to say no, can you?
> **Maya Berry:** I just said no and it's disappointing that you would ask an Arab American Muslim women such hateful questions.
> **Senator Kennedy:** You should have your head in a bag!
[](https://substack.com/redirect/16ed922e-388d-4eb8-9859-0c5c790a9f8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This unhinged hate has consequences, as the murder of Wadea Al-Fayume proved. His murderer was Joseph Cuzba--a white man radicalized by white supremacist talking points that Arab Americans and Muslim Americans somehow support terrorism. Senator Kennedy did not seem to care about why the hearing on Wadea's murder was necessary in the first place, and defaulted to that exact same bigotry. Kennedy has, of coursed, faced zero consequences for his racism and hate.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6d70b4f2-7f5b-435e-9422-85f53fc153a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

None of the above examples of GOP racism are from decades ago. They're from literally days and hours ago. You can't actively alienate every growing bloc of the American electorate--Blacks, Latinos, the youth--and you can't depend solely on the single shrinking bloc of the electorate--Whites. And yet, four years later, I am again forced to reflect on a party that nominated the worst kind of people, like Richard Mourdock, and tried to win an election by appealing only to White people.
Can you guess who this prominent Republican is? It's none other than MAGA GOP Vice Presidential Candidate Senator JD Vance. The same man who referred to Trump as "America's Hitler," prior to becoming a Trump sycophant himself.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/66c50db2-2b0d-449c-b153-88fdda0c39a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

I don't expect any politician or party to be perfect--but I do expect media to hold accountable those who engage in overt bigotry, racism, and violence, as the above examples demonstrate. Peter,
The Stein/Ware campaign couldn’t be more humbled and honored by this endorsement from the Muslim American Public Affairs Council (MAPAC) of North Carolina! Please read their endorsement in full and [donate](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fund_pm_9_18&n=1) to help get the word out about the only anti-genocide campaign that has a path to the White House. We can put an end to the genocide on day one of a Stein/Ware administration. As Gaza goes, we all go.

**MAPAC Endorsement:** We are at a critical moment in our political journey, and Muslim American Public Affairs Council in North Carolina has taken a bold and necessary step to endorse Dr. Jill Stein and her running mate, Professor Butch Ware, in the upcoming presidential election. This decision is grounded in our values of justice, integrity, and the desire for real change in a two-party system that has consistently ignored our voices. Both Kamala Harris and Donald Trump have shown that they do not truly listen to the Muslim community or address our concerns. Despite widespread calls to stop funding the Israeli war on Gaza and to hold those responsible for atrocities accountable, our voices were silenced at the Democratic National Convention. Kamala Harris, in particular, has made it clear she will continue the current administration’s policies, which offer unconditional support to Israel, furthering the oppression of Palestinians. In contrast, Dr. Jill Stein has stood with us, amplifying the voices of the Muslim and Palestinian communities. Her actions speak louder than words, and her campaign, which includes a Muslim vice-presidential candidate, is committed to ending the violence funded by American tax dollars. She represents the courageous leadership we need, not only in foreign policy but in reforming our democracy. North Carolina, as a pivotal swing state, is leading the charge, and we urge other states to follow. This is a movement for justice and peace that can change the future of our country. body:

TELL CONGRESS: DEFEND OUR CLIMATE FROM POLLUTER-PUSHED ROLLBACKS

Backed by Big Oil and other corporate polluters, lawmakers are preparing to use
the Congressional Review Act (CRA) and policy riders in government funding bills
to attempt to overturn critical environmental safeguards that protect our health
and climate from harmful pollution.

Unlike other pieces of legislation, CRA votes can pass through Congress with a
simple majority vote in both chambers, which means that there’s a real threat
that these rollbacks could become law. And government funding runs out at the
end of September, so members are under pressure to approve a bill. We’re calling
on LCV members like you to tell Congress to vote NO on corporate polluters’
dirty agenda.

We’re aiming to deliver 5,000 petition signatures today — add your name right now >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_ TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv. Peter — in the past year, the Biden-Harris administration has rolled
out a series of important executive actions to clean up our air and water,
reduce climate pollution, and protect public lands from drilling, mining, and
other destructive industries. These actions will make a critical difference in the fight against climate
change — but there’s a narrow window of time when members of Congress can try to
block the Biden-Harris administration’s climate and environmental protections
through the Congressional Review Act (CRA) or when government funding runs out
at the end of September. The CRA allows Congress to overturn administrative actions like these with a
simple majority vote in both the House and Senate, and with narrow margins in
both chambers, just a few members of Congress will determine whether this effort
succeeds or fails. That means the outcome could come down to grassroots pressure from people like
you. Join thousands of LCV members who are writing to Congress today and urging their representatives to vote NO on corporate polluters’ dirty agenda. It only takes a moment to add your name and make your voice heard >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/qjPNcm8_N~ We have to act quickly: MAGA Republicans are pressing for a vote to overturn the
Biden-Harris administration’s actions to reduce toxic emissions and combat
climate change. Pro-polluter lawmakers are targeting limits on vehicle emissions and clean water
protections. We need a massive show of force from environmentalists like you to
avoid even more attacks on fundamental protections for our health and
environment. Take action right now: tell your members of Congress to vote NO on any Congressional Review Act resolution or policy rider that rolls back the progress we’ve made to protect our communities from pollution and climate change >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Zzb0MqP9~ Thank you for taking action, Peter. You're being lied to, Team. Plain and simple.
Time and again, it's been proven that noncitizens are not voting in our state or federal elections. All states -- across the country -- have multiple systems in place to stop attempted noncitizen voting. Noncitizens who violate the law face prison time and deportation.
Why is a major, partisan news network plus a major political party and multiple candidates lying about this? Because they want to scare you into voting for them and the anti-immigration nationalist movement.
What's worse? Every day people reach out to us, asking about lies regarding noncitizen voting, like how some states are paying for hotel rooms and busing in noncitizens to vote. It's all lies . It's been investigated and disproven over and over again by journalists and nonpartisan organizations -- noncitizens who try and vote are caught and convicted, and noncitizen votes don't count in federal and state elections.
The people who peddle these lies are trying to use you. They want your fear to control you and make you vote for their anti-democracy agenda, searching for safety in their controlling, suppressive, fascistic arms.

## **"**_Thurman waited in pain in a hospital bed, worried about what would happen to her 6-year-old son_ , as doctors monitored her infection spreading, her blood pressure sinking and her organs beginning to fail."
## "It took 20 hours for doctors to finally operate. By then, **_it was too late_.**"
Amber's death in August 2022 has been declared the first official death from an abortion ban. But hers is far from the only one – we've all read and heard the stories of women turned away from emergency rooms bleeding from miscarriages, patients forced to carry nonviable pregnancies until they're sick enough for doctors to terminate, 13-year-olds forced to carry their rapist's baby because the closest clinic is hundreds of miles away in another state. This is the hell women and girls are living under because of Donald Trump and Brian Fitzpatrick's abortion bans. And it's killing us. Amber Nicole Thurman should be alive today. And she isn’t because politicians like Trump and Fitzpatrick think they know better than women and our doctors. Amber’s blood – and the trauma of every woman and girl living under an abortion ban – is on their hands. When I joined the Army at 17, I knew I would be risking my life in combat to protect our freedoms. I never imagined I would have to protect them from politicians right here at home, too. But when I saw Fitzpatrick vote over and over again to restrict our reproductive freedoms, I knew my mission remained the same, it was just the location that changed. I got into this race to protect our freedoms in the halls of Congress, just like I did on the battlefield. **I'm running for Amber and Amanda Zurawski and Kaitlyn Joshua and Kate Cox and a 13-year-old girl in Mississippi also named Ashley. They deserve better. And so do you, my fellow patriot.** Thanks for being in this fight with me as my co-pilot, Ashley 🚁

Absentee ballots drop in two days, and our volunteers are just 1,000 voters short of the number we need to reach before they get their absentee ballots.

body:
We need to flip or hold these key chambers in November.
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93083231/499300023/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliZGUwYjMyLWU5NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cKYuhXXJT1-phfN2vVHZJQ1KTz9f_qsc0QXYbQmfHJg=&emci=833e2f08-dc75-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=9bde0b32-e975-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=8431045)
---

Peter, As someone who is interested in protecting democracy, you know that state legislatures can be _key_ to enacting new redistricting reforms, strengthening existing redistricting reforms, and providing a key check on Republican attempts to gerrymander. As part of our 2024 electoral strategy, we’ve identified states where we need to _flip or hold_ key chambers to help protect free and fair elections. **So many of these state-level races come down to just _hundreds_ of votes. **It means the work we do to reach and educate voters about the stakes of these races _really_ matters. [**Can you make a donation today to help safeguard democracy?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93083232/499300024/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambers_email_20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_campaign=StateChambers&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliZGUwYjMyLWU5NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cKYuhXXJT1-phfN2vVHZJQ1KTz9f_qsc0QXYbQmfHJg=) Let’s quickly review the strategy: **FOUR TO FLIP** | In four of our priority states, the Republican Party controls _both_ chambers of the state legislatures. With this kind of power, Trump’s MAGA allies have the opportunity to bring Project 2025 policies into our communities. [**Push back and flip seats →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93083233/499300025/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambers_email_20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_campaign=StateChambers&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliZGUwYjMyLWU5NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cKYuhXXJT1-phfN2vVHZJQ1KTz9f_qsc0QXYbQmfHJg=)
---
**New Hampshire:** Republicans have to defend _tiny_ majorities — _the House is considered a toss-up_ and the Senate is within reach. The Republican trifecta could redraw its congressional map at any moment, so a flip here is critical to put GOP gerrymandering to rest.
**Georgia:** Republicans have enacted extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. The _twenty-seven_ state legislature candidates we’ve endorsed as Democracy Defenders give us a real chance to gain real ground, lay the groundwork for more victories to come, and push back against GOP attacks on our democracy.
**Wisconsin:** Earlier this year, the Republican-drawn, gerrymandered legislative maps were struck down in court and now we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly and making gains in the State Senate — our best shot in a generation.
**Arizona:** Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in both the State House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can build power that can be used to strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
**TWO TO HOLD**
In two of our priority states, Democrats hold a trifecta of their state government, which means Republicans are doing everything they can to regain seats and undo progress. [**Hold the line and protect democracy →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93083234/499300026/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambers_email_20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_campaign=StateChambers&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliZGUwYjMyLWU5NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cKYuhXXJT1-phfN2vVHZJQ1KTz9f_qsc0QXYbQmfHJg=)
---
**Michigan:** Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission.
**Minnesota:** Democrats won a trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, *only* the full State House is on the ballot. Republicans only need to flip five seats to flip it back.
**ONE SPECIAL COMMONWEALTH**
And in one Commonwealth, we need to do both. [**Double down for fair maps →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93083235/499300027/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambers_email_20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_campaign=StateChambers&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliZGUwYjMyLWU5NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cKYuhXXJT1-phfN2vVHZJQ1KTz9f_qsc0QXYbQmfHJg=)
---
**Pennsylvania:** Here, Republicans control the State Senate and Democrats control the House. If we flip the Senate _and_ hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform.
***
Our state-by-state strategy relies on people like you who believe in safeguarding democracy. With under 50 days until the election, there’s never been a more impactful time to help create fair maps in these priority states. [**Will you chip in $30 right now to help power this critical work in races like these?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93083236/499300028/517417402?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_StateChambers_email_20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240918-NDRC-Tier1-StateChambers_&utm_campaign=StateChambers&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliZGUwYjMyLWU5NzUtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=cKYuhXXJT1-phfN2vVHZJQ1KTz9f_qsc0QXYbQmfHJg=)

clean_body: We need to flip or hold these key chambers in November. | Peter, As someone who is interested in protecting democracy, you know that state legislatures can be key to enacting new redistricting reforms, strengthening existing redistricting reforms, and providing a key check on Republican attempts to gerrymander. As part of our 2024 electoral strategy, we’ve identified states where we need to flip or hold key chambers to help protect free and fair elections. So many of these state-level races come down to just hundreds of votes. It means the work we do to reach and educate voters about the stakes of these races really matters. = Let’s quickly review the strategy: FOUR TO FLIP | In four of our priority states, the Republican Party controls both chambers of the state legislatures. With this kind of power, Trump’s MAGA allies have the opportunity to bring Project 2025 policies into our communities. = New Hampshire: Republicans have to defend tiny majorities — the House is considered a toss-up and the Senate is within reach. The Republican trifecta could redraw its congressional map at any moment, so a flip here is critical to put GOP gerrymandering to rest. Georgia: Republicans have enacted extreme voter suppression laws that target communities of color with despicable precision. The twenty-seven state legislature candidates we’ve endorsed as Democracy Defenders give us a real chance to gain real ground, lay the groundwork for more victories to come, and push back against GOP attacks on our democracy. Wisconsin: Earlier this year, the Republican-drawn, gerrymandered legislative maps were struck down in court and now we have a real chance at flipping the State Assembly and making gains in the State Senate — our best shot in a generation. Arizona: Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in both the State House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can build power that can be used to strengthen the state’s redistricting process. TWO TO HOLD In two of our priority states, Democrats hold a trifecta of their state government, which means Republicans are doing everything they can to regain seats and undo progress. = Michigan: Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. Minnesota: Democrats won a trifecta of their state’s government in 2022, but this year, only the full State House is on the ballot. Republicans only need to flip five seats to flip it back. ONE SPECIAL COMMONWEALTH And in one Commonwealth, we need to do both. = Pennsylvania: Here, Republicans control the State Senate and Democrats control the House. If we flip the Senate and hold the House, another Democratic trifecta will give us a route to redistricting reform. * Our state-by-state strategy relies on people like you who believe in safeguarding democracy. With under 50 days until the election, there’s never been a more impactful time to help create fair maps in these priority states. = Thank you, NDRC HQ = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1943%2E135344%2EL4qGIz)

Friend —
I want to take you behind the curtain of some very real decisions being made right now, ahead of our final FEC fundraising deadline, about our race in Michigan.
These are not the decisions WE are making.
The decisions I am talking about are being made in fancy glass conference rooms in tall buildings in Washington, D.C., where a handful of Republican strategists are taking stock of the Senate map and making decisions about where they can deploy their vast resources most effectively to flip a seat red.
And that is where our last end-of-quarter FEC fundraising deadline comes in on September 30th, when every candidate is legally obligated to report how much money they have raised and how much they have spent.
You see, one of the key pieces of data that GOP super PACs will be looking at is the strength of our fundraising. It will give them an indication of our support and our ability to fight back if they spend additional dark money on our race.
There are certainly clear indications that they are zeroing in on Michigan. New TV ad reservations. Stray comments about internal polling. Articles in Fox News suggesting that we are vulnerable. CNN has said we are 4th most likely to flip. And an upwards of $20 million already spent in super PAC attack ads against me.
It may not seem like a big deal from the outside, but they serve almost as a bat signal to outside organizations: spend here.
We are looking to file a strong report, not only so that we can fight back when these conservative organizations flood the state with ads, but also to try to deter them with our strength and have them invest those dollars somewhere else. So I am asking: [**will you chip in $3 to help us file a strong report at the end of the quarter? It’s not so much the amount that you donate, but that you donate.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240918-2-900&t=2&akid=1943%2E135344%2EL4qGIz)

body:
Hello All:

I hope this email finds you well. We have some opportunities to help us win this election in the next two weeks.

Here are the items we need help with,** please email me back or text me at (419) 231-1111 to RSVP:**

**_September 21 Perrysburg Homecoming Parade_**

**When:** (9AM Line-UP) 10AM Step Off Saturday September 21st
**Where:** Number 15—W 5th Near Louisiana in Perrysburg close address: 109 W 5th St, Perrysburg, OH 43551
**Need:** We need volunteers to wear Derek Merrin shirts and pass out notepads along the route.

**_September 25 Phone Bank_**
**What:** Phone Bank
**When:** Wednesday September 25th 5:30PM to 7:30PM
**Where:** Lucas County Republican Headquarters, 1306 Kittle Rd Holland, OH 43528
**Need:** We need volunteers to make calls to targeted voters interested in more information on Derek Merrin. Volunteers will use an app on their phones, and it is recommended that you bring a charged phone, phone charging cable and or ear buds with a microphone. Headsets will be available as well.

Volunteers will use an app on their phones, and it is recommended that you bring a charged phone, phone charging cable and or ear buds with a microphone. Headsets will be available as well.

Holland, OH 43528

Volunteers will use an app on their phones, and it is recommended that you bring a charged phone, phone charging cable and or ear buds with a microphone. Headsets will be available as well.

**_OTHER OPPORTUNITIES TO HELP ----WE NEED:_**
-Letter writers

All of these items can be done at your own convenience as well. Reach out and we will work out how to get you involved!

Justin Barnhart

NRCC-OH09

name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Amber Thurman would still be alive if not for Trump's abortion ban
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Amber Thurman was a young single mom with a beautiful little boy who was the light of her life. She had just moved into a new apartment in a better neighborhood and was making plans to go to nursing school. Her whole life was ahead of her.
But two weeks after Georgia imposed a strict new 6-week abortion ban, Amber Thurman was dead.
Amber died from sepsis – a life-threatening infection – after doctors delayed performing a routine procedure called a dilation and curettage (D&C) needed to clear out her uterus out of fear of violating Georgia’s abortion ban.
Because of Georgia’s MAGA-backed abortion laws, doctors hesitated for 20 critical hours . By the time they acted, it was too late.
Make no mistake: Amber’s death was a direct result of the kind of dangerous, extremist legislation that Jim Jordan and ULTRA-MAGA Republicans want to impose nationwide.
I’ve already shared Jordan’s 3 attempts at introducing his extreme abortion laws. At the time they were too extreme for his colleagues, but who knows what the future holds if he and other ULTRA-MAGA Republicans take office.
We know Jim Jordan WILL pass a national abortion ban if given the chance , and Donald Trump would absolutely sign it into law. Our only hope of stopping them is to kick these controlling maniacs out of power.
Getting Jim Jordan out of power has to be a top priority for all Americans. We’re closing in fast on $2M raised and we’re already polling in a statistical tie. I need your help to blanket the district with ads to make sure every voter here knows how Jordan is working against all of us. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240918_abortion_message_link1]
Amber’s tragic story hits me like a gut punch. As a single mom myself, it breaks my heart to think of her son growing up without his mommy.
But Jim Jordan doesn’t care how many women like Amber get hurt by his extreme agenda.
This is the same man who mocked a 10-year-old rape victim right here in Ohio when she was forced to flee the state for a life-saving abortion just weeks after Roe was overturned. (And yes, the same Jim Jordan who turned his back on his students at OSU when they were being sexually abused by their doctor.)
His cruelty truly knows no bounds.
This is not about faith or values. He is a typical abuser, it’s all about him and control. Jim Jordan is willing to sacrifice women’s lives to maintain his power.
This is not a fight we can sit out, and that’s why I need your help today.
This is the most important congressional race in the country, and with your support, we can make sure Jim Jordan’s extremist agenda is stopped in its tracks. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240918_abortion_message_link2]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240918_abortion_message_button1]
Together, we can build a future where women are respected, doctors and patients, not politicians, make healthcare decisions, and every mother has the right to live her life without fear.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

Yesterday, Donald Trump held a town hall in Flint. A few hours earlier, J.D. Vance spoke in West Michigan at a rally in Kent County. These should have been opportunities to bring people together or offer a plan for our state and our country.
Instead, Trump did what has become typical for his events: he ranted about crowd size at his rallies, bragged about his relationships with Kim Jong Un, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin, and repeated the lie that the 2020 election was unfair.
Vance was no better, suggesting that Kamala Harris was leading us all on a “path to slavery.”
This is Trump’s 10th visit to Michigan since he launched his 2024 presidential campaign. And it won’t be the last time we see him here.
Because Trump, Vance, and Republicans know what we know: If Trump loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the race is tight. At the top of the ticket, and for my race for Senate. And everyone knows it will come down to the wire.
Trump’s visit is part of a clear strategy to throw their resources at Michigan. If you watch even a few minutes of TV here you’ll see millions of dollars of attack ads on a non-stop loop.
The latest polls show our state is virtually tied — for both the presidential and the Senate races. Political forecaster Nate Silver’s recently published analysis said not only that Michigan is a “pure toss-up” but also that there may be no state more important than Michigan in this election.
But we are not powerless. We can impact the outcome of the races in this state.
Want to help? Chip in what you can to my campaign and Tim Kaine and help send a message that Michigan is sure as hell not ready to swing back to Trump. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]

freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Friends-
This International Equal Pay Day, we are acknowledging that the barriers against equal pay for women are more than just a lack of equitable salaries. Women are much more likely to take on unpaid caregiving roles, making up 60% of caregivers in the United States [https://nationalpartnership.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/female-face-family-caregiving.pdf] . Female caregivers are more likely to live in poverty, losing an average of $324,000 in wages over their lifetimes [https://www.homecaregenerations.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/02/study.pdf] .
https://www.axios.com/local/washington-dc/2024/08/19/paid-family-leave-dc-maryland-virginia [https://www.axios.com/local/washington-dc/2024/08/19/paid-family-leave-dc-maryland-virginia]
Right now, 3.4 million Virginia workers [https://nationalpartnership.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/paid-leave-means-a-stronger-virginia.pdf] have no guarantee that they won’t miss a critical paycheck when taking time off to care for themselves or a loved one, paychecks that could be crucial to providing the care their families need.
It’s time for Virginia to take care of its caregivers; that’s why we’re fighting for paid family and medical leave in our commonwealth. Paid family and medical leave would create an insurance program that would provide up to 12 weeks of paid leave, giving Virginians the time and funds they need to keep themselves and their families safe and healthy.
No one should have to choose between caring for their loved ones and a paycheck.
Natalie Jones
Communications Manager

# [Weird](https://public-api.wordpress.com/bar/?stat=groovemails-events&bin=wpcom_email_click&redirect_to=http%3A%2F%2Fbethfarnhamforcongress.com%2F2024%2F09%2F18%2Fweird%2F&sr=0&signature=b7dab69343ec476c2f3070b22be48f8b&blog_id=213069660&user=248418217&_&_z=z)
| | By **Elizabeth Farnham** on September 18, 2024
---|---
_This Op-Ed was published in the Gettysburg Connection on August 30, 2024._
(Photo credit: Everett Historical Society, subject: Johnstown Flood 1889)
As I sat eating delicious scrambled eggs at the John Murtha Johnstown - Cambria County Airport while waiting for my opponent, Representative John Joyce, to speak, I wondered - what does this dermatologist from Altoona say to keep the good people of Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District voting against their own interests and putting him into a Washington, D.C. office?
I observed him from across the room. In his usual suit-jacket-and-unbuttoned-oxford-shirt-sans-tie, he stood around, speaking quietly with members of Cambria’s Regional Chamber of Commerce (CCRC) whose Governmental Action Committee (GAC) had invited him, not me, to speak. In a change from years past, and pretty much any other political forum ever, the CCRC decided to host separate fora for us candidates “this year.” Well, that was certainly better than Blair County’s Chamber of Commerce who was rumored to forgo the forum this year in order not to “anger the congressman.” So I sat respectfully with other women who had also breakfasted at the table closest to the podium, and he never introduced himself to us, his constituents.
What was I expecting exactly - that he would acknowledge our humanity? Silly me. It’s not like he respected our valid Pennsylvania electoral votes when, in a blatant attempt to trash them, he signed the Texas Amicus Brief in December 2020. In refusing to certify them on January 7th, 2021 after Trump’s violent insurrection, I believe he broke his oath to the U.S. Constitution. And he certainly didn’t respect our agency over our own bodies when he voted against the Women’s Health Protection Act and cosponsored the unscientific Life at Conception Act, so why would I expect him to ever approach us and shake our hands?
After an introduction by Greg Winger, chair of the CRCC GAC, Representative Joyce was off! In a pleading voice and at a breakneck speed that seemed beyond what one would choose for others to take in, he tumbled out many, many words, but his theme of “Us versus Them” broke through. He began by noting how his family had lived in the area for generations, then detoured through his wife’s childhood. Yet, I couldn’t help but contrast his ancestral fervor to the faraway origins of the greatest advocate Johnstown had ever known - former Representative, and Democrat, John Murtha - after whom the airport where Rep. Joyce was speaking at that very moment, was named. To the people of Johnstown who also named Route 219, various cancer centers and university buildings, in addition to other treasured locales after the longstanding congressman, it didn’t matter that he was born and primarily raised in West Virginia and later, Westmoreland County. It mattered what Murtha did for Johnstown.
But Joyce doesn’t do for Johnstown like Murtha did. In fact it’s quite the opposite. While there are grumbles about how and when to use the rare windfall of funds from the Infrastructure Investments and Jobs Act, the America Rescue Plan Act, and the Inflation Reduction Act, the fact is, Representative John Joyce voted against all three. Sure, board members of the Vision Works 2025, local business owners, and politicians had been questioned repeatedly about when and how the funding will be implemented for projects in and around Johnstown - some of those people were at that very breakfast - but had any of them, or any other voters from Johnstown, ever considered that the funding wouldn’t be there if more members of Congress had voted like Representative Joyce?
I turned back to his speech. Having established the “Us” in his narrative, he moved on to the “Them,” and they were, unsurprisingly...immigrants. According to him, “we all are a border state” and by extension immigrants are just bearing down on us with their crime and fentanyl, which he noted for its extra foreignness because, he claimed, “the ingredients are made in China.” Nevermind that the U.S. Customs and Border Patrol who are on the frontlines of this illegal trade state on their website that fentanyl, “oftentimes enters the U.S. through common trade pathways, such as air cargo and express courier...these shipments can be declared as legitimate goods because some do have a legitimate purpose.” No, Representative Joyce has decided that immigrants who seek asylum from persecution are to blame and so he went down to the border on our tax money and...and...“touched bags of fentanyl”?
Weird.
The rest of his speech was a plea for us to believe that he is just a bi-partisian politician, looking out for our health even though he recently voted with 45 other extremists for Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene’s amendment to defund NATO and he’s “proud” to be endorsed by convicted felon Trump. Perhaps, the good people of PA-13 haven’t been paying attention, but the truth is, he doesn’t represent us and I’m running so he never will again.

(Photo credit: Everett Historical Society, subject: Johnstown Flood 1889) As I sat eating delicious scrambled eggs at the John Murtha Johnstown - Cambria County Airport ... | or | | | or ---|---|--- | | By Elizabeth Farnham on September 18, 2024 ---|--- This Op-Ed was published in the Gettysburg Connection on August 30, 2024. (Photo credit: Everett Historical Society, subject: Johnstown Flood 1889) As I sat eating delicious scrambled eggs at the John Murtha Johnstown - Cambria County Airport while waiting for my opponent, Representative John Joyce, to speak, I wondered - what does this dermatologist from Altoona say to keep the good people of Pennsylvania’s 13th Congressional District voting against their own interests and putting him into a Washington, D.C. office? I observed him from across the room. In his usual suit-jacket-and-unbuttoned-oxford-shirt-sans-tie, he stood around, speaking quietly with members of Cambria’s Regional Chamber of Commerce (CCRC) whose Governmental Action Committee (GAC) had invited him, not me, to speak. In a change from years past, and pretty much any other political forum ever, the CCRC decided to host separate fora for us candidates “this year.” Well, that was certainly better than Blair County’s Chamber of Commerce who was rumored to forgo the forum this year in order not to “anger the congressman.” So I sat respectfully with other women who had also breakfasted at the table closest to the podium, and he never introduced himself to us, his constituents. What was I expecting exactly - that he would acknowledge our humanity? Silly me. It’s not like he respected our valid Pennsylvania electoral votes when, in a blatant attempt to trash them, he signed the Texas Amicus Brief in December 2020. In refusing to certify them on January 7th, 2021 after Trump’s violent insurrection, I believe he broke his oath to the U.S. Constitution. And he certainly didn’t respect our agency over our own bodies when he voted against the Women’s Health Protection Act and cosponsored the unscientific Life at Conception Act, so why would I expect him to ever approach us and shake our hands? After an introduction by Greg Winger, chair of the CRCC GAC, Representative Joyce was off! In a pleading voice and at a breakneck speed that seemed beyond what one would choose for others to take in, he tumbled out many, many words, but his theme of “Us versus Them” broke through. He began by noting how his family had lived in the area for generations, then detoured through his wife’s childhood. Yet, I couldn’t help but contrast his ancestral fervor to the faraway origins of the greatest advocate Johnstown had ever known - former Representative, and Democrat, John Murtha - after whom the airport where Rep. Joyce was speaking at that very moment, was named. To the people of Johnstown who also named Route 219, various cancer centers and university buildings, in addition to other treasured locales after the longstanding congressman, it didn’t matter that he was born and primarily raised in West Virginia and later, Westmoreland County. It mattered what Murtha did for Johnstown. But Joyce doesn’t do for Johnstown like Murtha did. In fact it’s quite the opposite. While there are grumbles about how and when to use the rare windfall of funds from the Infrastructure Investments and Jobs Act, the America Rescue Plan Act, and the Inflation Reduction Act, the fact is, Representative John Joyce voted against all three. Sure, board members of the Vision Works 2025, local business owners, and politicians had been questioned repeatedly about when and how the funding will be implemented for projects in and around Johnstown - some of those people were at that very breakfast - but had any of them, or any other voters from Johnstown, ever considered that the funding wouldn’t be there if more members of Congress had voted like Representative Joyce? I turned back to his speech. Having established the “Us” in his narrative, he moved on to the “Them,” and they were, unsurprisingly...immigrants. According to him, “we all are a border state” and by extension immigrants are just bearing down on us with their crime and fentanyl, which he noted for its extra foreignness because, he claimed, “the ingredients are made in China.” Nevermind that the U.S. Customs and Border Patrol who are on the frontlines of this illegal trade state on their website that fentanyl, “oftentimes enters the U.S. through common trade pathways, such as air cargo and express courier...these shipments can be declared as legitimate goods because some do have a legitimate purpose.” No, Representative Joyce has decided that immigrants who seek asylum from persecution are to blame and so he went down to the border on our tax money and...and...“touched bags of fentanyl”? Weird. The rest of his speech was a plea for us to believe that he is just a bi-partisian politician, looking out for our health even though he recently voted with 45 other extremists for Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene’s amendment to defund NATO and he’s “proud” to be endorsed by convicted felon Trump. Perhaps, the good people of PA-13 haven’t been paying attention, but the truth is, he doesn’t represent us and I’m running so he never will again. | | | | | Beth Farnham for Congress © 2024. your email settings or unsubscribe. | | | | Get the Jetpack app Subscribe, bookmark, and get real‐time notifications - all from one app! | | | | ---|--- | | | | Automattic, Inc. 60 29th St. #343, San Francisco, CA 94110 |

| | **NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| Friends and Neighbors,

I want to thank you for your unwavering trust and support as I serve as your State Representative! The last few weeks have been very busy for me as I’ve been out in the district, attending events and getting to know more about how I can make Florida and House District 24 even better. I’m very proud of what we’ve accomplished, and I look forward to the work ahead of us in order to keep our state the Free State of Florida for generations to come.

If there is something I can do for you, please do not hesitate to contact my office. I want to work with you to build a brighter future for Florida and our district. You can get in touch with my office by [clicking here](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=5ce45b2551&e=d1c1b9864f).**** We would be more than happy to assist you in any way we can!
---
| | **Tuesday, September 3 - Heritage Trail Park Ribbon Cutting**
---
|
---
---
| My staff had the opportunity to attend the ribbon cutting for the newest trailhead in Ocala, **Heritage Trail Park**. Located on the west side of Ocala, this trail displays historic images honoring the area’s prominent citizens who have made a big impact on our community.
---
| | **Friday, September 6 - Congratulations to My Son, Rey!**
---
|
---
| I had an amazing time with family and friends celebrating the marriage of my son Rey and my new daughter-in-law, Maddie. Congratulations to them both!
---
| | **Wednesday, September 11 - 9/11 Memorial Services**
---
|
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| It was a privilege to join the community and fellow Marion County leaders for the **9/11 Memorial Service 23rd Anniversary Program**. Many incredible speakers memorialized the horrendous acts that took place on September 11, 2001, including **Marion County Commissioners Michelle Stone** , **Kathy Bryant** , and **Matt McClain** ; **Marion Sheriff Billy Woods** , **Marion County Fire Chief James Banta** , **Mayor Ben Marciano** , and more. Also in attendance were **Representative McClain** , **Ocala Councilman Ire Bethea** , **Marion School Board Members Eric Cummings** and **Lori Conrad** , and community members who lost someone special on 9/11.
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| That evening, in **Belleview** , I spoke at the**2024 Freedom Walk** alongside **Belleview Mayor Christine Dobkowski** and **Sgt. Mike Miley** from the **Belleview Police Department**. The talented **Belleview High School Chamber Singers** opened the ceremony with the National Anthem and “God Bless America.” Many in our community can still recall exactly where they were when they heard the news that the **World Trade Center** had been attacked. It is a memory that will stay with those who lost someone or witnessed the horrific events of that day forever. Even though this was an incredibly dark day for the United States, the American people showed their true strength by coming together to comfort and help one another.
---
| | **Thursday, September 12 - Meeting with the Marion County Public Schools CFO**
---
|
---
| I had the opportunity to meet with the **Marion County Public Schools CFO** to have a better understanding of how the school budget works. The way money is spent through our school board has been questioned by many for so long, so I wanted the opportunity to ask questions and get an understanding of how the funding is allocated.
---
| | **Thursday, September 12 - Launching of the Matching Funds Capital Campaign at the Hospice of Marion County Center**
---
|
---
| I was also honored to attend an event for the launching of the **Matching Funds Capital Campaign for the Nancy Renyhart Dementia Education Program** at the **Hospice of Marion County Center**. The Hospice of Marion County Foundation will match donations up to $500,000, doubling the impact of the contributions they receive. This will go toward funding the construction of a facility designed to expand their community outreach and impact around the North Central Florida area. [Dementia Education - Empath Hospice of Marion County](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=33158fc73f&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | **Thursday, September 12 - Arnette House Open House**
---
|
---
---
| Finally, my staff attended an open house event at the **Arnette House**. They had the opportunity to tour the facility, meet some of the staff and kids, and learn more about what the Arnette House does in our community. They have had an incredible impact on youth and families throughout Marion County. [Click here to learn more about this wonderful organization.](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=c02e0a9258&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
|
---
| | Thank you for reading, and I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

May God bless you and the Free State of Florida!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

**FROM THE DESK OF CONRAD BLACK** **You may already know that I spent most of my career in publishing and helped build the third largest newspaper company in the western world.**

We published over 400 titles, including the London Daily Telegraph, Chicago Sun Times, Jerusalem Post, Spectator, and most of the leading newspapers in Canada and Australia.

**I am proud to have also been one of the founders of the modern New York Sun, and believe that now, more than ever, it is a paper that is uniquely suited for this moment of crisis in journalism.**

Too many journalists are not only failing to live up to public expectations but are actively abusing public trust. Instead of policing the powerful on behalf of the public, they police the public on behalf of the powers they favor.

**The New York Sun has never lost sight of who it serves.** It's a patriotic newspaper that places principle over politics and people over party. That is why I am happy to be a weekly contributor to it. It maintains the highest professional standards without being pedantic or boring. It's a community where I am proud to belong.

The Sun is a lone voice among a sea of major publications owned by multi-billion-dollar corporations that generally try to stifle dissent.

**The only one way the Sun can win is if we all join in its effort.** Collectively we cannot be overwhelmed by any media conglomerate or oppressive, woke, media groupthink. The Sun has long advocated on our behalf. Now, if we join the Sun's movement to restore American journalism, we will be unstoppable.

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

| | Peter, we are beyond excited to invite you to join **Madam Vice President Kamala Harris** and the legendary **Oprah Winfrey** for an extraordinary **Unite for America Livestream Event!** 📅 Mark your calendars for **Thursday, September 19 at 8 PM ET**.

This event is more than just a conversation. It is a call to action for voters to come together, support **Vice President Kamala Harris** , and work toward a future rooted in equality and progress. You'd think I'd be used to it by now. But just when you think the News Media can't sink any lower... they surprise me.

| |

---
| | | I've spent more years in Washington than I care to admit.

You'd think I'd be used to it by now. But just when I think the News Media can't sink any lower... they surprise me.

September 15th was a horrible day for our country. I thanked God Almighty for protecting President Trump a second time. I prayed hard for Trump's Family and for our country that day. And every day since.

The Media, on the other hand, took a different tone.
_Politico made sure to report "Republicans outraged" over it.

The Washington Post described it as a "golf course episode."_
_MSNBC even had the gall to suggest Trump was to blame for not "toning down the rhetoric." _
I'm fuming. Our News Media has fallen so far from grace. It has NEVER been more clear their sole motive is to drag Conservatives through the mud and help Democrats win elections.

**_[That's why it's incumbent on ALL OF US to stand up to them.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=87f4ca971a0b49edb6e5f2bd05aedd3a&_e=zdyyz5KPfOtWk6r8p6_dq7PINTsGcerWB3R22MbaYNcGbZXfatqlNGcBPvRgZOD5zqUcTFgzFjM2-E8Va4zVbDZVRwmvljl94STIaQFNKHbDqBnzjNBItAlJMtW6oF-3Ksoc-ej7ixhxw3l93UYtnGj53GrS47C0o7xAxLCHTYcS6bUvWNmg-bT31hZP34epvo4Fd-rLl5qeBpmc32jv1YWyPfY0Ev0nKMnpNZN-hE9BTEvDEQ-jaY8JOcLkmZGlY9c9A8kne-a_YuNJqUuxWHsNww70uPb2pBKJOTc2G_ZuYKbMBcYwD9_eqf8Zr-W-58hSCsFXfonRRf4OpMF0rIaFsBdS1NFMU-R928ve3JoWR3qTBSqqiyfVwFQYYfddw1nevikuD9DtWJXRPK1qlUHzRk5UtNzUoIJqFzf4VN1g94IEMAcXL8Y3qtvJIh60U3W31oFeCSxJwf75LCHnRQ%3D%3D "That’s why it’s incumbent on ALL OF US to stand up to them. name: Andrea Salinas
subject: three numbers you should know
body:
Let me be clear about this: I’m certainly not panicking.

| | Peter, my team and I just walked through some of the math we’re up against as we try to hold down this battleground seat here in OR-06. Let me be clear about this: I’m certainly not panicking. (I’m never panicking, Peter, and if I were, the first thing I’d do is talk to my family, not send out a campaign email.) But there’s no escaping the conclusion that we need more grassroots support to win this race. [_**I’ll walk you through the math below, but if you already know you’re with me and you’re able to help, here’s a link to split whatever amount feels right for you between Becca Balint and me →**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93086954/499313206/-2127437632?&refcode=E10533-20240918-SalinasSplit-SL-SplitSend&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDE5NzgwYy1mNzc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tozgBjf4HOwRyMU1VZK-KaHSgPvRA95l-6yE0aRcA3k=) **[Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93086956/499313207/-2127437632?&refcode=E10533-20240918-SalinasSplit-SB-SplitSend&amount=27&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDE5NzgwYy1mNzc1LWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRlZTY2ODEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tozgBjf4HOwRyMU1VZK-KaHSgPvRA95l-6yE0aRcA3k=)** So, the math. **The first number:** $5,500,000. That’s how much money just ONE of the many GOP super PACs targeting this seat just reserved in airtime in our media market. That’s enough to pay for nonstop attack ads against me this fall. **The second number** : $2,767,350. That’s how much money my MAGA opponent gave to his own campaign in 2022 to try to defeat me — and you can bet he’ll throw even more money into this rematch. **The third number:** 7,210. That’s how many votes we won by in 2022. Not very many in a district that’s home to over 700,000 people. In fact, it was such a nail-biter that we didn’t even know if I’d won or lost until several days after the election. I’m not telling you this because I want you to feel worried or, worse, hopeless about this election. I’m telling you this because I truly believe we can win this race — but I know that the only way to do it is by growing our grassroots war chest, dollar by dollar. name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Criteria for Choosing Our Leaders
body:
Responding To A Biblical Call For Justice | |
---
| | | As evangelical Christians, one of our chief criteria for evaluating and choosing our leaders are the teachings of Jesus calling us to help the vulnerable. As I shared in my op-ed in _The Hill [Why I am an evangelical for Harris](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=01ec62169b&e=43463f1dee)_:

_...personal charity is commendable but is no substitute for biblical justice, which is rooted both in God’s love for everyone and the biblical assertion that we are all made in the image of God. __These ideas undergird our belief as citizens that we are all created equal._

_In a representative democracy like ours, it is the people who are ultimately sovereign. We are, effectively, like the kings of Israel and Judah. The prophets called them and all those in power to establish justice, to see that everyone had what they need to live the lives God intended for them — because God loves them._

**_That’s why there is a special concern for the vulnerable and powerless in society — the widow, the orphan, the stranger. In Matthew 25, Jesus so completely identifies with them that he says that what we do — or don’t do — to them we do or don’t do to him (Mt. 25:31-45). Furthermore, Jesus expressly says that it is what we do unto the “least of these” — the hungry, thirsty, foreigner, sick, prisoner, and those so poor they can’t afford clothes — that will determine how we are judged._**

**__Vice President Harris has said that the parable of the Good Samaritan inspires and guides her public service, that it is about loving others. _Matthew 25 lets us in on a little secret: we are to see the vulnerable man in the ditch that the Samaritan helped as Jesus himself_** _._

**_Given this biblical understanding, we dare not separate love from justice; indeed, we cannot, because justice comes from love._**

Among her policies to protect the vulnerable and promote the wellbeing of our children, **Vice President Harris is calling for a renewed expansion of the Child Tax Credit, which was one of the primary Biden-Harris policies that** **lifted 7.3 million children from poverty – an historic achievement.** Republicans refused to extend the expansion of this program. Harris has proposed to renew this expansion and add to it a $6,000 tax cut to families with newborn children.

Read more about [other criteria for evaluating our next president](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=6d3bdf16ac&e=43463f1dee). If any of these are of concern to you – helping the vulnerable, character, family, democracy, and the rule of law, then [**join us in pledging to support Vice President Harris**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=ae57cd62a8&e=43463f1dee). We’re praying for you.

Rev. Jim Ball, Ph.D.
Founder and Chair
Evangelicals for Harris

A 394-acre tract along the Russian River, home to the iconic Clar Tree—a rare old-growth redwood towering at 278 feet—will be forever protected from development. 🌿

Located near Guerneville, this majestic tree, with a 16-foot circumference, miraculously survived 19th-century logging and will now stand tall for future generations.

clean_body: News from the League | September 18, 2024 | Sonoma Coast Redwoods This is our moment: A rare opportunity to collectively protect a stunning stretch of California coast from development. The 1,624-acre Sonoma Coast Redwoods property is the missing link that will connect wildlife habitat, build fire resilience, and expand outdoor recreation for everyone who loves the redwoods and the sea. Fighting fire with fire In the Sierra Nevada, Indigenous tribes are rekindling cultural burning—a practice banned in California for more than 100 years. Learn how this ancestral tradition could help threatened giant sequoias survive in an era of mega-fires. Vote YES This November, Californians can choose a better climate future by voting Yes on Prop 4—a bond measure that will lock in reliable funding for redwood forest protection, wildfire prevention, and clean, safe water for all. Supporter spotlight Building on a family legacy, Lisa Weger worked with the League to protect 3,862-acre Weger Ranch in Mendocino County. “As a result of my upbringing, I have always believed that I am the steward, not the owner,” said Weger of this special place. Got field trips? Does your community, school, or non-profit seek to introduce young people to the redwoods? Apply for a Redwood Connect Grant before the October 18 deadline and help bring the wonder of the big trees to the next generation. Podcast Artist, educator, and naturalist Elexis Padrón shares her personal philosophy on building a relationship with the natural world—and walks us through the exciting new Arts in California Parks program. | | Instagram Post of the Month ---|--- | | ---|--- 🌲 Victory for conservation! A 394-acre tract along the Russian River, home to the iconic Clar Tree—a rare old-growth redwood towering at 278 feet—will be forever protected from development. 🌿 Located near Guerneville, this majestic tree, with a 16-foot circumference, miraculously survived 19th-century logging and will now stand tall for future generations. 🔗Link in bio. 📷 @vivian.p.chen THE LEAGUE IN THE NEWS Press Democrat SiliconValley.com SF Chronicle Support our work Connect with us | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States |

At Leaders We Deserve, we don’t do this work for glory or recognition. That said, it’s always a good thing when we can get our message and our mission in front of even more people – so I was glad to see this recent write-up about our success.
**[If you’re already with us in the fight to elect the next generation of bold leaders who will fight for our progressive values, will you pitch in $5 right now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240918?refcode=em20240918&amount=5&refcode2=1195_587540_ELmL2x&akid=1195%2E587540%2EELmL2x)**
The new article from _The Trace_ tells the story of how David Hogg, a survivor of the Parkland school shooting, and Kevin Lata, Rep. Maxwell Frost’s former campaign manager, launched Leaders We Deserve to elect young progressive candidates.
It highlights some of the notable folks on our Advisory Board, like Arne Duncan, former Education Secretary for President Barack Obama, who had this to say:
**[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240918?refcode=em20240918&amount=5&refcode2=1195_587540_ELmL2x&akid=1195%2E587540%2EELmL2x)**
And most exciting of all, the article discussed some of the wins that Leaders We Deserve has already accumulated over the past year, including electing Nadarius Clark to the Virginia legislature last fall and then securing back-to-back victories in Molly Cook’s primaries and the special election in Houston, **officially making her the youngest and FIRST EVER openly LGBTQ+ member of the Texas Senate.**
Peter, I’m proud to work for Leaders We Deserve because I truly believe that this organization is changing the future for the better. We’re playing the long game and at the same time, we’re making tangible progress right now in this election.

Fellow Conservative,

We’re less than 50 days from the election and voting in our TOSS-UP race begins FRIDAY!!

The anticipated margin for victory in this race is RAZOR THIN, and it could go either way at this point.
