body:
And Congress must respond with a plan that matches its scale.
#
Stop almost anyone on the street today and you’ll hear **we’re in a housing crisis.**
In most American counties, minimum-wage workers can’t afford to rent even a modest one-bedroom apartment. Working families are bidding against the world’s biggest financial firms for homes.
It’s becoming nearly impossible for working-class people to buy and keep a roof over their heads.
**There is another way: social housing.** And today, Alexandria and Senator Tina Smith introduced legislation to build millions of Americans a safe, comfortable, and affordable place to call home — with the security and dignity that come with it.
**Read more about their plan in the op-ed below** , and if you can, [make a $5 donation to power Alexandria and Tina's continued fight to ensure that housing is a human right →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240918-smith.NAvFZt&refcode=em20240918-7222-P_FND_SPL_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7222%2E2526796%2Eu23Pvz)
* * *
Stop almost anyone on the street today and you’ll hear **we’re in a housing crisis**. In most American counties, minimum-wage workers can’t afford to rent even a modest one-bedroom apartment. Working families are bidding against the world’s biggest financial firms for homes. On top of it all, people living in public housing complexes across the country are increasingly exposed to inhumane conditions after years of federal neglect and underinvestment.
It’s becoming nearly impossible for working-class people to buy and keep a roof over their heads. **Congress must respond with a plan that matches the scale of this crisis**.
For generations, the federal government’s approach to housing policy has been primarily focused on encouraging single-family homeownership and private investment in rental housing. The mortgage-interest deduction provides roughly $30 billion in tax write-offs to homeowners annually. In addition to their support of the mortgage market, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac provide up to $150 billion in financial backing to the multifamily rental market every year, but much of it goes to large, corporate landlords. These lucrative loans come with very few tenant protections or labor requirements. And the largest affordable housing incentive our government offers — the low-income housing tax credit — too often ends up in the hands of for-profit developers.
**Outsourcing development to the private market leaves affordable housing subject to the boom-and-bust cycle of private investment**. What’s more, the federal government relinquishes the oversight needed to protect tenants from abusive landlords and racial discrimination.
The result is a housing market where corporate landlords make record profits while half of America’s 44 million renters struggle to pay rent. For a generation of young people, the idea of home has become loaded with anxiety; too many know they can’t find an affordable, stable place to rent, let alone buy.
Why is this happening? For decades, thanks to restrictive zoning laws and increasing construction costs, we simply haven’t built enough new housing.
**There is another way: social housing**. Instead of treating real estate as a commodity, we can underwrite the construction of millions of homes and apartments that, by law, _must remain affordable_. Some would be rental units; others would offer Americans the opportunity to build equity. These models of rent caps and homeownership are already working around the world, such as in Vienna, and in some parts of the United States.
**In Congress, the two of us represent very different parts of the country, but New Yorkers and Minnesotans have both benefited from social housing**.
The Electchester complex in Queens and Co-op City in The Bronx today house over 50,000 New Yorkers. Co-op City stands as not only one of the largest housing cooperatives in the world — with its own schools and power plant — but also the largest, naturally occurring retirement community in the country, a testament to its financial and social sustainability.
In Minnesota, trusts, such as Saint Paul’s Rondo Community Land Trust, give people the chance at more affordable homeownership, because the homeowners don’t buy the land; instead, it’s held in trust and leased to homeowners on a long-term, renewable basis. The model has expanded across Minnesota, in rural and suburban communities alike.
**Because we believe that housing is a human right** , like food or health care, we believe that more Americans deserve the option of social housing. That’s why we’re introducing **the Homes Act, a plan to establish a new, federally backed development authority to finance and build homes in big cities and small towns across America**. These homes would be built to last by union workers, and then turned over to entities that agree to manage them for permanent affordability: public and tribal housing authorities, cooperatives, tenant unions, community land trusts, nonprofits and local governments.
Our housing development authority wouldn’t be focused on maximizing profit or returns to shareholders. **Rent would be capped at 25 percent of a household’s adjusted annual gross income**. Homes would be set aside for lower-income families in mixed-income buildings and communities. And every home would be built to modern, efficient standards, which would cut residents’ utility costs. Renters wouldn’t have to worry about the prospect of a big corporation buying up the building and evicting everyone. Some could even come together to purchase their buildings outright.
To fund social housing construction, our development authority would rely on a combination of congressional spending and Treasury-backed loans, making financing resilient to the volatility of our housing market and the political winds of the annual appropriations process.
**Our bill would also invest in public housing and repeal the Faircloth Amendment, which prevents the construction of new public housing**. Passed in 1998, with the support of both parties, the amendment helped entrench a cycle of stigmatization and disinvestment. Our legislation would reinvest federal money in local public housing authorities to fund the backlog of much-needed repairs.
We know that housing looks a lot different in Bemidji, Minn., than in The Bronx. **It shouldn’t be a one-size-fits-all approach**. That’s why our bill would task local governments, unions and established local nonprofits with developing homes that blend seamlessly into the landscape of the town and fit the needs of the people living in them.
Research from New York University, the University of California, Berkeley, and the Climate and Community Institute estimates that **our bill could build and preserve more than 1.25 million homes, including more than 850,000 for the lowest-income households**.
**We can’t wait for the private market alone to solve the housing crisis**. This is the federal government’s chance to invest in social housing and give millions of Americans a safe, comfortable and affordable place to call home — with the sense of security and dignity that come with it.
* * *
Thank you for reading,
Team AOC
Alexandria and Tina are fighting to prove that housing is a human right, like food or health care, and for working-class people across the country to have a brighter, more secure, future.

Peter, Washington State Attorney General Bob Ferguson is the Democrat running to be our neighboring state’s next Governor. subject: Did you catch this really important email from John?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
[1]Fetterman's Frontline Five

Did you catch this really important email from John?

This week, John launched what we are calling “Fetterman’s Frontline Five”
with a goal to raise $150,000 by September 30th for 5 key Senate races
that will decide the fate of our Senate majority.

In the few hours since we launched, support has poured in from all over
the nation!

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240918?refcode=em20240918-FFF-9395&refcode2=9395_434096_wljf9I&akid=9395%2E434096%2Ewljf9I ][IMG]

Folks from around the country all want to see one thing: a Democratic
majority in the Senate. That won’t be possible without the election of the
Frontline Five.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240918?refcode=em20240918-FFF-9395&refcode2=9395_434096_wljf9I&akid=9395%2E434096%2Ewljf9I ]Will you make a $5 contribution to lend your much needed
support to the Frontline Five and by doing so, get us one step closer to
protecting a blue Senate?

Thanks,
Team Fetterman

P.S. If you didn’t get a chance to read John’s email, keep on reading:

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: John Fetterman
Date: Tuesday, September 17, 2024
Subject: Meet the Frontline Five
To: Derek [dpwillis67@gmail.com]

Derek, I refuse
to believe that we will lose the Senate this year. 🙅♂️

The GOP is spending millions of dollars to unseat five of my colleagues
and return Mitch McConnell the majority. They are hoping to flip seats in
Nevada, Montana, Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, and my home state,
Pennsylvania. And with those wins, Republicans plan to take back control
of the U.S. Senate. Not on my watch.

If we are going to deliver stability, unity, and a new way forward with
Kamala Harris, we will need to defend our Democratic Senate majority. It’s
a feat that won’t be possible without the re-election of what I am calling
my Frontline Five:

Bob Casey
Jon Tester
Jacky Rosen
Sherrod Brown
Tammy Baldwin

So far this cycle, we have raised over $75,000 for these critical races
thanks to supporters like you – but there is so much more that we need to
do to make sure these Senators win their elections and return to a blue
Senate, + Election Day is rapidly approaching!

That’s why: I am setting a goal to raise $150,000 for the Frontline Five
by the end of the third quarter (September 30th at midnight). This
infusion of support will help these campaigns meet their end-of-quarter
goals AND provide much-needed support to fight off attacks from the GOP
and its super PACs.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240918?refcode=em20240918-FFF-9395&refcode2=9395_434096_wljf9I&akid=9395%2E434096%2Ewljf9I ][IMG]

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240918?refcode=em20240918-FFF-9395&refcode2=9395_434096_wljf9I&akid=9395%2E434096%2Ewljf9I ]Derek, will
you rush a $5 contribution to the Frontline Five and get us
one step closer to keeping a blue Senate? We have less than halfway to go
to reach our $150,000 goal and get these Democratic candidates over the
line!

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240918?amount=5&refcode=em20240918-FFF-9395&refcode2=9395_434096_wljf9I&akid=9395%2E434096%2Ewljf9I ]Donate $5 »

I don’t have to tell you how much is at stake in this election. Keeping a
blue Senate is paramount to delivering on the issues that matter most to
Americans:

✅ Securing access to abortion
✅ Codifying LGBTQ+ rights
✅ Passing the voting rights act
✅ Voting through liberal SCOTUS nominations
✅ Approving Kamala Harris’ Cabinet picks
✅ and so much more...

None of this is possible if we lose the Senate in November. Every donation
you make to a Fetterman’s Frontline Five email will go directly to each of
the five key Senate races needed to defend our Senate Majority.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240918?refcode=em20240918-FFF-9395&refcode2=9395_434096_wljf9I&akid=9395%2E434096%2Ewljf9I ]So, I have to ask,
Derek: will you take action
RIGHT NOW to help defend the Frontline Five and our Democratic Senate
Majority by making a $5 contribution right now?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-fff-20240918?amount=5&refcode=em20240918-FFF-9395&refcode2=9395_434096_wljf9I&akid=9395%2E434096%2Ewljf9I ]Donate »

This election is too important to sit on the sidelines. I hope you’ll join
me in supporting my Frontline Five and defending our majority at this
pivotal moment.

💙 John

John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.johnfetterman.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1001&akid=9395%2E434096%2Ewljf9I

We’re in the fight of our lives this election — abortion is on the ballot. Abortion is not a dirty word. And when we treat it like one, we harm women. Republicans were never stopping with abortion. MAGA extremists are coming after contraception & IVF. They’re coming after women. Far-right groups and megadonors are pouring funds into Nevada, trying to flip the White House and the Senate so they can pass a national abortion ban. Friend,

Donald Trump and JD Vance's far-right playbook, Project 2025, is full of wacky ideas. But we need to talk about its blatant attack on workers' rights.
**Project 2025 would eliminate overtime protections** for an estimated 4.3 million workers, allowing states to opt out of federal overtime and minimum wage laws.

**Project 2025 would eliminate unions as we know them** , taking away the bargaining power and collective organizing that generations of Ohioans have fought for and earned.

**Project 2025 would give corporations a free pass to****engage in union-busting activities** , which will drive up profits for C-suite executives.
Here's what you won't find in Project 2025: **the belief that hard work should pay off or that every worker should have a voice in the workplace. That's the Dignity of Work, and I've fought for it every day of my career.**

**It's clear as day that the GOP's corporate megadonors are spending record-breaking amounts of money to defeat me, flip the Senate, and cash in their newfound power by implementing Project 2025.**

clean_body: He’s a Marine and Mayor. Now he needs your help to win this Congressional seat. | Fellow American, let me introduce you to Kamala Harris’ worst nightmare - Kevin Lincoln. Kevin has served our nation as a Marine and a mayor in California. Now, he’s running for one of the most competitive congressional seats in the country, right in Kamala’s backyard. He knows how to win as a Republican in California. And that scares the Left. I know firsthand the nasty names that Democrats call black and minority Republicans. I’ve been called EVERY NAME in the book. They will do the same to Kevin Lincoln. That’s why we need to do whatever we can to help him win this November. Fellow American, right now we have a slim majority in the House of Representatives. If we have any chance of passing the conservative agenda, I need new partners like Kevin Lincoln in Washington. Please, don’t give up on this opportunity to send a message to Kamala Harris and the radical Left. Thanks, Byron Donalds | Meet Kevin Lincoln My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton. Like , Follow , and Subscribe! **THIS IS INSANE. ** This week, Meta/Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg published a letter admitting the Biden-Harris administration pressured Facebook to censor content they didn’t like, **and wait till you see what was included. ** Here’s the letter from Mark Zuckerberg:
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=17333f06894043ca80b8beb8d05ea1ac&_e=rjt2UGmUOIzTuj0dKx2-GgnYdWbdM0gR0c7p3Nya6tuqR3x2YfjCPgmUfml4qApXresvmQS4o9osMdX5VsXe0C_A7srUFbn9MuICahR67Lot3N5Cjo-coNae18avY9BeCccCFa166Mh8Hd9crPIiBJs0rzJ7pJSc1KrrFmXnu1UQtxVvcPqMPFE5oBci1hWWNE8Vjcer4zlUooEKk3XSGZ15v8WdEZeVAnvvWSUReil9m3jYjKduff7Uk5TNSl17ighuoJxdfwtYuzm-FsdFTw%3D%3D)

subject: You’re running out of time to sign the Air Force birthday card
body:
You're running out of time to sign the Air Force birthday card
I'm reaching out to make sure you saw the email Christopher sent this morning. Have you had a chance to **[sign the U.S. Air Force birthday card yet? We're aiming for 77,000 signatures and we're getting close.](https://links.e.uso.)**
I know it might seem like a small thing, but your words of support really do matter, especially on days like today. My brother is currently stationed far from home and deploying on urgent missions in defense of our nation. Knowing that folks back home are thinking of him and appreciating what he does means the world to him, and others like him.
By signing this card, you're showing service members that their efforts are recognized and valued. Trust me, those kind thoughts and well-wishes can really lift their spirits.
So, **[before midnight, will you add your name to celebrate the Air Force's 77th birthday and thank all our airmen for their service? ](https://links.e.uso.)**
Thank you,
Jamie Finfrock, USO

USO Supporter, **today the Air Force celebrates its 77th birthday** , and we set a goal to collect 77,000 signatures and well-wishes for our brave airmen. But right now, we're coming up short, and I'm counting on you to help us reach our goal before this chance passes by.
**[It only takes a moment to show your support, so please: Will you add your name now to honor our airmen while there's still time?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/0d-ehpay-GS_/dGdaRjVGNVVlV2REalFoa0ZscUkrRytYSHI0SUpSbWptVHptMzdOSE5EeDAwM2hndjQ4WlMyRTk2UGN3SUNmOEI5TzZ3U09HS1h1eFQ4bE1GTlhwNmtvaVpqTTkxZ0NIdzNvK2VJL1lnVUU9S0/S0pjcVZiZG1yTGRpL3JJd2tpcThrczk1TVdLK25DN0VPOHVZTFR5VHpOZEZuSWFhaEw1dGEyc202NWhyMWRYOC90cTdzb01TMVZLOTVwTjhSMGNJQUdtUEtTUkxSeHZGS0)**
I've seen firsthand the risks our airmen take and the sacrifices they -- and their families -- make on behalf of us all. Over the course of 25 years, including my deployments to Afghanistan, Kuwait and other locations in the Middle East, my family and I made those sacrifices too.
During one of those long deployments, my wife got this idea from another military spouse: Fill a jar with M&M'S to help our kids count down the days until my return. Every day, they'd get to eat one M&M -- just one! -- and by the time the jar was empty, I'd be home.
Then, my deployment was extended. The thought of disappointing our kids was heartbreaking. But in the middle of the night, my wife secretly added M&M'S to the jar, keeping it just filled enough so our little ones wouldn't lose hope. I don't know how she held it together for our kids for so long. But I do know that every military family has their own story of perseverance just like ours.
**That 's why it's so important to share these stories and honor the sacrifices made by so many airmen and their loved ones. Today, as we reflect on the Air Force's birthday, your words of encouragement, understanding and gratitude are even more powerful.**
[SIGN NOW TO HONOR OUR HEROES](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/gdYehE~7WYCL/dGdaRjVGNVVlV2REalFoa0ZscUkrRytYSHI0SUpSbWptVHptMzdOSE5EeDAwM2hndjQ4WlMyRTk2UGN3SUNmOEI5TzZ3U09HS1h1eFQ4bE1GTlhwNmtvaVpqTTkxZ0NIdzNvK2VJL1lnVUU9S0/S0pjcVZiZG1yTGRpL3JJd2tpcThrczk1TVdLK25DN0VPOHVZTFR5VHpOZEZuSWFhaEw1dGEyc202NWhyMWRYOC90cTdzb01TMVZLOTVwTjhSMGNJQUdtUEtTUkxSeHZGS0)
---
Serving in the Air Force is a challenging and vital mission, but it's a source of great pride. We do it because families like yours and mine are worth every effort, and the support of the American people keeps us strong.
**So please, will you take this opportunity to make today special for everyone in the Air Force?**
**[Add your name before midnight to show our Air Force heroes and all our service members you care and thank them for the sacrifices.](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/4NKwHKag~Xh_/dGdaRjVGNVVlV2REalFoa0ZscUkrRytYSHI0SUpSbWptVHptMzdOSE5EeDAwM2hndjQ4WlMyRTk2UGN3SUNmOEI5TzZ3U09HS1h1eFQ4bE1GTlhwNmtvaVpqTTkxZ0NIdzNvK2VJL1lnVUU9S0/S0pjcVZiZG1yTGRpL3JJd2tpcThrczk1TVdLK25DN0VPOHVZTFR5VHpOZEZuSWFhaEw1dGEyc202NWhyMWRYOC90cTdzb01TMVZLOTVwTjhSMGNJQUdtUEtTUkxSeHZGS0)**
Thank you for supporting our military heroes,
Christopher Plamp

This may be corny to say, Peter, but it’s true.
In the nearly 20 years that I’ve been a professor in Arizona, my students have taught me more than I could ever hope to teach them.
I’ve taught classes on climate change, administrative law, drought policy, and more. In all of them, my students have shown me what it means to believe in a brighter future.
Time and time again, I’ve seen my students tackle tough, complicated issues with determination and creativity. They lean on each other, using team work and humor in the face of existential problems like climate change. They’re unafraid to take on the status quo and confront injustice — because they’re focused on what can be .
Politics can be slow and frustrating. But I’m in this race because I believe, like my students have shown me, that a better future is possible.
We can restore reproductive rights across the country. We can bring good-paying clean energy jobs to our state. We can lower the cost of housing and health care. We can create a drought contingency plan that protects Arizona’s water to generations to come.
Flipping AZ-06 blue will get us one step closer to making an Arizona where we can all thrive.
My opponent stands for extremist policies that will drag us into the past. Will you help me take on him and corporate, out-of-state donors by chipping in now? Every dollar counts in the frontline race. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091824_Professor_act]

Thank you, Peter.
Kirsten

Kirsten is a mom, an environmental attorney, and a former State Legislator who has spent the past six years fighting to restore funding to public schools, protect Arizona's natural resources, and make our communities safer.
She’s ready to take that fight to Washington to find common-sense solutions to the challenges we’re facing here in Arizona's Sixth Congressional District.

| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
---
[](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=7&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0) Hey — born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.

**In a moment, I’ll ask you** [**to join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in the critical U.S. Senate race happening in my home state against Josh Hawley this year and Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=8&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0) **But first, I think we need to talk about family values.** | [CHIP IN NOW »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=9&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
---
I learned what family values meant while growing up in Missouri, the most beautiful state in the union.
I also learned what that didn’t mean.
[](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=10&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
Family values didn’t mean cruelty. It didn’t mean fake patriotism. It didn’t mean telling people how to live, or family profits. It didn’t mean making life harder for hardworking people. And it sure as hell didn’t mean robbing people of their rights or tax dollars.

**None of that is family values... that’s something else.**
[CHIP IN NOW »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=11&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
---
Growing up in working class neighborhoods in Missouri, Lucas and I both learned what it meant for a family to live paycheck to paycheck.

We also learned the real meaning of family values — but not from rich politicians and self-help authors like Josh Hawley.
[](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=12&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
**We’re the Show Me State. People showed us.**
[](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=13&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
[CHIP IN A SPLIT DONATION NOW »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=14&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
---
People like the neighbors and church friends that helped Lucas’ family get by when his parents were bankrupted by medical bills. People like the Scout master, track coach, and public school teachers who mentored and supported Lucas growing up. People like the veterans at Lucas’ local Marine Corps league in mid-Missouri, who taught him that he could honor and protect everyone who took care of him by serving like they did.

Lucas and I both learned that family values are really about people taking care of each other and doing the right thing. Through good times, and tough times.

**All that other noise from the politicians...**
[](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=15&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
**That’s something else.**

In Missouri this November, there’s a real choice in the Senate race. Josh Hawley only won his last race with 51% of the vote — and that was before he helped overturn Roe, enacted a total abortion ban, voted against IVF and birth control, stalled healthcare for veterans, and cost taxpayers $250,000 by breaking transparency laws to help his own campaign.

Lucas Kunce is the Marine veteran who can beat him. It won’t be easy, but it will be worth it.
**So I’m asking:** [**Will you join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race by splitting a donation of any amount with Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats? Lucas is committed to building his campaign the right way, without a dollar from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists, so anything you can give really will make a big impact.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=16&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Lucas Kunce will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51905?t=17&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51906?t=18&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51907?t=19&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51908?t=20&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/51904?t=21&akid=22092%2E4449941%2EFgxQL0)
Thanks for listening,

John Goodman

| | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. Our union was nearly torn apart by the great evil of slavery – 620,000 soldiers fell during the Civil War. Yet the star spangled banner still waved over the land of the free and the home of the brave. America ended two World Wars, demolished the Soviet Union, and stands today as a shining city on a hill to which the whole world looks for leadership and guidance. Through it all, the beautiful scars America has developed are proof that our country is the greatest, most benevolent, and freest nation in the history of mankind. It’s to that country, and the people who she represents, I have pledged my life, my service, my body, mind, and soul. As long as there is breath in my lungs and blood flowing through my veins, I will never stop fighting to make sure that America’s future is bright and beautiful. clean_body: I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter – and she saw what I looked like before I was injured in Afghanistan. | | | | | | | | Friend, I was sorting through old pictures with my daughter the other day and she saw a photo of me before I was injured in Afghanistan. She said to me: “Dad, I think you look better now.” Her precious words were a good reminder – my scars aren’t just cosmetic damage... They are a deep part of who I am & my story. They paint a picture of my service and commitment to my country – but more than that, they’re proof that struggle & sacrifice & pain are beautiful and not something to be avoided. When I think about my scars I feel a deep kinship with my country – America has been scarred too. Our great country has been beat-up and bloodied – but through each struggle she emerges more beautiful than before. The founders waged a bloody war to create an idea – an experiment – to prove that freedom flourishes & tyranny destroys. Against the odds and despite the challenges – America emerged more victorious and more beautiful than before. Our union was nearly torn apart by the great evil of slavery – 620,000 soldiers fell during the Civil War. Yet the star spangled banner still waved over the land of the free and the home of the brave. America ended two World Wars, demolished the Soviet Union, and stands today as a shining city on a hill to which the whole world looks for leadership and guidance. Through it all, the beautiful scars America has developed are proof that our country is the greatest, most benevolent, and freest nation in the history of mankind. It’s to that country, and the people who she represents, I have pledged my life, my service, my body, mind, and soul. As long as there is breath in my lungs and blood flowing through my veins, I will never stop fighting to make sure that America’s future is bright and beautiful. And I’d be honored beyond explanation to receive your support in my mission to continue my service to America as the next United States Senator from Nevada. **Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. If you’d like to unsubscribe, | | Peter, Artificial Intelligence holds tremendous promise to improve quality of life, but as with many technologies, there is a significant risk that it could reinforce existing structural, economic, social, and demographic disparities. Diversity matters. Period. With something as consequential and revolutionary as AI, we must take significant strides to ensure we can properly foster and develop a diverse workforce in the AI landscape. We need to keep up with a constantly evolving world, Peter. We need legislation that stays ahead of the game and uplifts the common good. I’ve never been one to slow down — so staying on top of critical bills, such as the Expanding AI Voices Act , is right in my wheelhouse. = | = I’m proud to champion the Expanding AI Voices Act , Peter. This bipartisan legislation will facilitate capacity building, promote increased access, and broaden participation across the Artificial Intelligence industry. The talent of our nation’s MSIs, HBCUs, rural-serving institutions, and TCUs will be empowered to bridge the digital divide and ensure equitable access to AI opportunities. MAKE AMERICA HEALTHY
Life Expectancy Crisis—
We Must Act Now
Dear Peter,
Obesity.
Chronic Illness.
Allergies.
Lifelong Prescriptions.
We have shortened life expectancy.
You and I want something better for our children and grandchildren.
**But nothing will change** unless and until we have someone willing to take on the task of cleaning out Washington’s corrupt “health” agencies and holding Big Pharma and Big Ag to account for their willful inaction that is hurting and maiming millions. At the same time, they continue to make record profits.
Our movement to **protect our children’s health** and hold individuals accountable for prioritizing profits over people has become a groundswell.
The announcement that RFK Jr. suspended his campaign for the White House and endorsed President Donald Trump to take on the corporate capture of our nation’s “health” agencies and open investigations into Big Ag and Big Pharma–has taken the country by storm.
Consider—
* RFK Jr.’s Arizona Endorsement Speech seen by over 100 million, and
* RFK Jr.’s interviews on significant network television jumped 10-fold–including primary interviews on Dr. Phil, Tucker Carlson, FOX News, Glenn Beck, and Chris Cuomo’s News Nation.

This new embrace RFK Jr. continues to receive for his work protecting children’s health is nothing short of astonishing–and we have you to thank for making it possible.
[Your gifts, signed petitions, volunteering, prayers–all of it has led to the formation of individuals committed to a Unity Government–one that includes former Democrats like RFK Jr. and now Tulsi Gabbard.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=growing_movement_9_18_24_nd1&n=5)
Americans are realizing that we need to prioritize our country above political party. We need to come together to solve our nation’s most pressing and complex problems..., and we will only be able to do that with your continued support.
**Your gift of $25, $50, $100 or more** will grow our voice– _the voice of the people_ –in the public square ahead of Election Day, in Washington after Election Day, and in the corporate board rooms all across America.
We will shake up Washington, clean out the corruption, investigate wrongdoing, and hold particular individuals accountable to you, the taxpayer.
Together, this nationwide grassroots movement will...
Make America Healthy Again!

body:
You’d think I’d be used to it by now. But just when you think the News Media can’t sink any lower... they surprise me.

| |

---
| | | I've spent more years in Washington than I care to admit.

You'd think I'd be used to it by now. But just when I think the News Media can't sink any lower... they surprise me.

September 15th was a horrible day for our country. I thanked God Almighty for protecting President Trump a second time. I prayed hard for Trump's Family and for our country that day. And every day since.

The Media, on the other hand, took a different tone.
_Politico made sure to report "Republicans outraged" over it.

The Washington Post described it as a "golf course episode."_
_MSNBC even had the gall to suggest Trump was to blame for not "toning down the rhetoric." _
I'm fuming. Our News Media has fallen so far from grace. It has NEVER been more clear their sole motive is to drag Conservatives through the mud and help Democrats win elections.

**_[That's why it's incumbent on ALL OF US to stand up to them.](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkTGPnTAMxz9N2IISJxAYMpx0YupVVZeOUSCGFykEFAzv-u0rnnRTl3a2f_77Z__6cB8-ppiX735FO6fiyuHocsfkE8_4JD75TA4EaC56Ljsnq2CF7IPWFVppoDVCNEJWD2t6JbzC2QCOEzbdiJPuUOsOABUaX0V7zxG97ABko9taSBU8gMRxNqprOqaFT1iongti2FafQ4ojFvpdcN8K1dO2Vsk-iPaDqTcGA4PhwOksWD9jLhjuDgYDoV_57RAPZDDcDnzEFPFCTo94vNRuXA3lxkvMC1PvVE5k0J60usmvu49LZur9a2n3440P337KWkoNvXYkG22EUFyapmXQ4qejGP4DeOVsmTDTHX7xORX-BTNoP898_V2oig37M6YUj9YwLZbVx_S6DP3jAy8LfwIAAP__3n-auQ "That’s why it’s incumbent on ALL OF US to stand up to them. | Peter,

**Congratulations to Emerge’s Seated Together Class of 2024. The third cohort just graduated 11 trailblazing Black women from across the country. Let’s celebrate them! **** 🎉**

This is a critical moment in our democracy, and it is empowering to see the next generation of leadership ready to win this November!

Seated Together is Emerge’s advanced candidate leadership program specifically for Black women elected officials who aspire to run for higher office. The program was co-founded by Congresswoman Emilia Sykes (OH-13) and Colorado state Rep. Leslie Herod. Just last week, our third Seated Together cohort graduated and we gathered in Washington, DC to celebrate at our annual Level Up event.

**_The 2024 class included:_**
* Representative Rhetta Andrews Bowers, Texas, House District 113
* Representative Morgan Cephas, Pennsylvania, House District 192
* Senator Merika Coleman, Alabama, District 19, Chair Alabama Legislative Black Caucus
* Representative Gina H. Curry, Pennsylvania, Legislative District 164
* Trustee Erica Gilmore, Tennessee, Metropolitan Trustee of Nashville & Davidson County
* Senator Sonya Halpern, Georgia, Senate District 39
* Representative Annie E. McDaniel, South Carolina, House District 41
* Council President LaMonica McIver, New Jersey, Council Member, Central Ward, Newark and Democratic nominee for New Jersey’s 10th Congressional District
* Senator Elizabeth “Liz” Miranda, Massachusetts, Second Suffolk District
* Mayor Talisha Searcy, Maryland, Takoma Park
* Assemblymember Lori Wilson, California, Assembly District 11

There's nothing like connecting in person to spark real change. Yesterday in Michigan was proof of that. I spent National Voter Registration Day knocking on doors for Kamala Harris, meeting with dedicated organizers and students working to get out the vote, and speaking at a **_Climate Voters for Harris_** event at the University of Michigan. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93095318/499341908/1555083529?refcode=ea.443500b6-0c76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.443500b6-0c76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ0MzUwMGI2LTBjNzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CEWxRL1CjPFOltIsTEnioNQ1aZrbGDcfJoYf_V3GIwk=) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93095319/499341909/1555083529?refcode=ea.443500b6-0c76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.443500b6-0c76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ0MzUwMGI2LTBjNzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CEWxRL1CjPFOltIsTEnioNQ1aZrbGDcfJoYf_V3GIwk=) One encounter in particular moved me deeply. As I approached a home in Ann Arbor, a woman answered the door. The surprise on her face turned into a warm embrace as we shared a heartfelt moment about the importance of this election. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93095320/499341910/1555083529?refcode=ea.443500b6-0c76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.443500b6-0c76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ0MzUwMGI2LTBjNzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CEWxRL1CjPFOltIsTEnioNQ1aZrbGDcfJoYf_V3GIwk=) I loved sharing with her why I’m doing _everything_ I can to get Kamala Harris and Tim Walz elected. **[Even if you're on the other side of the country, your support can make a real impact on GOTV efforts in key battlegrounds like Michigan. If you're ready to help, will you chip in to split a donation between the Harris-Walz campaign and JanePAC?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93095321/499341911/1555083529?refcode=ea.443500b6-0c76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ms=ea.443500b6-0c76-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ0MzUwMGI2LTBjNzYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGVlNjY4MSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CEWxRL1CjPFOltIsTEnioNQ1aZrbGDcfJoYf_V3GIwk=)** We’re facing a critical moment in the fight for our environment, and with battleground states like Michigan hanging in the balance, we need to give it everything we’ve got. Michigan could truly make or break this election — and with it, our last chance to prevent catastrophic climate consequences and avoid a dangerous reversal in climate policy. That's why JanePAC is spending the next 2 months upping our ground game, mobilizing climate voters, and supporting leaders like Vice President Kamala Harris who are committed to a livable future. As I approached a home in Ann Arbor, a woman answered the door. The surprise on her face turned into a warm embrace as we shared a heartfelt moment about the importance of this election. = I loved sharing with her why I’m doing everything I can to get Kamala Harris and Tim Walz elected. = We’re facing a critical moment in the fight for our environment, and with battleground states like Michigan hanging in the balance, we need to give it everything we’ve got. Michigan could truly make or break this election — and with it, our last chance to prevent catastrophic climate consequences and avoid a dangerous reversal in climate policy. | **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. subject: ULTRA-MAGA are making lists – and you’re on them.
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Dictatorships and despots throughout history have made lists of their political enemies – and now the ULTRA-MAGA world is doing the same.
This is the authoritarian playbook: track, control, and silence anyone who dares to dissent.
Just this month, Portage County Sheriff Bruce Zuchowski called on his community to write down the addresses of Kamala Harris supporters.
He didn’t stop there – he went on to say these supporters will soon be harboring immigrants he describes as “illegal human locusts.”
This is what happens when political leaders encourage hate, paranoia, and division.
And Jim Jordan? He’s playing right into it.
From abortion surveillance under Project 2025 to supporting the ULTRA-MAGA extremists who want to put librarians on sex offender lists simply for providing books that mention LGBTQ+ people, the pattern is crystal clear: make lists of everyone who isn’t “us,” and punish them.
Contribute now to help us take on this extremist agenda before it goes too far. Your support will help us hit our $1M goal this month and take the fight directly to Jim Jordan and the ULTRA-MAGA extremists. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240918_ohio_sheriff_link1]
Ultimately, the warped agenda of the broken GOP is all about control, fear, and silence.
And there’s only one purpose for lists like these—tear down anyone who doesn’t fit into their narrow worldview.
These people are dangerous, and Jim Jordan is leading the charge.
Project 2025 is his playbook, and it’s a full-blown assault on democracy.
He wants to strip away women’s rights and reproductive freedoms, suppress votes, and weaponize the law to punish those who dare to stand against them.
Jordan, under the bidding of creeps like Donald Trump and JD Vance, is creating an authoritarian nightmare, and he won’t stop unless we stand up.
This is the most important congressional race in the country. We can’t let extremists like Jim Jordan continue to fan the flames of hate and division.
The stakes are too high.
Let’s send a message loud and clear: America is better than this. Contribute today, and let’s stop them before it’s too late. Together, we can restore sanity and protect our democracy from the dangerous path they’re on. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240918_ohio_sheriff_link2]

# [#] Team,

Did you know that every day, tens of thousands of Americans are the victim of change of address fraud – and it’s increasing by more than double each year.

We need to require a government ID to change an address, and add two-factor authentication to the process – the same standard of security required to open a bank account or a credit card.

It’s time that the USPS starts taking change of address fraud seriously. Will you add your name to stand with me and demand action on behalf of the tens of thousands of Americans affected by this every year? [https://go.josh4congress.com/a/usps-2409]

STAND WITH JOSH [https://go.josh4congress.com/a/usps-2409]

For years, Josh has demanded that the USPS take action to protect New Jerseyans’ mail, checks, gifts, veterans benefits, tax returns, Social Security checks, and life-saving medications from thieves. Jersey Families deserve to trust their post office and be safe from the con artists and scammers who take advantage of the weak points in the system.

Add your name to stand with Josh and demand the USPS take action to protect our Jersey Families → [https://go.josh4congress.com/a/usps-2409]

Thank you for fighting with us,

Team Gottheimer

But it's support from this team of fearless fighters that allows me to keep going.= | | = The similarities between Kamala and me go further than our upbringings. We both started out as prosecutors and moved our way up to attorneys general, holding corrupt politicians and corporations accountable for their crimes. And in all our years of service, our commitment has always been to the people. It's the people who make this country great and who power our pursuit of justice – and I'm confident that Kamala Harris is going to fight harder than ever to take down the powerful and corrupt. But if she's going to get the job done, she's going to need folks like me and you fighting by her side in New York and around the country. Just like I vowed when I became New York's first black woman attorney general, I promise to never waver in my fight against malicious magnates and underhanded organizations. But I can't do it alone –= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you. Letitia James | With so many tough and crucial fights ahead, I am counting on people like you to fuel my fight for justice, progress, and true equality. Will you make a monthly donation to make sure I can continue using the full power of the Attorney General's office to make a difference for everyday people and families? | | = | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. * **TOP NEWS**

**" Deer Park fire: Pipeline blaze and evacuations enter third day,"** Houston Chronicle's**Octavia Johnson** and **Caroline Wilburn** -- "A [pipeline fire near Deer Park and La Porte ](https://substack.com/redirect/ceae0152-d956-462f-82d1-8c0657defac5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)was shrinking but still ablaze Wednesday, roughly 48 hours after an [SUV crashed](https://substack.com/redirect/3a246d12-1b21-407d-826e-34a967072dae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) into an above-ground pipeline valve Monday morning, possibly starting the fire.

The [natural gas pipeline is owned by Energy Transfer](https://substack.com/redirect/6f3d17b8-540e-4069-ab46-4e2b48221094?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) located near the border between Deer Park, La Porte and Pasadena. The energy company said it was [utilizing air monitoring equipment](https://substack.com/redirect/6f3d17b8-540e-4069-ab46-4e2b48221094?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the area alongside Harris County's Pollution Control Services Department.

Officials reported on Monday that four people were injured. Two of the injuries were caused by the fire and two were heat-related. A Pasadena firefighter was one of the people who experienced heat stress and was treated with fluids and rested, Fire Chief **Lanny Armstrong** said in an email. The firefighter remained at the scene.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/0d46b489-7069-4f6c-a0df-fa086238bf70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Energy Transfer crews were working to manage and fix a pipeline leak Wednesday by installing stopples, which are used to temporarily block the flow in a pipeline section, according to a news release.

"Initial assessments conducted by local authorities and Energy Transfer revealed a pressure drop at the affected pipeline section," the release reads. "In response, the company immediately shut down the offsite flaring process and initiated procedures to isolate the leak."

The company deployed crews to both the north and south ends of the pipeline to rush the stopple installation process, which is expected to take roughly three hours per side. Once installed, Energy Transfer will redirect the flares to a location in front of the stopple with the goal of creating "a vacuum at the leak source" to diminish the current flame.

Local law enforcement will be present in the area to direct traffic and ensure the safety of the public.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/0d46b489-7069-4f6c-a0df-fa086238bf70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
CenterPoint Energy assured customers that power would be restored to all eligible homes and businesses by the end of Wednesday, according to the news release. Thirty**** customers were without power in the La Porte and Deer Park area as of Wednesday afternoon, La Porte OEM officials said.

After initial tests revealed concerning air quality [surrounding the pipeline](https://substack.com/redirect/f604addc-8764-4fe9-85aa-b1a18fec8350?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Harris County Judge **Lina Hidalgo** [confirmed Tuesday evening](https://substack.com/redirect/48d61ffc-691e-45af-be63-7d86724400d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that more sensitive sets of equipment confirmed the air quality was acceptable.

As [evacuations continued](https://substack.com/redirect/ce11e672-2d72-4fb4-b241-5ae6b76ac37d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), several residents were still waiting for the all-clear to reenter their homes early Wednesday. Impacted residents hadn't returned as of Wednesday, according to city spokesperson **Maria Lawler**. The area still impacted includes Willow Springs Bayou, extending from Fernrock Drive to Somerton Drive, Spencer Highway, Canada Road and Oakhaven Road/Eagle Run Street." **" Deer Park fire: Pipeline blaze and evacuations enter third day,"** Houston Chronicle's**Octavia Johnson** and **Caroline Wilburn** -- "A [pipeline fire near Deer Park and La Porte ](https://substack.com/redirect/3c659273-5586-46dd-9872-73e80a5358be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)was shrinking but still ablaze Wednesday, roughly 48 hours after an [SUV crashed](https://substack.com/redirect/db7bce0d-6046-4148-a848-7dfd2a1b8fc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) into an above-ground pipeline valve Monday morning, possibly starting the fire.

The [natural gas pipeline is owned by Energy Transfer](https://substack.com/redirect/e0efbd1b-4657-44ee-b4b4-58cdf40c2101?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) located near the border between Deer Park, La Porte and Pasadena. The energy company said it was [utilizing air monitoring equipment](https://substack.com/redirect/e0efbd1b-4657-44ee-b4b4-58cdf40c2101?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the area alongside Harris County's Pollution Control Services Department.

Officials reported on Monday that four people were injured. Two of the injuries were caused by the fire and two were heat-related. A Pasadena firefighter was one of the people who experienced heat stress and was treated with fluids and rested, Fire Chief **Lanny Armstrong** said in an email. The firefighter remained at the scene.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/c6b2f3ff-d263-41e7-a727-a9a906b5128e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Energy Transfer crews were working to manage and fix a pipeline leak Wednesday by installing stopples, which are used to temporarily block the flow in a pipeline section, according to a news release.

"Initial assessments conducted by local authorities and Energy Transfer revealed a pressure drop at the affected pipeline section," the release reads. "In response, the company immediately shut down the offsite flaring process and initiated procedures to isolate the leak."

The company deployed crews to both the north and south ends of the pipeline to rush the stopple installation process, which is expected to take roughly three hours per side. Once installed, Energy Transfer will redirect the flares to a location in front of the stopple with the goal of creating "a vacuum at the leak source" to diminish the current flame.

Local law enforcement will be present in the area to direct traffic and ensure the safety of the public.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/c6b2f3ff-d263-41e7-a727-a9a906b5128e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
CenterPoint Energy assured customers that power would be restored to all eligible homes and businesses by the end of Wednesday, according to the news release. Thirty**** customers were without power in the La Porte and Deer Park area as of Wednesday afternoon, La Porte OEM officials said.

After initial tests revealed concerning air quality [surrounding the pipeline](https://substack.com/redirect/38360435-a1b3-42c9-8a46-4c4f1dc3cad5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Harris County Judge **Lina Hidalgo** [confirmed Tuesday evening](https://substack.com/redirect/ff3227f3-072e-4d37-839c-0c8c431e6f59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that more sensitive sets of equipment confirmed the air quality was acceptable.

As [evacuations continued](https://substack.com/redirect/e1c30747-b8fb-4258-b03b-b27920096f42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), several residents were still waiting for the all-clear to reenter their homes early Wednesday. Impacted residents hadn't returned as of Wednesday, according to city spokesperson **Maria Lawler**. [1]Justice Democrats

Last week, the Attorney General of Michigan issued criminal charges
against 9 protesters who demonstrated for a ceasefire in Gaza on the
University of Michigan’s Ann Arbor campus last spring.

As Justice Democrats Rep. Rashida Tlaib pointed out, this is a clear
attack on students’ freedom of speech, which they were using to stand on
the right side of history and demand an end to the ongoing genocide
against innocent Palestinians.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240918.DeOBZK&refcode=em20240918-36002&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=36002%2E1203867%2E4rN-UU ]The AG failed to deliver justice for the victims of the Flint Water
Crisis but has time to bring frivolous charges that only serve to silence
those speaking out against a genocidal apartheid regime? This shameful
attack on students’ rights will fail. Follow the Constitution.

But it gets worse.

A new investigation from the Detroit Free Press found that Detroit police
have spent years monitoring the social media accounts of protesters, even
if they’re not suspected of any crime. When they denied surveilling
ceasefire demonstrators last spring, they lied.

Rashida once again spoke out and stood with activists: “If you stand up
for justice in Detroit, you will be targeted for repression by the Detroit
Police. This is a City gov't that has wasted millions targeting activists.
This has to end.”

We agree, and clearly, we need more progressive, anti-war leaders like
Rashida who are willing to fight for the rights of their constituents
against this targeted surveillance and censorship in Washington.

| Peter,

Whether it’s at home, at school, or in our neighborhoods, every person deserves to feel secure—**and right now,_that safety is under threat from extremist policies that put us all at risk._**
